descriptosaurus-000046.en: Now in a fully updated third edition, Descriptosaurus is the first book for creative writing that is a thematic expansion of a dictionary and a thesaurus; it provides children with a comprehensive resource with which to expand their descriptive vocabulary, experiment with language and sentence structure and build up narratives based around settings, characters and creatures.
descriptosaurus-000046.zh: 现在在一个全面更新的第三版中，Descriptosaurus 是第一本创意写作书籍，它是字典和词库的主题扩展； 它为孩子们提供了一个全面的资源来扩展他们的描述性词汇，尝试语言和句子结构，并根据环境、角色和生物建立叙事。

descriptosaurus-000047.en: Descriptosaurus positions the word, zooms in on it to examine the meaning, expands it into phrases, and then provides alternatives in words, phrases and sentences.
descriptosaurus-000047.zh: 描述 aurus 定位单词，放大它以检查含义，将其扩展为短语，然后在单词、短语和句子中提供替代方案。

descriptosaurus-000048.en: The model was created and refined over a number of years as a result of feedback from children inside and outside the classroom as to the resources they required to inspire and assist them with their writing.
descriptosaurus-000048.zh: 该模型是多年来创建和完善的，这是由于课堂内外的孩子们对他们激发和协助他们写作所需的资源的反馈。

descriptosaurus-000049.en: For reluctant writers or those faced with blank page syndrome, it provides essential starting points to encourage putting pen to paper, not only inspiring children, but also building their confidence, encouraging them to use, apply and create using the correct grammatical structures, and adding colour to their writing through evaluation and experimentation.
descriptosaurus-000049.zh: 对于不情愿的作家或那些面临空白页综合症的人来说，它提供了重要的起点，鼓励他们不仅激励孩子，还要建立他们的信心，鼓励他们使用正确的语法结构，并通过评估和实验为他们的写作增添色彩。

descriptosaurus-000148.en: My aim has always been to provide resources that facilitate the teaching of creative writing in such a way as to enthuse and engage the children, to relieve the pressure on teachers, who spend many hours of their ‘spare time’ creating their own differentiated resources, as well as ideas and guidance for parents, and a structure to enable pupils to work independently.
descriptosaurus-000148.zh: 我的目标一直是提供资源，以促进创意写作的教学，以激发孩子们的热情和参与，以减轻教师的压力，他们花费大量时间“业余时间”创造自己的差异化资源，以及为家长提供的想法和指导，以及一个让学生能够帮助学生的结构。 独立工作。

descriptosaurus-000149.en: When I first decided to write Descriptosaurus it was because my experience of teaching creative writing to children had revealed that many had great imaginations and lots of ideas but lacked the descriptive vocabulary to communicate these effectively.
descriptosaurus-000149.zh: 当我第一次决定写 Descriptasaurus 时，这是因为我向孩子们教授创意写作的经验表明，许多人有很大的想象力和很多想法，但缺乏有效地传达这些内容的描述性词汇。

descriptosaurus-000150.en: The original focus of Descriptosaurus was to provide children with a comprehensive resource to help them to expand their descriptive vocabulary and to demonstrate how words, phrases and clauses could be incorporated in a variety of sentence structures.
descriptosaurus-000150.zh: Descriptasaurus 的最初重点是为儿童提供全面的资源，以帮助他们扩展描述性词汇，并展示如何将单词、短语和从句纳入各种句子结构中。

descriptosaurus-000152.en: In the Descriptosaurus genre series – Action & Adventure, Ghost Stories, Myths & Legends, and Fantasy – I set out with a new system I called S/C-I-R (Setting/Character, Interaction, Reaction) to tackle the issues I had encountered with disjointed pieces of description: action scenes that were merely a list of actions with no description of setting, other characters or emotions; excellent descriptions of setting, but the character(s) did not move through (interact with) the setting.
descriptosaurus-000152.zh: 在Descriptosaurus类型系列中——动作与冒险、鬼故事、神话与传说和幻想——我开始使用一个我称之为S/C-I-R的新系统（设置/角色，交互，反应）来解决我遇到的脱节问题 描述片段：动作场景，只是一个动作列表，没有描述，没有描述，其他角色或情感； 对设置的出色描述，但字符没有通过（与）设置进行交互。

descriptosaurus-000154.en: This was also an attempt to provide a contextualised alternative to the prescriptive, repetitive focus on textbook grammar in response to the introduction of the SPAG tests, which shifted the focus to knowledge of the language and the labelling of its component parts rather than its application.
descriptosaurus-000154.zh: 这也是试图提供一种基于SPAG测试的规范性重复性关注教科书语法的语境化替代方案，将重点转移到对语言的知识和其组成部分的标签上，而不是它的应用。

descriptosaurus-000155.en: By taking a number of sentences or phrases for setting, interaction and reaction, combining them into a descriptive paragraph of a scene, and then experimenting with different ways of combining the sentences, openers and length, children learn about grammar but also, more importantly, its purpose and impact on flow, sense and expression.
descriptosaurus-000155.zh: 通过取一些句子或短语进行设置、交互和反应，将它们组合成场景的描述性段落，然后尝试将句子、开头和长度组合起来的不同方式，让孩子们了解语法，更重要的是，它的目的和对流动、意义和表达的影响。

descriptosaurus-000156.en: Why Write a Third Edition of Descriptosaurus?
descriptosaurus-000156.zh: 为什么要写第三版描述龙？

descriptosaurus-000157.en: Learning grammar as knowledge in preparation for specific assessments may result in decent scores, but it does not necessarily follow that this knowledge will be demonstrated in pupils’ everyday or creative writing.
descriptosaurus-000157.zh: 学习语法作为准备特定评估的知识可能会产生不错的分数，但并不一定会在学生的日常或创造性写作中展示这些知识。

descriptosaurus-000158.en: The process that is used to succeed in the tests is temporary and shallow, with little guarantee that pupils progress to understand, evaluate, apply and create.
descriptosaurus-000158.zh: 用于测试成功的过程是暂时的和肤浅的，几乎没有保证学生能够理解、评估、应用和创造。

descriptosaurus-000159.en: As with all assessments, the challenge we face is to balance the need to prepare for the SPAG tests with teaching those skills as part of completing and improving a creative writing task so that children know that the ultimate aim is to be able to use the skills and knowledge in a real context.
descriptosaurus-000159.zh: 与所有评估一样，我们面临的挑战是平衡准备 SPAG 测试的需要与教授这些技能作为完成和改进创意写作任务的一部分，以便孩子们知道最终目标是能够在真实的环境中使用这些技能和知识。

descriptosaurus-000160.en: I found the artificial sentences in grammar books that were concocted to illustrate a target sentence structure rarely captured the attention or imagination of the children, but using the same target structure in contextualised sentences that related to the creative text being composed and discussing their impact had a very positive effect on engagement and enthusiasm.
descriptosaurus-000160.zh: 我在语法书籍中发现了用于说明目标句子结构的人工句子，很少引起孩子们的注意力或想象力，但是在与创作文本相关的语境化句子中使用相同的目标结构并讨论其影响对参与和讨论产生了非常积极的影响，并且 热情。

descriptosaurus-000162.en: I therefore felt it was necessary to develop the Descriptosaurus model further, to not only incorporate models for the coordination and subordination requirements of the National Curriculum, but also provide models that teach children how to embed description and imagery in their writing by using a variety of phrases and structures.
descriptosaurus-000162.zh: 因此，我觉得有必要进一步开发描述龙模型，不仅要结合国家课程的协调和从属要求的模型，还提供教导儿童如何通过使用各种短语和结构将描述和意象嵌入到写作中的模型。

descriptosaurus-000163.en: These models can then be used to accumulate grammatical knowledge and, at the same time, discuss the grammatical skills involved in changing the structure of a sentence and its impact.
descriptosaurus-000163.zh: 然后可以使用这些模型来积累语法知识，同时讨论改变句子结构及其影响所涉及的语法技能。

descriptosaurus-000164.en: In the words of Ted Hughes: ‘the example goes like magic through all their writing... if you do it regularly. This is the only successful method I found of teaching grammar ...’.
descriptosaurus-000164.zh: 用泰德休斯的话来说：“这个例子在他们所有的写作中都像魔术一样……如果你经常这样做的话。 这是我发现语法教学的唯一成功方法......'。

descriptosaurus-000165.en: The ability to link ideas within sentences by combining and sequencing clauses enables pupils to structure and connect ideas.
descriptosaurus-000165.zh: 通过组合和排序从句将句子中的想法联系起来的能力使学生能够构建和连接想法。

descriptosaurus-000166.en: However, partly as a result of the identification and labelling required by the SPAG tests, this emphasis on cohesion results in paragraphs of sentences that are formulaic, having been cultivated to follow the same basic patterns.
descriptosaurus-000166.zh: 然而，部分由于 SPAG 测试要求的识别和标记的结果，这种对凝聚力的强调导致了公式化的句子段落，这些句子已经被培养成遵循相同的基本模式。

descriptosaurus-000167.en: Little time and consideration is available for studying and practising how to manipulate and elaborate sentences to create more precise, varied and effective writing.
descriptosaurus-000167.zh: 很少有时间和考虑可以用于研究和练习如何操纵和精心设计句子，以创建更精确、多样性和有效的写作。

descriptosaurus-000168.en: Teaching children how to manipulate sentence structure produces powerful, precise and able writers.
descriptosaurus-000168.zh: 教孩子如何操纵句子结构会产生强大、精确和能干的作家。

descriptosaurus-000169.en: The more they practise, using modelled sentence types, the more fluid their writing will become.
descriptosaurus-000169.zh: 他们练习得越多，使用模拟的句子类型，他们的写作就会变得越流畅。

descriptosaurus-000170.en: They need to be introduced to new vocabulary and literary techniques and given the chance to:
descriptosaurus-000170.zh: 他们需要了解新的词汇和文学技巧，并有机会：

descriptosaurus-000171.en: Use them repeatedly in context to understand how to use them appropriately.
descriptosaurus-000171.zh: 在具体语境中反复使用，才能学会怎样用得恰当。

descriptosaurus-000173.en: Experiment with different sentence structures and length to evaluate the effect on the quality of their writing, not merely complete an exercise in a textbook where they have to choose the appropriate conjunction to make a compound sentence.
descriptosaurus-000173.zh: 尝试不同的句子结构和长短，看看它们如何影响文章质量；别只做课本上那种选一个合适的连词组成并列复合句的练习。

descriptosaurus-000177.en: Poetry is an effective way of demonstrating the use of the vocabulary and phrases from Descriptosaurus to model the various target sentence structures.
descriptosaurus-000177.zh: 诗歌是演示描述龙使用词汇和短语来模拟各种目标句子结构的有效方式。

descriptosaurus-000178.en: This enables pupils to approach the task in small, manageable steps, and to focus on:
descriptosaurus-000178.zh: 这使学生能够以小而可管理的步骤处理任务，并专注于：

descriptosaurus-000182.en: Poetry is also an excellent form to focus on impact rather than merely cohesion.
descriptosaurus-000182.zh: 诗歌也是关注影响而不仅仅是凝聚力的绝佳形式。

descriptosaurus-000183.en: The new edition includes a number of poems that I have developed as a starting point, but the process can be used with any poetic structure being studied.
descriptosaurus-000183.zh: 新版本包括我作为起点开发的许多诗歌，但该过程可以用于任何正在研究的诗意结构。

descriptosaurus-000185.en: Once the poem is complete, the next stage is to provide a model of the target sentence structure and give children time to experiment with inserting combinations of the vocabulary they have chosen.
descriptosaurus-000185.zh: 一旦诗歌完成，下一阶段是提供一个目标句子结构的模型，让孩子们有时间尝试插入他们选择的词汇组合。

descriptosaurus-000186.en: These poems and sentence models can, therefore, be used not only to practise the target structure but also to manipulate and elaborate it, and to consider the impact on meaning and effect.
descriptosaurus-000186.zh: 因此，这些诗歌和句子模型不仅可以用于实践目标结构，还可以用于操纵和阐述它，并考虑对意义和效果的影响。

descriptosaurus-000187.en: While imitating sentence patterns children also become aware of punctuation.
descriptosaurus-000187.zh: 在模仿句子模式的同时，孩子们也会意识到标点符号。

descriptosaurus-000188.zh: 第 5 部分包括建模的句子结构。

descriptosaurus-000189.en: These have been split into three sections: Detail, Flow, Impact (DFI).
descriptosaurus-000189.zh: 这些示范句型分成三部分：细节（Detail）、行文流动（Flow）和感染力（Impact），简称 DFI。

descriptosaurus-000191.en: assigned beginner, intermediate and advanced labels to the models rather than year group, as a pupil who has not mastered compound sentences will find it difficult to access a model on how to use subordination.
descriptosaurus-000191.zh: 将初学者、中级和高级标签分配给模型而不是年级组，因为没有掌握复合句子的学生将发现很难获得有关如何使用从属的模型。

descriptosaurus-000192.en: Likewise, a child who has absorbed advanced sentence structures from their independent reading should have the opportunity to experiment with that structure, but with the support of a modelled sentence that demonstrates the correct structure and punctuation.
descriptosaurus-000192.zh: 同样，从独立阅读中吸收高级句子结构的孩子应该有机会尝试这种结构，但在模型句子的支持下，证明了正确的结构和标点符号。

descriptosaurus-000193.en: The website also includes display cards for each of the sentences to facilitate demonstration and discussion.
descriptosaurus-000193.zh: 该网站还包括每个句子的展示卡，以方便演示和讨论。

descriptosaurus-000194.en: In addition, each sentence has been split into individual word flash cards for sentence construction and manipulation.
descriptosaurus-000194.zh: 此外，每个句子都被分成单独的单词闪存卡，用于句子构造和操作。

descriptosaurus-000196.en: For many years, I have been frustrated that a final piece of creative writing never seems to match up to the fantastic, imaginative ideas for a story that pupils are able to articulate during the initial brainstorming session.
descriptosaurus-000196.zh: 多年来，我一直很沮丧，因为最后一篇创意写作似乎永远无法与学生在最初的头脑风暴会议中表达的故事相匹配的奇妙、富有想象力的想法。

descriptosaurus-000197.en: I have tried many different methods of planning to try to remedy this situation, and whilst I found that there was more evidence of these ideas being included in the story, the problem of maintaining the threads of the story, the creativity and descriptive language remained.
descriptosaurus-000197.zh: 我尝试了许多不同的计划方法来尝试纠正这种情况，虽然我发现故事中包含了更多的这些想法，但保持故事线索的问题仍然存在，创造力和描述性语言仍然存在。

descriptosaurus-000198.en: A method that proved to be very successful was to take sections of the story and write action frames.
descriptosaurus-000198.zh: 一种被证明非常成功的方法是截取故事的一部分并编写动作框架。

descriptosaurus-000199.en: This can be done for the pupils’ own writing or from a class text.
descriptosaurus-000199.zh: 这可以为学生自己的写作或课堂文本完成。

descriptosaurus-000200.en: Breaking the frame down into a series of movements and reactions enables pupils to describe the scene more effectively and in detail, but also to apply the skills they have previously learned in respect of grammar.
descriptosaurus-000200.zh: 将框架分解成一系列动作和反应，使学生能够更有效、更详细地描述场景，同时也可以应用他们以前在语法方面学到的技能。

descriptosaurus-000201.en: In addition, this exercise also facilitates the inclusion of discussion and drama.
descriptosaurus-000201.zh: 此外，这个练习还有助于将讨论和戏剧纳入其中。

descriptosaurus-000202.en: An example is included using a wolf chase, which can be combined with the resources for ‘Little Red Riding Hood’.
descriptosaurus-000202.zh: 一个例子包括使用狼追逐，它可以与“小红帽”的资源相结合。

descriptosaurus-000203.en: To demonstrate how part of a class text can be taken as a writing stimulus, a scene from The Silver Sword by Ian Serrailler is included on the website.
descriptosaurus-000203.zh: 为了展示如何将部分课文作为写作刺激，网站上包含了伊恩·塞拉勒 (Ian Serrailler) 的银剑中的场景。

descriptosaurus-000205.en: Applying and combining the sentences for flow and impact are also essential skills.
descriptosaurus-000205.zh: 应用和组合句子以进行流动和影响也是必不可少的技能。

descriptosaurus-000206.en: To enable pupils to practise this skill, this edition has included a number of S/C-I-R passages for discussion, which have also been broken down into individual sentences for combining into a passage.
descriptosaurus-000206.zh: 为了使学生能够练习这项技能，该版本包含了许多 S/C-I-R 段落进行讨论，这些段落也被分解为单独的句子，以组合成一段话。

descriptosaurus-000207.en: The passages have been designed to provide opportunities for cross-curricular writing.
descriptosaurus-000207.zh: 这些段落旨在为跨课程写作提供机会。

descriptosaurus-000208.en: The current obsession with fronted adverbials is having a negative impact on the quality of creative writing in schools.
descriptosaurus-000208.zh: 当前对正面状语的痴迷对学校的创意写作质量产生了负面影响。

descriptosaurus-000209.en: These S/C-I-R sentences expose pupils to various sentence structures, lengths and openers; enable them to discuss how to develop the sentences into a descriptive passage using various techniques that have been studied as part of the grammar curriculum; experiment with the techniques, and discuss the results in terms of flow and impact.
descriptosaurus-000209.zh: 这些 S/C-I-R 句子使学生接触到各种句子结构、长度和开头； 使他们能够讨论如何使用已作为语法课程的一部分研究的各种技术将句子发展成描述性段落； 试验这些技术，并根据流量和影响讨论结果。

descriptosaurus-000210.en: These exercises embed the grammar being studied and enable pupils to master the concepts in context.
descriptosaurus-000210.zh: 这些练习包含正在研究的语法，使学生能够在上下文中掌握概念。

descriptosaurus-000212.en: It is important that we do not lose sight of the fact that children need to be able to use grammar as a tool to help them improve their writing.
descriptosaurus-000212.zh: 重要的是，我们不要忽视儿童需要能够使用语法作为帮助他们提高写作的工具这一事实。

descriptosaurus-000213.en: By actively noting new vocabulary and phrases gleaned from their independent and class reading, writing down key sentence patterns, highlighting punctuation, and storing them in a writing journal, children will eventually have all the tools they need when they find their own voice.
descriptosaurus-000213.zh: 通过积极记录从独立和课堂阅读中收集的新词汇和短语，写下关键的句子模式，突出标点符号，并将它们存储在写作日记中，孩子们最终将在找到自己的声音时拥有所需的所有工具。

descriptosaurus-000214.en: By including these sentence models, as well as providing children with ideas and descriptive vocabulary, I hope to fully engage them with the tasks rather than merely the mechanics of the language; to tap into their imaginations; add colour to their writing by evaluating and experimenting with vocabulary and figurative language, and then frame it by examining the elements of grammar and punctuation.
descriptosaurus-000214.zh: 通过包括这些句子模型，以及为孩子们提供想法和描述性词汇，我希望将他们完全参与到任务中，而不仅仅是语言的机制； 挖掘他们的想象力； 通过评估和实验词汇和比喻语言为他们的写作增添色彩，然后通过检查语法和标点符号的元素来构建它。

descriptosaurus-000216.en: should be an holistic experience rather than a functional, formulaic, technique-gathering exercise.
descriptosaurus-000216.zh: 应该是一种整体体验，而不是功能性的、公式化的、技术聚集的练习。

descriptosaurus-000219.en: Descriptosaurus is a new and innovative model of creative writing that is a thematic expansion of a dictionary and a thesaurus.
descriptosaurus-000219.zh: Descriptasaurus 是一种新的、创新的创意写作模式，是字典和词库的主题扩展。

descriptosaurus-000220.en: To be creative when writing, it is first necessary to have the requisite knowledge and skills: the vocabulary to describe and the structure to organise ideas.
descriptosaurus-000220.zh: 要在写作时要有创意，首先需要具备必要的知识和技能：描述的词汇和组织想法的结构。

descriptosaurus-000221.en: Descriptosaurus provides children with a comprehensive resource to help them expand their descriptive vocabulary, experiment with language and sentence structure and build up narratives based around the following areas:
descriptosaurus-000221.zh: Descriptasaurus 为儿童提供了全面的资源，以帮助他们扩展描述性词汇，尝试语言和句子结构，并基于以下领域建立叙述：

descriptosaurus-000222.zh: 设置 – 景观、定居点和大气

descriptosaurus-000224.zh: 生物——外观、能力和栖息地。

descriptosaurus-000225.en: A dictionary teaches children the meaning of words and a thesaurus expands their vocabulary.
descriptosaurus-000225.zh: 字典教孩子单词的含义，词库扩大了他们的词汇量。

descriptosaurus-000226.en: Descriptosaurus teaches them how to describe a setting using their senses; how to describe a character using expressions, voice and movement, to add detail, depth and colour to their writing.
descriptosaurus-000226.zh: 描述龙教他们如何用他们的感官描述一个环境； 如何用表达、声音和动作来描述角色，为他们的写作增添细节、深度和色彩。

descriptosaurus-000227.en: It positions the words – whether for appearance, expression, landscape, smell or sound – classifies them as nouns, adjectives and verbs, zooms in to examine their meaning and then expands them into phrases and sentences.
descriptosaurus-000227.zh: 它定位单词——无论是外观、表达、景观、气味还是声音——将它们分类为名词、形容词和动词，放大以检查它们的含义，然后将它们扩展为短语和句子。

descriptosaurus-000228.en: It shows how they can be used and provides alternative sentence structures.
descriptosaurus-000228.zh: 它显示了如何使用它们并提供替代的句子结构。

descriptosaurus-000229.en: The model was created – and continues to evolve, with additional components and models being added to each new edition – as a result of feedback from children about the resources they require to inspire and assist them with their writing.
descriptosaurus-000229.zh: 该模型是创建的——并将继续发展，在每个新版本中添加了额外的组件和模型——这是因为孩子们对他们需要的资源来激发和帮助他们写作。

descriptosaurus-000231.en: For reluctant writers or those faced with the ‘blank page syndrome,’ Descriptosaurus provides invaluable starting points to encourage putting pen to paper.
descriptosaurus-000231.zh: 对于不情愿的作家或那些面临“空白页综合症”的人来说，Descriptasaurus 提供了宝贵的起点来鼓励将笔放在纸上。

descriptosaurus-000232.en: Alison Wilcox has extensive teaching experience in schools in England and Scotland.
descriptosaurus-000232.zh: Alison Wilcox 在英格兰和苏格兰的学校拥有丰富的教学经验。

descriptosaurus-000233.en: Colleagues describe her methods as ‘innovative and inspirational to even the most reluctant of writers.’ She is also the author of the Descriptosaurus genre series, which includes Action & Adventure, Ghost Stories, Myths & Legends and Fantasy.
descriptosaurus-000233.zh: 同事们将她的方法描述为“即使是最不情愿的作家，也具有创新性和鼓舞力”。她也是描述龙类型系列的作者，该系列包括动作与冒险、鬼故事、神话与传说和幻想。

descriptosaurus-000234.en: In addition to writing, Alison continues to work for periods as a full-time teacher, and has collaborated with the National Literacy Trust on two very successful creative writing competitions.
descriptosaurus-000234.zh: 除了写作之外，艾莉森还继续担任全职教师，并与国家扫盲信托基金合作举办了两项非常成功的创意写作比赛。

descriptosaurus-000235.zh: 为什么描述性写作很重要？

descriptosaurus-000236.en: The importance of children being able to express their ideas using good descriptive language is widely accepted, not just for creative writing, but also for non-fiction.
descriptosaurus-000236.zh: 儿童能够使用良好的描述性语言表达他们的想法的重要性被广泛接受，不仅对于创意写作，而且对于非小说类也是如此。

descriptosaurus-000237.en: Developing descriptive language to communicate effectively is an essential tool across the curriculum.
descriptosaurus-000237.zh: 开发描述性语言以有效沟通是整个课程的重要工具。

descriptosaurus-000238.en: History is concerned not merely with dates and facts, but with describing and interpreting past events.
descriptosaurus-000238.zh: 历史不仅关注日期和事实，还关注描述和解释过去的事件。

descriptosaurus-000239.en: In Geography, children need to be able to describe the world around them.
descriptosaurus-000239.zh: 在地理上，孩子需要能够描述他们周围的世界。

descriptosaurus-000240.en: In Science, they need to observe carefully and then be capable of describing what is happening in an experiment.
descriptosaurus-000240.zh: 在科学中，他们需要仔细观察，然后能够描述实验中正在发生的事情。

descriptosaurus-000241.en: In all areas of the curriculum, children need the vocabulary to enable them to describe and interpret.
descriptosaurus-000241.zh: 在课程的所有领域，孩子都需要词汇来描述和解释。

descriptosaurus-000242.en: To be able to describe effectively, we first need to be taught how to look and listen.
descriptosaurus-000242.zh: 为了能够有效地描述，我们首先需要被教导如何看待和倾听。

descriptosaurus-000243.en: We need to learn the vocabulary to use in order to express our ideas.
descriptosaurus-000243.zh: 我们需要学习使用的词汇来表达我们的想法。

descriptosaurus-000244.en: As well as encouraging children to use interesting language, Descriptosaurus aims to improve children’s observation skills in both their own environment and their reading.
descriptosaurus-000244.zh: 除了鼓励孩子们使用有趣的语言外，Descriptasaurus 还旨在提高孩子在自己的环境和阅读中的观察能力。

descriptosaurus-000245.en: We describe sights and events differently because we see and interpret things differently.
descriptosaurus-000245.zh: 我们以不同的方式描述景象和事件，因为我们对事物的看法和解释不同。

descriptosaurus-000246.en: To any situation or piece of writing we bring our own personality, experience and imagination.
descriptosaurus-000246.zh: 对于任何情况或文章，我们都会带来自己的个性、经验和想象力。

descriptosaurus-000247.en: As educators, both parents and teachers, we need to open children’s eyes to the world around them, stimulate their imaginations and sow the seeds of effects that can be achieved in their writing.
descriptosaurus-000247.zh: 作为教育工作者，无论是父母还是教师，我们都需要让孩子们看到周围的世界，激发他们的想象力，播下他们写作中可以实现的效果的种子。

descriptosaurus-000248.en: With the vocabulary, knowledge and understanding of how to use language to achieve depth and colour in their writing, children will grow in confidence and motivation to experiment, find their ‘voice’ and develop their own style of writing.
descriptosaurus-000248.zh: 凭借词汇、知识和对如何使用语言在写作中实现深度和色彩的理解，孩子们将有信心和动力去尝试，找到他们的“声音”并发展自己的写作风格。

descriptosaurus-000250.en: Although the age range for Descriptosaurus is 8–14, it is beneficial for older children, or even adults, who need assistance with vocabulary or who who suffer from ‘blank page syndrome’.
descriptosaurus-000250.zh: 尽管描述龙的年龄范围是 8-14 岁，但它对需要词汇量或患有“空白页综合症”的年龄较大的儿童甚至成年人有益。

descriptosaurus-000252.en: Descriptosaurus is a resource that can be used at home or school by pupils, parents and teachers.
descriptosaurus-000252.zh: Descriptosaurus 是一种资源，可供学生、家长和教师在家中或学校使用。

descriptosaurus-000253.en: Although consideration has been given to specific curricula, Descriptosaurus is a general tool applicable to any creative writing syllabus in any territory where there is a desire to improve descriptive writing.
descriptosaurus-000253.zh: 尽管已经考虑了特定的课程，但描述书龙是适用于任何有意改进描述性写作的领域的任何创意写作教学大纲的通用工具。

descriptosaurus-000254.en: Why is Descriptosaurus a Useful Tool for Parents?
descriptosaurus-000254.zh: 为什么描述龙是父母的有用工具？

descriptosaurus-000255.en: We all agree that there is no substitute for reading to improve children’s writing.
descriptosaurus-000255.zh: 我们都同意，阅读可以提高儿童的写作能力。

descriptosaurus-000256.en: However, we live in a world dominated by the moving image, be it television, mobile phones or games consoles.
descriptosaurus-000256.zh: 然而，我们生活在一个以运动图像为主的世界中，无论是电视、手机还是游戏机。

descriptosaurus-000257.en: As a teacher, I have encountered the problems reluctant readers face when challenged to write creatively.
descriptosaurus-000257.zh: 作为一名教师，我遇到了不愿读者在写作时遇到的问题。

descriptosaurus-000258.en: As a parent, I have encountered the problems of developing a ‘reading habit’ at home alongside an obsession to use their fingers to operate a keyboard or console rather than turn a page.
descriptosaurus-000258.zh: 作为家长，我遇到了在家中养成“阅读习惯”的问题，同时又会痴迷于用手指操作键盘或控制台而不是翻页。

descriptosaurus-000259.en: How then can we develop children’s writing when there is a reluctance to read or engage with a text?
descriptosaurus-000259.zh: 那么，当我们不愿阅读或参与文本时，我们如何发展儿童的写作呢？

descriptosaurus-000260.en: The answer is to feed the children’s imaginations with pictures, sounds and games, and use Descriptosaurus to describe what they see, hear, smell, touch.
descriptosaurus-000260.zh: 答案是用图片、声音和游戏来满足孩子们的想象力，并使用描述龙来描述他们所看到、听到、闻到、触摸的内容。

descriptosaurus-000261.en: One of the main rationales for developing the Descriptosaurus model into a book was in response to comments from other parents regarding the advantages enjoyed by my own children having an English teacher as a parent.
descriptosaurus-000261.zh: 将描述龙模型开发成一本书的主要理由之一是回应其他父母对我自己的孩子有英语老师作为父母所享有的优势的评论。

descriptosaurus-000262.en: Parents and teachers have never been under as much pressure as they are today, with the demands of SATS and 11 plus exams to improve writing levels.
descriptosaurus-000262.zh: 家长和老师从未像今天这样承受过大的压力，SAT 和 11 Plus 考试的要求可以提高写作水平。

descriptosaurus-000263.en: Parents felt relatively confident about helping their children with grammar, maths and science because these had rules, a method and a right or wrong answer.
descriptosaurus-000263.zh: 父母对帮助孩子进行语法、数学和科学感到相对自信，因为这些有规则、方法和正确或错误的答案。

descriptosaurus-000264.en: They found creative writing to be very different.
descriptosaurus-000264.zh: 他们发现创意写作非常不同。

descriptosaurus-000265.en: Many of these parents felt that their own descriptive vocabulary was inadequate and thus struggled to assist their children with writing tasks.
descriptosaurus-000265.zh: 这些父母中的许多人认为他们自己的描述性词汇不足，因此难以帮助他们的孩子完成写作任务。

descriptosaurus-000266.en: Not only have I witnessed a marked improvement in the descriptive writing of the children using a Descriptosaurus, I have also noted an increase in confidence in their parents.
descriptosaurus-000266.zh: 我不仅目睹了使用描述龙的描述性写作的显着改善，我还注意到他们对父母的信心增加了。

descriptosaurus-000269.en: When children bring home any piece of writing, the most important assistance a parent can provide is getting them to plan it carefully.
descriptosaurus-000269.zh: 当孩子们把任何一篇文章带回家时，父母可以提供的最重要的帮助就是让他们仔细计划。

descriptosaurus-000270.en: Get the children to mind map words and phrases to answer the questions:
descriptosaurus-000270.zh: 让孩子们记住地图单词和短语来回答问题：

descriptosaurus-000271.en: Who (appearance, personality, and emotions – expressions, voice, body language)
descriptosaurus-000271.zh: 谁（外表、个性和情感——表达、声音、肢体语言）

descriptosaurus-000273.zh: 哪里（感官——视觉、声音、气味、触觉）

descriptosaurus-000274.en: When (atmosphere – time of year or day, weather).
descriptosaurus-000274.zh: 何时（气氛——一年中的时间或一天的时间、天气）。

descriptosaurus-000275.en: Planning sheets, which structure this process, can be downloaded from the companion website at www.routlege.com/cw/wilcox.
descriptosaurus-000275.zh: 可以从配套网站 www.routlege.com/cw/wilcox 下载计划表，以构建此过程。

descriptosaurus-000276.en: Frames for action, and character and setting descriptions, including modelled writing – can be found on the companion website.
descriptosaurus-000276.zh: 可以在配套网站上找到行动框架、角色和设置描述，包括模型写作。

descriptosaurus-000277.en: These frames break the text into bite-size tables, which make it easier to focus on the quality of the writing.
descriptosaurus-000277.zh: 这些框架将文本分解为一口大小的表格，这使得更容易专注于写作的质量。

descriptosaurus-000278.en: ‘How to use this book’ is also a useful guide.
descriptosaurus-000278.zh: “如何使用这本书”也是一个有用的指南。

descriptosaurus-000280.en: This is an opportunity to use the moving image to improve creative writing.
descriptosaurus-000280.zh: 这是一个使用运动图像来改进创意写作的机会。

descriptosaurus-000281.en: Watch a film together and examine how:

descriptosaurus-000282.en: atmosphere and suspense are achieved using

descriptosaurus-000284.en: the body language and tone of a character is used to express their emotions.
descriptosaurus-000284.zh: 角色的肢体语言和语气用于表达他们的情绪。

descriptosaurus-000286.en: Making the Most of Journeys or Family Leisure Time
descriptosaurus-000286.zh: 充分利用旅程或家庭休闲时间

descriptosaurus-000287.en: When embarking on a journey, use the following as boredom busters.
descriptosaurus-000287.zh: 踏上旅程时，请将以下内容用作无聊的克星。

descriptosaurus-000288.en: Audio books are a great way of passing the time and develop descriptive vocabulary and discussion.
descriptosaurus-000288.zh: 有声读物是打发时间和发展描述性词汇和讨论的好方法。

descriptosaurus-000290.en: Use a sentence from the Prompt Cards section for a game of ‘What happened next?
descriptosaurus-000290.zh: 使用提示卡部分中的一个句子进行“接下来发生了什么？

descriptosaurus-000292.en: ’ or ‘Where is it?’ Each player can take it in turns to contribute an idea to each of the questions.
descriptosaurus-000292.zh: ’或‘它在哪里？’每个玩家可以轮流为每个问题贡献一个想法。

descriptosaurus-000293.en: The benefit of sharing ideas, imaginations and discussion should not be underestimated.
descriptosaurus-000293.zh: 分享思想、想象力和讨论的好处不应被低估。

descriptosaurus-000294.en: Children can also be encouraged to create their own Prompt Cards and questions.
descriptosaurus-000294.zh: 还可以鼓励孩子们自己制作自己的卡片和问题。

descriptosaurus-000295.en: The alternative version of ‘I Spy’ on the companion website is a great, fun way of improving children’s vocabulary.
descriptosaurus-000295.zh: 伴侣网站上的“我间谍”的替代版本是提高儿童词汇的一种很棒、有趣的方式。

descriptosaurus-000297.en: Playing ‘I Can’ helps improve children’s understanding of how using senses in their descriptive writing can dramatically improve the quality of their work.
descriptosaurus-000297.zh: 玩“我可以”有助于提高孩子们对在描述性写作中使用感官的理解如何显着提高他们的工作质量。

descriptosaurus-000299.en: The ‘Character Profile’ cards can be used to create interesting and even bizarre characters.
descriptosaurus-000299.zh: “角色配置文件”卡片可用于创建有趣甚至奇怪的角色。

descriptosaurus-000301.en: When stuck in a traffic jam, an amusing game to pass the time is to make up character profiles for the occupants of neighbouring vehicles.
descriptosaurus-000301.zh: 当被堵在交通堵塞中时，一个有趣的游戏来打发时间是为邻近车辆的乘客编造角色档案。

descriptosaurus-000304.en: What are they going to do?

descriptosaurus-000306.en: What sort of house do they live in?
descriptosaurus-000306.zh: 他们住在什么样的房子里？

descriptosaurus-000307.zh: 他们有什么有趣的地方？

descriptosaurus-000308.en: Are they famous, a secret agent, etc.?
descriptosaurus-000308.zh: 他们是出名的，是秘密特工等吗？

descriptosaurus-000310.en: This is a good way of getting children to notice body language.
descriptosaurus-000310.zh: 这是让孩子注意肢体语言的好方法。

descriptosaurus-000311.en: For example, are they drumming their fingers on the steering wheel?
descriptosaurus-000311.zh: 例如，他们是否在方向盘上敲打手指？

descriptosaurus-000313.en: Collect photos, postcards, leaflets, travel brochures, pictures from newspapers and magazines.
descriptosaurus-000313.zh: 收集照片、明信片、传单、旅行手册、报纸和杂志的照片。

descriptosaurus-000314.en: Make an album of old photos.
descriptosaurus-000314.zh: 制作一张旧照片的相册。

descriptosaurus-000315.en: Instead of listing where the photo was taken, who is in the picture – describe the scene.
descriptosaurus-000315.zh: 而不是列出照片中的拍摄地点，而是照片中的谁——描述场景。

descriptosaurus-000316.en: There may be an opportunity here to practise using dialogue by imagining what the people in the photos are thinking or what they are saying to each other.
descriptosaurus-000316.zh: 这里可能有机会通过想象照片中的人在想什么或他们在说什么来练习使用对话。

descriptosaurus-000317.en: Use cuttings and leaflets to produce a scrap album.
descriptosaurus-000317.zh: 使用插条和传单制作废品专辑。

descriptosaurus-000318.en: Collect a list of words and phrases to describe the settings and characters.
descriptosaurus-000318.zh: 收集单词和短语列表来描述设置和字符。

descriptosaurus-000319.en: The companion website includes a number of additional elements, ideas, frameworks and models to assist with the description of setting and character:
descriptosaurus-000319.zh: 配套网站包括一些附加元素、想法、框架和模型，以帮助描述设置和字符：

descriptosaurus-000320.en: Tour Guide demonstrates how to develop a description of a setting.
descriptosaurus-000320.zh: 导游演示如何开发设置的描述。

descriptosaurus-000321.en: Missing Person demonstrates how to develop a description of a character.
descriptosaurus-000321.zh: 失踪人员演示如何开发角色的描述。

descriptosaurus-000323.en: See also Guess the Portrait in the ‘Games’ section of the companion website.
descriptosaurus-000323.zh: 另请参阅配套网站“游戏”部分中的“猜测”肖像。

descriptosaurus-000325.en: These can be played at home and are great fun.
descriptosaurus-000325.zh: 这些可以在家里玩，很有趣。

descriptosaurus-000327.en: Many parents receive feedback that to improve their writing their children need to use conjunctions.
descriptosaurus-000327.zh: 许多家长收到反馈，即为了提高他们的写作能力，他们的孩子需要使用连词。

descriptosaurus-000328.en: For many, this has proved a minefield.
descriptosaurus-000328.zh: 对于许多人来说，这已被证明是一个雷区。

descriptosaurus-000329.en: Model sentences have been included for each element, and the companion website includes the sentences on individual display cards and on flash cards, where each sentence has been broken down into individual words.
descriptosaurus-000329.zh: 每个元素都包含了模型句子，配套网站包括单个显示卡和闪存卡上的句子，其中每个句子都被分解为单个单词。

descriptosaurus-000332.en: When planning a piece of creative writing, use planning sheets, mind maps, etc. to collate words and phrases to answer the questions:
descriptosaurus-000332.zh: 在计划一篇创意写作时，请使用计划表、思维导图等来整理单词和短语以回答问题：

descriptosaurus-000333.en: Who (appearance, personality, and emotions – expressions, voice, body language)
descriptosaurus-000333.zh: 谁（外表、个性和情感——表达、声音、肢体语言）

descriptosaurus-000335.zh: 哪里（感官——视觉、声音、气味、触觉）

descriptosaurus-000336.en: When (atmosphere – time of year or day, weather).
descriptosaurus-000336.zh: 何时（气氛——一年中的时间或一天的时间、天气）。

descriptosaurus-000337.en: For more ideas go to the following sections on the companion website:
descriptosaurus-000337.zh: 有关更多想法，请访问 Companion 网站上的以下部分：

descriptosaurus-000338.en: Writing tips to build atmosphere, tension and suspense
descriptosaurus-000338.zh: 营造氛围、紧张和悬念的写作技巧

descriptosaurus-000339.en: Hooks to build interest and tension
descriptosaurus-000339.zh: 建立兴趣和紧张的钩子

descriptosaurus-000344.en: Creature description using the opening of The Iron Man
descriptosaurus-000344.zh: 使用钢铁侠开口的生物描述

descriptosaurus-000350.en: Action frames, description frames for setting and character (these include a model, outline and blank forms).
descriptosaurus-000350.zh: 动作框架、用于设置和字符的描述框架（这些框架包括模型、轮廓和空白表单）。

descriptosaurus-000353.en: Take a traditional tale, such as ‘Red Riding Hood’, in which the structure is already in place, and get the children to fill in the descriptive detail.
descriptosaurus-000353.zh: 以传统的故事为例，例如“红帽”，其中结构已经到位，让孩子们填写描述性的细节。

descriptosaurus-000354.en: Detailed lessons plans are included in ‘Lessons plans for descriptive writing’ on the companion website.
descriptosaurus-000354.zh: 详细的课程计划包含在配套网站上的“描述性写作课程计划”中。

descriptosaurus-000355.en: Part 5 of the book has been based on a wolf chase to demonstrate how a basic story can be innovated.
descriptosaurus-000355.zh: 这本书的第 5 部分是基于狼的追逐来展示如何创新一个基本的故事。

descriptosaurus-000356.en: Myths and legends can be used in much the same way.
descriptosaurus-000356.zh: 神话和传说可以以同样的方式使用。

descriptosaurus-000357.en: For example, the journey through the tunnel to meet the Minotaur.
descriptosaurus-000357.zh: 例如，穿过隧道的旅程与牛头怪相遇。

descriptosaurus-000358.en: Resources for developing a creature description are included in the companion website.
descriptosaurus-000358.zh: 用于开发生物描述的资源包含在配套网站中。

descriptosaurus-000359.en: They include a poem, plan, vocabulary bank, and a model of how to incorporate the description in the structure of an existing text.
descriptosaurus-000359.zh: 它们包括诗歌、计划、词汇库以及如何将描述纳入现有文本结构的模型。

descriptosaurus-000360.en: The Coming of the Rhinogasaurus uses the opening from Ted Hughes’ The Iron Man.
descriptosaurus-000360.zh: 鼻翼龙的到来使用了泰德·休斯的《钢铁侠》的开口。

descriptosaurus-000362.en: The alternative version of ‘I Spy’ on the companion website is a great, fun way of improving children’s vocabulary.
descriptosaurus-000362.zh: 伴侣网站上的“我间谍”的替代版本是提高儿童词汇的一种很棒、有趣的方式。

descriptosaurus-000364.en: Playing ‘I Can’ helps improve children’s understanding of how using senses in their descriptive writing can dramatically improve the quality of their work.
descriptosaurus-000364.zh: 玩“我可以”有助于提高孩子们对在描述性写作中使用感官的理解如何显着提高他们的工作质量。

descriptosaurus-000366.en: Use a sentence from the Prompt Cards section for a game of ‘What happened next?’ or ‘Where is it?’ Children can also be encouraged to create their own
descriptosaurus-000366.zh: 使用提示卡部分中的一个句子“接下来发生了什么？”或“它在哪里？”也可以鼓励孩子们创建自己的游戏

descriptosaurus-000368.en: Prompt Cards are designed to stimulate and aid creative writing, and encourage the inclusion of a range of senses in description.
descriptosaurus-000368.zh: 提示卡旨在刺激和帮助创意写作，并鼓励在描述中包含一系列感官。

descriptosaurus-000369.en: The questions scaffold the structure and description.

descriptosaurus-000370.en: The benefit of the Prompt Cards is that they can be used as a quick-fire verbal planning burst or for modelling, but also as a piece of descriptive writing, a poem or to scaffold a story.
descriptosaurus-000370.zh: 即时卡片的好处是它们可以用作快速口头计划爆发或建模，还可以用作描述性写作、诗歌或故事的脚手架。

descriptosaurus-000371.en: They are designed to stimulate children’s imagination by getting them to consider a number of different settings and atmosphere – use their senses to build a detailed picture of the setting and create different scenarios and characters that could apply to the sentence prompt.
descriptosaurus-000371.zh: 它们旨在通过让孩子们考虑许多不同的环境和氛围来激发孩子们的想象力——用他们的感官来构建环境的详细图片，并创建可以应用于句子提示的不同场景和字符。

descriptosaurus-000372.en: If the children need help with ideas or vocabulary, they can use the main Descriptosaurus text to assist them.
descriptosaurus-000372.zh: 如果孩子们在想法或词汇方面需要帮助，他们可以使用主要的描述龙文本来帮助他们。

descriptosaurus-000373.en: The same technique can be used with the sentences in Hooks (companion website).
descriptosaurus-000373.zh: 同样的技术可以与 Hooks 中的句子（Companion 网站）一起使用。

descriptosaurus-000375.en: Pick a sentence from the Character Profile Cards.
descriptosaurus-000375.zh: 从角色配置文件卡片中选择一个句子。

descriptosaurus-000376.en: Centre it in a mind map and develop a profile.
descriptosaurus-000376.zh: 将其放在思维导图中并开发个人资料。

descriptosaurus-000379.en: Give the children a number of Setting and Atmosphere Cards.
descriptosaurus-000379.zh: 给孩子一些设置和氛围卡片。

descriptosaurus-000380.en: Challenge them to arrange them in pairs by matching a setting card with an atmosphere.
descriptosaurus-000380.zh: 挑战他们通过将设置卡与气氛相匹配来安排他们。

descriptosaurus-000382.en: The Prompt Cards can be combined with the Character Profile Cards and used in a warm-up activity.
descriptosaurus-000382.zh: 提示卡可以与角色配置卡结合使用，并用于热身活动。

descriptosaurus-000383.en: Divide the class into groups and give each group a number of cards.
descriptosaurus-000383.zh: 将班级分成几组，给每组几张牌。

descriptosaurus-000384.en: Set the children the challenge of organising the cards into a story, using the connectives to link the descriptions.
descriptosaurus-000384.zh: 将孩子们组织成一个故事的挑战，使用连接词来链接描述。

descriptosaurus-000386.en: The cards can also be used for an activity for examining sentence structure and also punctuation.
descriptosaurus-000386.zh: 这些卡片还可用于检查句子结构和标点符号的活动。

descriptosaurus-000388.en: Varying the length of the sentences to build tension
descriptosaurus-000388.zh: 改变句子的长度以建立张力

descriptosaurus-000389.en: Changing the sentences so that the children make a series of simple, compound or complex sentences
descriptosaurus-000389.zh: 改变句子，让孩子们做出一系列简单的、复合的或复数的句子

descriptosaurus-000391.en: Changing the order of the sentences.

descriptosaurus-000393.en: We continually reinforce to children the need to ‘show not tell’ when developing their characters.
descriptosaurus-000393.zh: 我们不断地向孩子们强调在发展他们的角色时“不告诉”的需要。

descriptosaurus-000394.en: These are two easy and fun games that can be used to get the children to really think about character traits and use speech, tone of voice, expressions and movement to describe their characters, but also to devise situations where the character’s reaction and their interaction with other characters clearly demonstrates the character’s personality.
descriptosaurus-000394.zh: 这是两个简单而有趣的游戏，可以让孩子们真正思考性格特征并使用语音、语气、表情和动作来描述他们的角色，同时也设计出角色的反应和与其他角色的互动清楚地展示了角色的个性的情况。

descriptosaurus-000395.en: There are six levels and the characters and vocabulary get progressively harder.
descriptosaurus-000395.zh: 有六个级别，角色和词汇变得越来越难。

descriptosaurus-000396.en: The children may need to look up some of the words in a dictionary to find the meaning and an easier synonym.
descriptosaurus-000396.zh: 孩子们可能需要查找字典中的一些单词以找到含义和更简单的同义词。

descriptosaurus-000397.en: The games, therefore, also work as vocabulary builders.
descriptosaurus-000397.zh: 因此，游戏也可以作为词汇构建器。

descriptosaurus-000399.en: These can be completed in groups for different settings and displayed as prompts.
descriptosaurus-000399.zh: 这些可以按组完成不同的设置并显示为提示。

descriptosaurus-000400.en: For example, forests, mountains, beaches, islands, water (sea, river, waterfalls), cities, towns, villages.
descriptosaurus-000400.zh: 例如，森林、山脉、海滩、岛屿、水（海、河、瀑布）、城市、城镇、村庄。

descriptosaurus-000401.en: A–Z lists for nouns, adjectives and verbs.
descriptosaurus-000401.zh: a-z 列出名词、形容词和动词。

descriptosaurus-000402.en: The work on ‘I Can’ can be

descriptosaurus-000403.en: recorded and used to produce these posters.
descriptosaurus-000403.zh: 记录并用于制作这些海报。

descriptosaurus-000404.en: Senses mind map (sight, sounds, smells, touch).
descriptosaurus-000404.zh: 感知思维导图（视觉、声音、气味、触摸）。

descriptosaurus-000406.en: Prompt Cards can be used as planning sheets for this activity.
descriptosaurus-000406.zh: 提示卡可用作此活动的计划表。

descriptosaurus-000408.en: Use the Character Profile Cards to produce:
descriptosaurus-000408.zh: 使用角色配置文件卡片制作：

descriptosaurus-000409.en: A Missing Person poster for a missing hero/heroine.
descriptosaurus-000409.zh: 失踪的英雄/女主角失踪人员海报。

descriptosaurus-000411.en: report form, together with a description frame model, outline and blank form (see companion website), provides a framework, outline and model.
descriptosaurus-000411.zh: 报告表，连同描述框架模型、大纲和空白表格（请参阅配套网站），提供了框架、大纲和模型。

descriptosaurus-000412.en: A Wanted poster for a dangerous criminal.
descriptosaurus-000412.zh: 一个危险罪犯的通缉海报。

descriptosaurus-000413.en: Challenge the children to describe the personality, abilities and exploits of the characters to explain why they need to be found.
descriptosaurus-000413.zh: 挑战孩子们描述角色的个性、能力和功绩，以解释为什么需要找到他们。

descriptosaurus-000414.en: Extension: The characters are in disguise.

descriptosaurus-000415.en: The children now need to think of distinguishing features, voice, movements and gestures in their description.
descriptosaurus-000415.zh: 孩子们现在需要考虑在他们的描述中区分特征、声音、动作和手势。

descriptosaurus-000417.en: Collect a selection of pictures (could be taken from studies in history, space or geography).
descriptosaurus-000417.zh: 收集精选的图片（可以从历史、太空或地理研究中拍摄）。

descriptosaurus-000418.en: Give each pair or group a selection of three/four numbered pictures.
descriptosaurus-000418.zh: 给每对或一组选择三/四个编号的图片。

descriptosaurus-000419.en: Pairs/groups label the pictures with important details that will help identify them.
descriptosaurus-000419.zh: 配对/组用有助于识别它们的重要细节标记图片。

descriptosaurus-000421.en: Using their notes, describe the picture to the rest of the class, who have to guess which of the numbered pictures is being described.
descriptosaurus-000421.zh: 使用他们的笔记，向班上的其他人描述图片，他们必须猜测正在描述哪些编号的图片。

descriptosaurus-000423.en: Extension: Each group adds extra detail to develop a class description of the picture.
descriptosaurus-000423.zh: 扩展：每个组添加额外的细节来开发图片的类描述。

descriptosaurus-000424.en: Portraits: It is also a useful exercise to develop skills in describing characters.
descriptosaurus-000424.zh: 肖像：这也是培养角色描述技能的有用练习。

descriptosaurus-000425.zh: www.npg.org.uk 是一个很好的来源。

descriptosaurus-000427.en: The task for the hero/heroine can be linked to a historical topic.
descriptosaurus-000427.zh: 英雄/女主角的任务可以与历史主题相关联。

descriptosaurus-000428.en: For example, join an expedition to search for an Egyptian tomb.
descriptosaurus-000428.zh: 例如，加入探险队寻找埃及墓葬。

descriptosaurus-000429.en: It can also be linked to a study of legends, where the children can first analyse the personality, abilities of the hero/heroine in the legend and use this information to develop their advert.
descriptosaurus-000429.zh: 它还可以与传说中的研究联系起来，孩子们可以首先分析传说中英雄/女主角的个性，并使用这些信息来发展他们的广告。

descriptosaurus-000430.en: Challenge the children to describe the task and the characteristics required to secure the job.
descriptosaurus-000430.zh: 挑战儿童描述任务和确保工作所需的特征。

descriptosaurus-000431.en: They should also include a description of the setting and the perils likely to be encountered.
descriptosaurus-000431.zh: 它们还应包括对环境的描述和可能遇到的危险。

descriptosaurus-000432.en: Extension: Write a Curriculum Vitae and an accompanying letter asking to be considered for the expedition, task or job.
descriptosaurus-000432.zh: 扩展：写一份简历和一封随附的信件，要求考虑参加探险、任务或工作。

descriptosaurus-000450.zh: 将各个句子组合成动作场景的描述性段落，然后尝试将句子、开头和长度组合的不同方式。

descriptosaurus-000700.zh: 改变句子的类型和长度，使你的写作更多

descriptosaurus-000702.en: There are three main types of sentence, which, when used together, produce different effects and make your writing more interesting.
descriptosaurus-000702.zh: 有三种主要类型的句子，当一起使用时，它们会产生不同的效果，让你的写作更有趣。

descriptosaurus-000704.en: (A clause has a subject and a verb.)

descriptosaurus-000705.en: Example: The forest was cloaked in mist.

descriptosaurus-000706.en: They are useful because they can create suspense, mystery and excitement.
descriptosaurus-000706.zh: 它们很有用，因为它们可以产生悬念、神秘和兴奋。

descriptosaurus-000707.en: Compound sentence: two or more simple sentences joined by a
descriptosaurus-000707.zh: 复合句：两个或多个简单的句子

descriptosaurus-000708.en: conjunction (and, or, but, so, for, yet), or separated by a comma, semi-colon (;) or colon (:).
descriptosaurus-000708.zh: 连词（AND，OR，但是，SO，FOR），或用逗号，分号（;）或冒号（：）分隔。

descriptosaurus-000709.en: Too many simple sentences can make your writing sound very jerky and boring to read.
descriptosaurus-000709.zh: 太多简单的句子会使你的写作听起来非常生涩和无聊。

descriptosaurus-000710.en: Example: The forest was a dark, tangled maze.
descriptosaurus-000710.zh: 示例：森林是一个黑暗、纠结的迷宫。

descriptosaurus-000711.en: It was impossible to find a way through.

descriptosaurus-000712.en: The dead branches rose up out of the mist.

descriptosaurus-000713.en: They grasped her ankles like bony fingers.
descriptosaurus-000713.zh: 他们像骨头的手指一样抓住她的脚踝。

descriptosaurus-000714.en: It is important to join sentences together to add variety and make your writing flow.
descriptosaurus-000714.zh: 将句子结合在一起以增加多样性并使您的写作流程非常重要。

descriptosaurus-000715.en: If we join some of these simple sentences together, the writing will flow more easily.
descriptosaurus-000715.zh: 如果我们将这些简单的句子中的一些结合在一起，写作会更容易流动。

descriptosaurus-000718.zh: 复杂句：有一个或多个从属

descriptosaurus-000719.zh: 子句（信息添加到主子句，但本身没有意义）。

descriptosaurus-000755.zh: 树枝像生锈的铰链一样扭曲和磨碎。

descriptosaurus-000756.en: Like some prehistoric beast, the huge, twisted limbs of the tree guarded the entrance.
descriptosaurus-000756.zh: 像一些史前野兽一样，树上巨大的扭曲的四肢守卫着入口。

descriptosaurus-000757.en: Pressing in on her from all sides, it seemed that the forest was trying to trap her in its thorny grasp.
descriptosaurus-000757.zh: 从四面八方压在她身上，似乎森林正试图将她困在棘手的手中。

descriptosaurus-000758.en: As it drifted through the forest, the fog made eerie shapes and shadows.
descriptosaurus-000758.zh: 当它在森林中漂流时，雾形成了怪异的形状和阴影。

descriptosaurus-000759.en: Cloaked in mist, the trees looked like ghostly, stooped figures.
descriptosaurus-000759.zh: 笼罩在迷雾中的树木，看起来像幽灵般的，弯腰的人物。

descriptosaurus-000760.en: ‘She was trapped in a thick, dark forest’ could now become:
descriptosaurus-000760.zh: “她被困在一片茂密的黑暗森林中”现在可能会变成：

descriptosaurus-000761.en: The forest was cloaked in mist.

descriptosaurus-000763.en: She was surrounded by a thick jungle of tangled trees, gnarled branches and thorns.
descriptosaurus-000763.zh: 她四周是一片浓密的丛林，树木交缠，枝条虬曲，荆棘密布。

descriptosaurus-000764.en: They had spread and twisted together.
descriptosaurus-000764.zh: 他们已经蔓延并扭曲在一起。

descriptosaurus-000765.en: It was impossible to find a way through.

descriptosaurus-000767.en: The thorns grasped at her ankles.

descriptosaurus-000768.en: They tore at her arms and legs.
descriptosaurus-000768.zh: 他们撕裂了她的胳膊和腿。

descriptosaurus-000770.en: The forest was cloaked in mist and she was trapped and surrounded by a thick jungle of tangled trees, gnarled branches and thorns, which had spread and twisted together, so it was impossible to find a way through and, as she tried to pass, the thorns grasped at her ankles and tore at her arms and legs.
descriptosaurus-000770.zh: 森林被迷雾笼罩，她被一片茂密的丛林丛林、粗糙的树枝和荆棘包围着，这些树枝和荆棘已经蔓延并扭曲在一起，所以不可能找到路，当她试图通过时，荆棘抓住了她的脚踝。 撕裂她的胳膊和腿。

descriptosaurus-000772.en: Cloaked in mist, the trees were like ghostly, prehistoric creatures.
descriptosaurus-000772.zh: 笼罩在迷雾中的树木就像幽灵般的史前生物。

descriptosaurus-000773.en: It was impossible to find a way through.

descriptosaurus-000774.en: She was trapped in a thick jungle of tangled trees, gnarled branches and thorns that had spread and twisted together.
descriptosaurus-000774.zh: 她被困在一片茂密的丛林里；树木交缠，虬曲的枝条和荆棘四下蔓延，扭结在一起。

descriptosaurus-000775.en: Grasping at her as she tried to pass, they tore at her arms and legs, clutching her in their thorny grasp.
descriptosaurus-000775.zh: 当她试图通过时，他们抓着她，撕扯着她的胳膊和腿，抓住她的棘手抓握。

descriptosaurus-000776.en: Which one is easiest to read and paints the best picture?
descriptosaurus-000776.zh: 哪一种最容易阅读和描绘最好的画面？

descriptosaurus-000778.en: The key to good writing is careful planning.
descriptosaurus-000778.zh: 写得好的关键是精心策划。

descriptosaurus-000779.en: When thinking about who, when and where, using Descriptosaurus will give you ideas and vocabulary to:
descriptosaurus-000779.zh: 在考虑谁、何时何地使用描述龙时，您将为您提供以下想法和词汇：

descriptosaurus-000780.en: use your senses to paint a vivid picture of your setting – sights, sounds, smells and touch
descriptosaurus-000780.zh: 用你的感官描绘你的环境的生动画面——景象、声音、气味和触觉

descriptosaurus-000782.en: describe a character using appearance, voice, movement and emotions.
descriptosaurus-000782.zh: 使用外表、声音、动作和情感来描述角色。

descriptosaurus-000980.en: Shone with patches of misty light
descriptosaurus-000980.zh: 闪耀着一片雾霾的光芒

descriptosaurus-000981.en: Painted the ground with flickering shadows
descriptosaurus-000981.zh: 用闪烁的阴影画了地面

descriptosaurus-000982.en: Branches spread and twisted together like a prehistoric beast
descriptosaurus-000982.zh: 树枝像史前野兽一样展开和扭曲在一起

descriptosaurus-000984.en: Thorns knotted amongst the trees and bushes
descriptosaurus-000984.zh: 树丛和灌木丛中的荆棘

descriptosaurus-000985.en: Twisted and grated against each other like rusty hinges

descriptosaurus-000993.en: Tore at their arms and legs

descriptosaurus-000996.en: Trapped her in its thorny grasp
descriptosaurus-000996.zh: 将她困在棘手的抓握中

descriptosaurus-000998.en: The majestic trees stood tall and proud.
descriptosaurus-000998.zh: 雄伟的树木高大而自豪。

descriptosaurus-000999.en: The trees were joined together like a crowd of vivid green umbrellas.
descriptosaurus-000999.zh: 树木像一群生动的绿色雨伞连接在一起。

descriptosaurus-001000.en: The magnificent trees flung their branches up to the sun to frame the deep blue sky.
descriptosaurus-001000.zh: 壮丽的树木将它们的树枝扔向太阳，勾勒出深蓝色的天空。

descriptosaurus-001001.en: A white blanket of snowdrops danced on gusts of frosty air.
descriptosaurus-001001.zh: 一片白色的雪花莲在冰冷的空气中跳舞。

descriptosaurus-001002.en: They were welcomed by wave after wave of the gently nodding heads of daffodils.
descriptosaurus-001002.zh: 他们受到了轻轻点头的水仙花的一波又一波的欢迎。

descriptosaurus-001003.en: The ground was painted with red poppies and yellow gorse.
descriptosaurus-001003.zh: 地上涂上了红色罂粟花和黄色的金雀花。

descriptosaurus-001004.en: The hedge was alive with splashes of red and orange berries.
descriptosaurus-001004.zh: 树篱充满了红色和橙色的浆果。

descriptosaurus-001005.en: Hanging from every branch were icicles that glistened like liquid diamonds.
descriptosaurus-001005.zh: 挂在每个树枝上的冰柱都像液态钻石一样闪闪发光。

descriptosaurus-001006.en: The branches swayed to the rhythm of the wind and their leaves fluttered like graceful butterflies.
descriptosaurus-001006.zh: 树枝随着风的节奏摇晃，叶子像优雅的蝴蝶一样飘扬。

descriptosaurus-001007.en: The petals had been shaken off the bush and lay like a carpet of pink confetti on the floor.
descriptosaurus-001007.zh: 花瓣从灌木丛中摇晃，像地板上的粉红色纸屑一样铺在地毯上。

descriptosaurus-001008.en: As they entered the wood, they were greeted by the bowed heads of a blazing carpet of bluebells.
descriptosaurus-001008.zh: 当他们进入树林时，他们被一片炽热的风信子地毯低着头迎接。

descriptosaurus-001009.en: It was impossible to move quickly through the spidery tangle of trees and bushes.
descriptosaurus-001009.zh: 无法快速穿过树木和灌木的蜘蛛般的缠结。

descriptosaurus-001010.en: The brambles and thorns tore at their arms and legs.
descriptosaurus-001010.zh: 荆棘和荆棘撕裂了他们的胳膊和腿。

descriptosaurus-001011.en: The forest floor was a writhing carpet of buzzing, crawling insects.
descriptosaurus-001011.zh: 森林地面是一块扭动的地毯，里面堆满了嗡嗡作响的爬行的昆虫。

descriptosaurus-001012.en: An eerie, greenish gloom filled the clearing.
descriptosaurus-001012.zh: 一股诡异的绿色阴影充满了空地。

descriptosaurus-001013.en: Patches of misty light shone through the gaps in the trees.
descriptosaurus-001013.zh: 一片雾气的光芒透过树林的缝隙照进来。

descriptosaurus-001014.en: The leaves glowed in the early morning light like hundreds of tiny hands.
descriptosaurus-001014.zh: 叶子在清晨的光线中像数百只小手一样发光。

descriptosaurus-001015.en: The bonfire blazed in the background.

descriptosaurus-001016.en: A thousand flickering shadows painted the ground.
descriptosaurus-001016.zh: 一千个闪烁的阴影画在地上。

descriptosaurus-001017.en: Rotting leaves hid the roots that wriggled across the ground.
descriptosaurus-001017.zh: 腐烂的叶子隐藏了在地面上蠕动的根部。

descriptosaurus-001018.en: The forest was a dark, tangled maze and it was impossible to find a way through.
descriptosaurus-001018.zh: 森林是一个黑暗、纠结的迷宫，不可能找到一条路。

descriptosaurus-001019.en: The branches of the thick, tangled trees had spread and twisted to form dark, overhead tunnels and created secret paths.
descriptosaurus-001019.zh: 茂密、纠结的树枝蔓延开来，形成了黑暗的头顶隧道，形成了秘密的路径。

descriptosaurus-001020.en: The ceiling of thick branches shut out the sky and covered the path in darkness.
descriptosaurus-001020.zh: 厚枝的天花板将天空挡在了黑暗中，覆盖了这条小路。

descriptosaurus-001021.en: The dead branches rose up and grasped at her ankles like bony fingers.
descriptosaurus-001021.zh: 死树的树枝像骨头的手指一样抬起，抓住她的脚踝。

descriptosaurus-001022.en: The branches twisted and grated against each other like rusty hinges.
descriptosaurus-001022.zh: 树枝像生锈的铰链一样扭曲和磨碎。

descriptosaurus-001023.en: Like some prehistoric beast, the huge, twisted limbs of the tree guarded the entrance.
descriptosaurus-001023.zh: 像一些史前野兽一样，树上巨大的扭曲的四肢守卫着入口。

descriptosaurus-001024.en: Pressing in on her from all sides, it seemed that the forest was trying to trap her in its thorny grasp.
descriptosaurus-001024.zh: 从四面八方压在她身上，似乎森林正试图将她困在棘手的手中。

descriptosaurus-001025.en: As it drifted through the forest, the fog made eerie shapes and shadows.
descriptosaurus-001025.zh: 当它在森林中漂流时，雾形成了怪异的形状和阴影。

descriptosaurus-001026.en: Cloaked in mist, the trees looked like ghostly, stooped figures.
descriptosaurus-001026.zh: 笼罩在迷雾中的树木，看起来像幽灵般的，弯腰的人物。

descriptosaurus-001148.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-001150.zh: 巨大的，白雪皑皑的山脉

descriptosaurus-001153.en: Paths of shimmering pillars and arches
descriptosaurus-001153.zh: 闪烁的柱子和拱门的路径

descriptosaurus-001161.zh: 巨大的，充满敌意的山脉

descriptosaurus-001168.en: Like the humps of a gigantic dinosaur
descriptosaurus-001168.zh: 就像巨大的恐龙的驼峰

descriptosaurus-001170.zh: 像箭头一样的巨大山峰

descriptosaurus-001171.en: Hunched shoulders of the craggy mountain
descriptosaurus-001171.zh: 弯曲的山的弯曲的肩膀

descriptosaurus-001173.en: Haunting maze of glinting ice and rock
descriptosaurus-001173.zh: 闪闪发光的冰和岩石迷人的迷宫

descriptosaurus-001174.en: Inky black maze of steep, rugged paths
descriptosaurus-001174.zh: 陡峭、崎岖的小路的墨黑迷宫

descriptosaurus-001175.en: Shattered, jagged boulders and unstable rock-falls
descriptosaurus-001175.zh: 破碎、锯齿状的巨石和不稳定的落石

descriptosaurus-001185.en: Framed by the mountain’s majestic peaks
descriptosaurus-001185.zh: 由山上雄伟的山峰构成

descriptosaurus-001187.en: Split, cracked and carved by the magic of nature
descriptosaurus-001187.zh: 被大自然的魔力分裂、破裂和雕刻

descriptosaurus-001193.zh: 像黑色的灯塔一样玫瑰

descriptosaurus-001197.en: Crushed them in its stony mouth
descriptosaurus-001197.zh: 把它们压在石头的嘴里

descriptosaurus-001200.en: Shattered by nature into jagged blades
descriptosaurus-001200.zh: 被大自然粉碎成锯齿状的刀片

descriptosaurus-001203.zh: 笼罩在厚厚的风暴云中

descriptosaurus-001204.en: Hostile peaks jumped out of the mist
descriptosaurus-001204.zh: 充满敌意的山峰从迷雾中跳了出来

descriptosaurus-001205.en: Gloomy, brooding summit lay in wait
descriptosaurus-001205.zh: 阴沉沉沉的峰会等待着

descriptosaurus-001207.en: Edged their way to the top

descriptosaurus-001208.en: Scrambled up the sheer, rugged slopes

descriptosaurus-001210.en: Tore their hands and knees on the jagged rocks
descriptosaurus-001210.zh: 在锯齿状的岩石上撕裂他们的手和膝盖

descriptosaurus-001212.en: Towering, snow-capped mountains rose to meet the sky.
descriptosaurus-001212.zh: 高耸的，白雪皑皑的山峰升起，迎接天空。

descriptosaurus-001213.en: He was surrounded by the soaring summits of the majestic mountains.
descriptosaurus-001213.zh: 他被雄伟的山脉高耸的山峰所包围。

descriptosaurus-001214.en: A magical world of shimmering snow towered above the wooden chalets of the mountain village.
descriptosaurus-001214.zh: 山村木屋上方的神奇的雪地闪烁着雪的世界。

descriptosaurus-001215.en: From high up on the summit of the mountain, they had a spectacular view of green meadows and streams like silver ribbons.
descriptosaurus-001215.zh: 从山顶的高处，他们可以欣赏到绿色草地和银色丝带的溪流的壮丽景色。

descriptosaurus-001216.en: Split, cracked and carved by the magic of nature, the rocks had created a path of shimmering pillars and arches.
descriptosaurus-001216.zh: 岩石被大自然的魔力分裂、裂开和雕刻，形成了一条闪闪发光的柱子和拱门的路径。

descriptosaurus-001217.en: The huge, hostile mountain pierced the sky.
descriptosaurus-001217.zh: 巨大的、敌对的山脉刺穿了天空。

descriptosaurus-001218.en: Mountains, like gigantic spearheads, towered above her.
descriptosaurus-001218.zh: 像巨大的矛头一样，高耸在她的头顶。

descriptosaurus-001219.en: The top of the mountain was covered by a ghostly blanket of dark clouds.
descriptosaurus-001219.zh: 山顶被一片幽灵般的乌云笼罩。

descriptosaurus-001220.en: The steep slopes rose towards the shark-finned ridges of the huge mountain.
descriptosaurus-001220.zh: 陡峭的山坡向巨大的山脊鲨鱼鳍的山脊上升。

descriptosaurus-001221.en: The snow-capped summit of the mountain soared above her and to reach it she knew she would have to climb the sheer, deadly slopes.
descriptosaurus-001221.zh: 山顶的白雪覆盖的山顶在她上方翱翔，为了到达它，她知道她必须爬上陡峭的致命山坡。

descriptosaurus-001222.en: Enormous boulders of jagged rock blocked the path and he had to wind his way over and through the inky black maze.
descriptosaurus-001222.zh: 巨大的锯齿状岩石挡住了小路，他不得不蜿蜒穿过漆黑的黑色迷宫。

descriptosaurus-001223.en: Like huge black daggers, the savage summits burst out of the trees.
descriptosaurus-001223.zh: 像巨大的黑色匕首一样，野蛮的山峰从树林中冲了出来。

descriptosaurus-001224.en: The mountains loomed ahead like a giant black shadow, their peaks like huge, pointed black teeth waiting to crush him in their stony mouth.
descriptosaurus-001224.zh: 山上像一个巨大的黑色影子一样隐约在前面，它们的山峰像巨大的尖尖的黑色牙齿，等着将他压在石头的嘴里。

descriptosaurus-001225.en: The steep path glistened with damp – polished by nature into dangerous, slippery slopes.
descriptosaurus-001225.zh: 陡峭的小路闪闪发光——自然而然地被抛光到危险的湿滑坡上。

descriptosaurus-001226.en: He was faced by a haunting maze of ice and rock, glimmering white, stark and hostile.
descriptosaurus-001226.zh: 他面对着一个令人难以忘怀的冰和岩石迷宫，闪闪发光的白色、鲜明和充满敌意。

descriptosaurus-001278.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-001280.zh: 巨大的，闪闪发光的钟乳石

descriptosaurus-001281.zh: 像巨型尖刺一样的石笋

descriptosaurus-001282.zh: 闪闪发光的白色水晶画廊

descriptosaurus-001283.en: Entrance to the cave was like a ghostly, black hole
descriptosaurus-001283.zh: 洞穴的入口就像一个幽灵般的黑洞

descriptosaurus-001284.zh: 像一张沉默的、尖叫的嘴巴

descriptosaurus-001285.en: Inky black maze of dangerous, slippery paths
descriptosaurus-001285.zh: 危险，湿滑的路径的墨黑迷宫

descriptosaurus-001292.en: Crystal spikes rose from the gloom
descriptosaurus-001292.zh: 水晶尖峰从阴暗中升起

descriptosaurus-001293.zh: 隐藏在浓密、纠结的藤蔓后面

descriptosaurus-001295.zh: 被抛光到危险的、光滑的路径中

descriptosaurus-001296.en: Lit only by the narrow beam of light from the torch
descriptosaurus-001296.zh: 仅被火炬的窄光束照亮

descriptosaurus-001298.en: The tunnel suddenly opened out into a glittering gallery of white crystals.
descriptosaurus-001298.zh: 隧道突然通向一个闪闪发光的白色水晶画廊。

descriptosaurus-001299.en: Hidden behind thick, tangled vines was the mouth of a low cave.
descriptosaurus-001299.zh: 隐藏在浓密、缠结的藤蔓后面的是一个低矮的洞穴。

descriptosaurus-001300.en: The cave was a winding, underground maze of low, dark tunnels.
descriptosaurus-001300.zh: 洞穴是一个蜿蜒的地下迷宫，由低矮的黑暗隧道组成。

descriptosaurus-001301.en: Stalagmites, like giant crystal spikes, covered the floor and rose out of the gloom.
descriptosaurus-001301.zh: 石笋，就像巨大的水晶尖刺一样，覆盖了地板，从阴霾中升起。

descriptosaurus-001302.en: Hanging from the roof, like enormous diamonds, were huge, shimmering stalactites.
descriptosaurus-001302.zh: 像巨大的钻石一样悬挂在屋顶上的是巨大的、闪闪发光的钟乳石。

descriptosaurus-001303.en: The cave was a black hole – a silent, screaming mouth in the face of the rocky hill.
descriptosaurus-001303.zh: 洞穴是一个黑洞——在岩石山的面前，一张无声的、尖叫的嘴。

descriptosaurus-001304.en: Lit only by the narrow beam of light from the torch, the cave was a ghostly, black hole.
descriptosaurus-001304.zh: 只有从火炬的狭窄光束照亮，洞穴是一个幽灵般的黑洞。

descriptosaurus-001305.en: Where water had leaked in from the rocks, the walls and floor glistened with damp.
descriptosaurus-001305.zh: 水从岩石中渗出的地方，墙壁和地板都被潮湿的地方闪闪发光。

descriptosaurus-001348.en: Long arc of powdery, white sand
descriptosaurus-001348.zh: 长长的粉状，白色的沙子

descriptosaurus-001354.en: Emerald jewel of coral reefs and diamond dust beaches
descriptosaurus-001354.zh: 珊瑚礁和钻石尘沙滩的翡翠宝石

descriptosaurus-001358.en: Surrounded by a lush, green forest
descriptosaurus-001358.zh: 周围环绕着郁郁葱葱的绿色森林

descriptosaurus-001360.en: Sloped gently down to the sea
descriptosaurus-001360.zh: 轻轻地向下倾斜到大海

descriptosaurus-001361.en: Reached by scrambling down a steep, winding path
descriptosaurus-001361.zh: 通过爬上陡峭蜿蜒的小路到达

descriptosaurus-001364.en: The beach was long and narrow and sloped gently down to the sea.
descriptosaurus-001364.zh: 海滩又长又窄，缓慢地向下倾斜到大海。

descriptosaurus-001365.en: He was surrounded by sugar white beaches and a vivid blue sea that stretched for miles.
descriptosaurus-001365.zh: 他被白糖白色的海滩和长达数英里的鲜艳的蓝色大海所包围。

descriptosaurus-001366.en: The emerald jewel of coral reefs and diamond dust beaches was enclosed by a lush green forest.
descriptosaurus-001366.zh: 珊瑚礁和钻石尘沙滩的翡翠宝石被一片郁郁葱葱的绿色森林所包围。

descriptosaurus-001367.en: The beach was a long arc of golden sand, sheltered by dunes and large umbrella palm trees.
descriptosaurus-001367.zh: 海滩是一条长长的金色沙滩，由沙丘和大伞棕榈树遮蔽。

descriptosaurus-001368.en: The small, sheltered cove was reached by scrambling down a steep, winding path.
descriptosaurus-001368.zh: 沿着陡峭蜿蜒的小路爬行，到达了隐蔽的小海湾。

descriptosaurus-001430.en: Pillars of rock at the entrance to the bay

descriptosaurus-001431.en: Jigsaw of human and animal skeletons
descriptosaurus-001431.zh: 人类和动物骨架的拼图

descriptosaurus-001433.en: Sinister view of volcanic peaks and a moon-like landscape
descriptosaurus-001433.zh: 火山峰和月亮般的景观的险恶视图

descriptosaurus-001435.zh: 紫色石南花开得灿若火焰

descriptosaurus-001436.en: Palm trees swayed in the breeze

descriptosaurus-001437.en: Circled by a shallow, blue lagoon

descriptosaurus-001438.en: Teeming with multi-coloured corals and tropical fish
descriptosaurus-001438.zh: 丰富多彩的珊瑚和热带鱼

descriptosaurus-001442.en: Echo of pain and death lingered
descriptosaurus-001442.zh: 痛苦和死亡的回声挥之不去

descriptosaurus-001444.en: It was an eerie, lifeless island guarded by steep, rocky cliffs.
descriptosaurus-001444.zh: 那是一座阴森荒寂的岛屿，四周是陡峭的岩壁。

descriptosaurus-001445.en: The rocky island slopes were ablaze with purple heather.
descriptosaurus-001445.zh: 岛上乱石嶙峋的山坡开满紫色石南，灿若火焰。

descriptosaurus-001446.en: They had arrived in a paradise of tropical islands, with swaying palm trees, pure white beaches and brilliant turquoise lagoons.
descriptosaurus-001446.zh: 他们到达了一个热带岛屿的天堂，那里有摇曳的棕榈树、纯净的白色海滩和灿烂的绿松石泻湖。

descriptosaurus-001447.en: The island was circled by a shallow lagoon on a beautiful reef teeming with multi-coloured corals and tropical fish.
descriptosaurus-001447.zh: 该岛被一个浅泻湖环绕，美丽的珊瑚礁上长满了彩色珊瑚和热带鱼。

descriptosaurus-001448.en: The island was a time capsule.

descriptosaurus-001449.en: Wherever they went they found relics of an ancient world.
descriptosaurus-001449.zh: 无论他们走到哪里，他们都会找到一个古老的世界的遗迹。

descriptosaurus-001450.en: Littered with bones, the shore was a jigsaw of human and animal skeletons.
descriptosaurus-001450.zh: 海岸上到处都是骨头，是人类和动物骨骼的拼图。

descriptosaurus-001496.en: Fountain of fire like a throbbing wound
descriptosaurus-001496.zh: 像跳动的伤口一样的火之泉

descriptosaurus-001498.en: Towering, black clouds of ash and smoke
descriptosaurus-001498.zh: 高耸的，黑白的灰烬和烟雾

descriptosaurus-001500.en: Cauldron of spitting bubbles, hissing steam and belching fumes
descriptosaurus-001500.zh: 吐出气泡、嘶嘶声和喷出烟雾的大锅

descriptosaurus-001503.en: Crater loomed ominously over the town
descriptosaurus-001503.zh: 火山口在城镇上空隐约可见

descriptosaurus-001507.zh: 紧随其后的是震耳欲聋的繁荣

descriptosaurus-001509.en: The air was thick with choking fumes.
descriptosaurus-001509.zh: 空气中充满了窒息的烟雾。

descriptosaurus-001510.en: The earth trembled and shook and sent everything crashing to the ground.
descriptosaurus-001510.zh: 大地颤抖着，把一切都倒在地上。

descriptosaurus-001511.en: It was hard to breathe and hard to see in the smoky, black haze.
descriptosaurus-001511.zh: 在烟雾缭绕的黑色阴霾中，很难呼吸，也很难看到。

descriptosaurus-001512.en: Huge black clouds blocked out the sun, and darkness fell.
descriptosaurus-001512.zh: 巨大的黑云挡住了太阳，黑暗降临了。

descriptosaurus-001513.en: Torrents of sizzling, smouldering ash and rocks rained from the sky.
descriptosaurus-001513.zh: 天空中下起了汹涌的火山灰和岩石的洪流。

descriptosaurus-001514.en: As the volcano erupted, there was a deafening boom and the ground trembled and shook.
descriptosaurus-001514.zh: 随着火山的爆发，一声震耳欲聋的轰鸣声，地面颤抖着震动。

descriptosaurus-001515.en: A fountain of fire, like a throbbing wound, flooded the sky.
descriptosaurus-001515.zh: 一道火之泉，如同一个跳动的伤口，淹没了天空。

descriptosaurus-001516.en: Looming ominously over the village, the crater and its plume of vapour was a silent, menacing reminder of its awesome power.
descriptosaurus-001516.zh: 在村庄上隐约可见，火山口和它的蒸汽羽流是一个无声的、威胁性的提醒，提醒人们它的强大力量。

descriptosaurus-001546.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-001551.en: Rocky and spiked with thorny bushes

descriptosaurus-001553.en: Burning, merciless desert of glare and death
descriptosaurus-001553.zh: 燃烧、无情的眩光和死亡沙漠

descriptosaurus-001555.en: Stretched as far as the eye could see

descriptosaurus-001557.en: Baked by day and chilled by night

descriptosaurus-001558.en: Wind flung the sand into their throats and eyes
descriptosaurus-001558.zh: 风把沙子扔进他们的喉咙和眼睛

descriptosaurus-001559.en: Whipped up mile-high walls of sand

descriptosaurus-001560.en: Endless, flat horizon was suddenly broken by ...
descriptosaurus-001560.zh: 无尽的平坦地平线突然被...

descriptosaurus-001563.en: It was a land of burning sands.

descriptosaurus-001564.en: Huge sand dunes had been blown away by the sand storm and dumped elsewhere.
descriptosaurus-001564.zh: 巨大的沙丘被沙尘暴吹走并倾倒在其他地方。

descriptosaurus-001565.en: The endless, flat horizon was suddenly broken by a group of tall rock pillars like giant mushrooms.
descriptosaurus-001565.zh: 一望无际的平坦地平线突然被一群像巨型蘑菇一样的高大岩柱打破。

descriptosaurus-001566.en: The desert spread out before him – a sea of sand, shimmering with heat.
descriptosaurus-001566.zh: 沙漠在他面前蔓延开来——沙海，闪烁着热量。

descriptosaurus-001567.en: It was a burning, merciless desert of glare and death.
descriptosaurus-001567.zh: 那是一片燃烧的无情的目光和死亡的沙漠。

descriptosaurus-001637.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-001646.en: Enormous cracks in the scorched earth
descriptosaurus-001646.zh: 烧焦的地球上的巨大裂缝

descriptosaurus-001647.en: Baked ground was as dry as cork underfoot
descriptosaurus-001647.zh: 烤的地面和软木脚下的软木一样干燥

descriptosaurus-001648.en: Withered, dead leaves and dry twigs

descriptosaurus-001655.en: Sunk into the lush, green grass
descriptosaurus-001655.zh: 沉入郁郁葱葱的绿草中

descriptosaurus-001659.en: Nothing grew on the baked earth
descriptosaurus-001659.zh: 烤的地球上没有任何东西生长

descriptosaurus-001661.en: Wind blew a cloud of dust along the road
descriptosaurus-001661.zh: 风在路上吹了一团尘埃

descriptosaurus-001662.en: Feet crunched on the withered, dead leaves
descriptosaurus-001662.zh: 脚在枯萎的枯叶上嘎吱作响

descriptosaurus-001665.en: Held her in its squelching, slimy grasp
descriptosaurus-001665.zh: 把她抱在它的嘶嘶声中，黏糊糊的抓握

descriptosaurus-001667.en: Slipped and clawed her way through the gooey slime
descriptosaurus-001667.zh: 滑过粘糊糊的粘液，滑过她的路

descriptosaurus-001672.en: The snow made a crisp carpet beneath their feet.
descriptosaurus-001672.zh: 雪在他们的脚下铺了一块清脆的地毯。

descriptosaurus-001673.en: They had entered a fairytale world, where the ground and hills were cloaked in snow.
descriptosaurus-001673.zh: 他们进入了一个童话世界，那里的地面和山丘都被雪遮住了。

descriptosaurus-001674.en: Above her, clouds like fluffy cotton balls drifted across the sky and below, autumn’s crisp leaves crunched under her feet.
descriptosaurus-001674.zh: 在她上方，像蓬松的棉球一样的云飘过天空和下面，秋天清脆的叶子在她的脚下嘎吱作响。

descriptosaurus-001676.en: Nothing grew on the dry, red ground.
descriptosaurus-001676.zh: 干燥的红色地面上没有任何东西生长。

descriptosaurus-001677.en: The months without rain had caused enormous cracks to appear in the scorched earth.
descriptosaurus-001677.zh: 没有下雨的几个月，在烧焦的地球上出现了巨大的裂缝。

descriptosaurus-001678.en: The ground was as dry as cork underfoot and her feet crunched on the withered, dead leaves and fallen twigs.
descriptosaurus-001678.zh: 地面像软木脚下一样干燥，她的脚在枯萎的枯叶和倒下的树枝上嘎吱作响。

descriptosaurus-001679.en: She slipped and clawed her way through the gooey slime.
descriptosaurus-001679.zh: 她滑倒并抓住了粘糊糊的粘液。

descriptosaurus-001680.en: The ground was like muddy soup and swallowed her feet in its squelching, slimy grasp.
descriptosaurus-001680.zh: 地面像泥泞的汤，将她的脚吞没在它的嘶嘶声、黏糊糊的抓握中。

descriptosaurus-001681.en: She scrambled up the vertical bank, which was slimy with damp leaves and mud.
descriptosaurus-001681.zh: 她爬上垂直的河岸，湿漉漉的树叶和泥土。

descriptosaurus-001682.en: The ground was covered in frost and glinted dangerously.
descriptosaurus-001682.zh: 地面上覆盖着霜冻，危险地闪烁着。

descriptosaurus-001683.en: The earth was hard with black frost that seeped through his sodden boots and spread ice into every limb.
descriptosaurus-001683.zh: 大地坚硬，黑色的霜从他湿透的靴子中渗出，将冰铺在每一个肢体中。

descriptosaurus-001684.en: Below his feet, the glittering ice cracked and groaned, until finally it split like a lightning bolt.
descriptosaurus-001684.zh: 在他的脚下，闪闪发光的冰块裂开并呻吟着，直到最后它像闪电一样裂开。

descriptosaurus-001722.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-001731.en: Rough path through heather and gorse
descriptosaurus-001731.zh: 穿越希瑟和戈尔斯的崎岖道路

descriptosaurus-001733.en: Dipped and climbed across the hills

descriptosaurus-001735.en: Climbed steeply up the side of the mountain

descriptosaurus-001736.zh: 消失在威胁性的高峰中

descriptosaurus-001739.en: Followed the twists and turns of the river

descriptosaurus-001743.en: Ran between a tunnel of high bushes
descriptosaurus-001743.zh: 在高灌木隧道之间运行

descriptosaurus-001746.en: Holes like craters gouged in the surface
descriptosaurus-001746.zh: 像火山口一样的洞在表面挖出

descriptosaurus-001748.en: A grassy path headed down to the left.

descriptosaurus-001749.en: The dusty, rugged path wound steeply up the side of the mountain.
descriptosaurus-001749.zh: 这条尘土飞扬的崎岖小路陡峭地蜿蜒在山的一侧。

descriptosaurus-001750.en: The narrow path followed the river and wound through the wood.
descriptosaurus-001750.zh: 狭窄的小路沿着河流穿过树林。

descriptosaurus-001751.en: The ancient mule track twisted and turned and snaked its way steeply to the top.
descriptosaurus-001751.zh: 古老的骡子轨道扭曲转身，陡峭地蜿蜒到山顶。

descriptosaurus-001752.en: The rough track dipped and climbed across the hills through the heather and gorse.
descriptosaurus-001752.zh: 崎岖不平的小路穿过石南花和金雀花，穿过山丘。

descriptosaurus-001753.en: The path suddenly veered to the left and they had a fleeting view of the vivid, blue sea stretching as far as the eye could see.
descriptosaurus-001753.zh: 小路突然向左转，他们可以转瞬即逝，一望无际的蓝色大海，一望无际。

descriptosaurus-001754.en: They followed a rough track between the fields of golden corn, until they came to a stile.
descriptosaurus-001754.zh: 他们沿着金色玉米田地之间的一条粗轨道，直到他们走到了一个阶梯上。

descriptosaurus-001755.en: Beyond the gate, a flight of narrow, rough steps led down to a stream.
descriptosaurus-001755.zh: 在大门之外，一条狭窄而粗糙的台阶通向一条溪流。

descriptosaurus-001756.en: He searched for a way forward and finally came across what seemed to be a forgotten path, hidden by thorns and creepers and leading deep into the forest.
descriptosaurus-001756.zh: 他寻找前进的道路，最终遇到了一条似乎被遗忘的道路，被荆棘和爬行者所掩盖，并深入森林。

descriptosaurus-001757.en: The bone-shaking trail was covered in holes like craters, which were filled with mud and water.
descriptosaurus-001757.zh: 摇骨的小径像陨石坑一样被洞覆盖，这些洞里充满了泥泞和水。

descriptosaurus-001758.en: They followed the narrow, winding coastal path until they came to a wooden fence.
descriptosaurus-001758.zh: 他们沿着狭窄蜿蜒的沿海小路走，直到他们来到一个木栅栏。

descriptosaurus-001759.en: Suddenly, the land fell away in a steep slope and then plunged into the sea.
descriptosaurus-001759.zh: 突然，这片土地在陡峭的斜坡上掉了下来，然后跳入了大海。
