descriptosaurus-001882.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-001885.en: As clear and smooth as glass

descriptosaurus-001888.zh: 像一条长长的，蜿蜒的丝带

descriptosaurus-001890.zh: 闪闪发光的银色大窗帘

descriptosaurus-001891.en: Glimmering like a lazy, grey snake
descriptosaurus-001891.zh: 像一条懒惰的灰色蛇一样闪闪发光

descriptosaurus-001892.en: Pearly white in the shadow of the moon

descriptosaurus-001893.en: Like thousands of tiny diamonds on the water
descriptosaurus-001893.zh: 就像水上成千上万的小钻石

descriptosaurus-001895.zh: 闪闪发光的水帘，跳舞的水

descriptosaurus-001900.en: Ripple of a stream tumbling down the hill
descriptosaurus-001900.zh: 山下翻滚的溪流的涟漪

descriptosaurus-001905.en: Bulging blister of churning, grey water

descriptosaurus-001907.zh: 令人毛骨悚然，绿色，水下森林

descriptosaurus-001910.en: Huge clouds of wild, flying spray
descriptosaurus-001910.zh: 巨大的狂野的飞喷雾云

descriptosaurus-001914.zh: 咆哮的急流的致命声音

descriptosaurus-001918.en: Flowed down the hill as dozens of little waterfalls
descriptosaurus-001918.zh: 像几十个小瀑布一样下山

descriptosaurus-001919.en: Rushed down the mountain like watery stairs

descriptosaurus-001920.en: Twisted and turned through the forest

descriptosaurus-001922.zh: 翻倒在苔藓覆盖的岩石上

descriptosaurus-001924.en: Burbled as it hopped and danced down the rocks
descriptosaurus-001924.zh: 当它在岩石上跳跃和跳舞时响起

descriptosaurus-001926.en: Glistened with a million diamonds of light
descriptosaurus-001926.zh: 闪闪发光的一百万颗光

descriptosaurus-001928.zh: 在正午的阳光下闪闪发光

descriptosaurus-001931.en: Dived into an eerie, green world
descriptosaurus-001931.zh: 潜入一个令人毛骨悚然的绿色世界

descriptosaurus-001932.en: Strangled by a spidery web of weeds

descriptosaurus-001933.en: Impossible to see anything in the murky depths
descriptosaurus-001933.zh: 不可能在阴暗的深处看到任何东西

descriptosaurus-001937.en: Plunged and cascaded down the mountain

descriptosaurus-001938.en: Cascaded over the top of the falls

descriptosaurus-001940.en: Battled against the boulders that barred its way

descriptosaurus-001941.en: Hurtled into the misty void below
descriptosaurus-001941.zh: 被冲进下面雾蒙蒙的虚空

descriptosaurus-001942.en: Blasted into a white, swirling foam
descriptosaurus-001942.zh: 爆炸成白色，旋转的泡沫

descriptosaurus-001943.en: Sent huge clouds of spray hundreds of feet into the air
descriptosaurus-001943.zh: 将数百英尺处的巨大喷雾云送入空中

descriptosaurus-001944.en: Roared as it hurtled over the edge

descriptosaurus-001945.en: Blanketed everything with its pounding roar
descriptosaurus-001945.zh: 用它的轰鸣声覆盖了一切

descriptosaurus-001946.en: Thundered endlessly over the lip of the rock
descriptosaurus-001946.zh: 无休止地在岩石的唇上响起

descriptosaurus-001947.en: Ate mile upon mile of ground

descriptosaurus-001948.zh: 摧毁了它路径上的一切

descriptosaurus-001950.en: The lake was a huge curtain of shimmering silver.
descriptosaurus-001950.zh: 湖是一道闪闪发光的银色窗帘。

descriptosaurus-001951.en: The cold, clear water of the stream wound down the mountainside.
descriptosaurus-001951.zh: 溪流冰冷清澈的水流下山腰。

descriptosaurus-001952.en: He could hear the soft bubbling of a stream in the distance.
descriptosaurus-001952.zh: 他能听到远处传来的轻柔的气息。

descriptosaurus-001953.en: The water in the lake was calm and crystal clear and sparkled with a million diamonds of light in the midday sun.
descriptosaurus-001953.zh: 湖中的水平静而清澈，在正午的阳光下，有一百万颗钻石闪闪发光。

descriptosaurus-001954.en: Shimmering in the flickering starlight, the river was a long, snaking, silver ribbon.
descriptosaurus-001954.zh: 在闪烁的星光中闪烁的河流是一条长长的、蜿蜒曲折的银色丝带。

descriptosaurus-001955.en: The mountain streams made winding lines of sparkling silver as they danced down the slopes.
descriptosaurus-001955.zh: 山间溪流在山坡上跳舞时，形成了闪闪发光的银线。

descriptosaurus-001956.en: There was a trickle of running water as the river flowed down the hill as dozens of little waterfalls.
descriptosaurus-001956.zh: 当河流像几十个小瀑布一样流下山坡时，有一滴水流过。

descriptosaurus-001957.en: From every hill came the gurgling of water – the music of invisible fountains as the river tumbled down the slopes.
descriptosaurus-001957.zh: 每座山上都传来水声——当河流从山坡上翻滚时，隐形喷泉的音乐。

descriptosaurus-001958.en: The waterfall was a silky, watery stairs that whispered as it fell.
descriptosaurus-001958.zh: 瀑布是一个柔滑的、水汪汪的楼梯，它在落下时低声说。

descriptosaurus-001959.en: He was surrounded by a curtain of dancing water, which sent a spray like thousands of tiny diamonds dropping from the sky.
descriptosaurus-001959.zh: 他被一片跳舞的水帘包围着，喷出的喷雾就像数千颗小钻石从天而降。

descriptosaurus-001960.en: Clear and as smooth as glass, the stream twisted and turned through the forest.
descriptosaurus-001960.zh: 清澈而光滑的玻璃，溪流扭曲并在森林中转动。

descriptosaurus-001961.en: The river was swollen and flooding its banks.

descriptosaurus-001962.en: The grey, churning water of the lake blended with the stormy sky.
descriptosaurus-001962.zh: 湖中灰蒙蒙的，搅动的水与暴风雨的天空融为一体。

descriptosaurus-001963.en: From below came the deadly sound of roaring rapids.
descriptosaurus-001963.zh: 从下面传来了咆哮的急流的致命声音。

descriptosaurus-001964.en: The lake was long and narrow and wound between the towering, ghostly mountains.
descriptosaurus-001964.zh: 湖又长又窄，在高耸的幽灵山之间缠绕着。

descriptosaurus-001965.en: The river was brown and frothing, polluted by rubbish and chemicals.
descriptosaurus-001965.zh: 这条河是棕色和起泡的，被垃圾和化学物质污染。

descriptosaurus-001966.en: It was impossible to see anything in the murky depths of the oily river.
descriptosaurus-001966.zh: 在油性河流的阴暗深处，不可能看到任何东西。

descriptosaurus-001967.en: The wild current swept past and flung the water into the air as it tumbled over the edge.
descriptosaurus-001967.zh: 狂野的水流掠过，把水扔到空中，翻滚到边缘。

descriptosaurus-001968.en: A torrent of water thundered endlessly over the lip of the rock and filled the river with its hammering roar.
descriptosaurus-001968.zh: 一股洪流在岩石的唇边无休止地雷鸣般的轰鸣，用锤击的咆哮充满了河流。

descriptosaurus-001969.en: The water was turned into wild, flying foam as it rampaged down the rocks.
descriptosaurus-001969.zh: 水在岩石上横冲直撞时变成了狂野的飞行泡沫。

descriptosaurus-001970.en: Roaring fiercely, the river hurtled over the edge into the swirling mist below.
descriptosaurus-001970.zh: 猛地咆哮着，河流越过边缘，进入下面的漩涡雾中。

descriptosaurus-001971.en: She had dived into an eerie world: an underwater forest of murky, green water, strangled by a spidery web of weeds.
descriptosaurus-001971.zh: 她潜入了一个怪异的世界：一片浑浊的绿水的水下森林，被蜘蛛般的杂草勒死。

descriptosaurus-001972.en: Torrents of water plunged over the top of the cliffs into the once calm waterhole, turning into a raging, foaming falls and sending huge clouds of spray hundreds of feet into the air.
descriptosaurus-001972.zh: 洪流从悬崖顶上倾泻而下，进入曾经平静的水坑，变成了汹涌的泡沫瀑布，将巨大的云雾喷射到数百英尺的空中。

descriptosaurus-002097.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-002105.zh: 柔软的白色泡沫的圆圈

descriptosaurus-002107.en: Slap and suck of water on sand

descriptosaurus-002108.en: Like the swish of a curtain

descriptosaurus-002109.en: Splash and slosh of the waves

descriptosaurus-002111.en: Grey, churning surface of the waves

descriptosaurus-002112.en: Black world of the deep, restless ocean
descriptosaurus-002112.zh: 深沉、不安的海洋的黑色世界

descriptosaurus-002116.zh: 波峰是一个巨大的拱门

descriptosaurus-002118.zh: 巨大的搅动泡沫的波峰

descriptosaurus-002123.en: Spray like a bleeding mist in the setting sun
descriptosaurus-002123.zh: 在夕阳下像喷雾一样喷雾

descriptosaurus-002125.en: Warning groan and rumble of the huge waves
descriptosaurus-002125.zh: 警告的巨大海浪的呻吟和隆隆声

descriptosaurus-002127.en: Caught sight of the sea far below

descriptosaurus-002128.zh: 像稀有宝石一样闪闪发光

descriptosaurus-002129.en: Silver streaks of light danced across the water
descriptosaurus-002129.zh: 银色的光芒在水面上翩翩起舞

descriptosaurus-002130.en: Blazed with all the colours of the rainbow
descriptosaurus-002130.zh: 用彩虹的所有颜色燃烧着

descriptosaurus-002132.en: Wrinkled the surface of the water

descriptosaurus-002136.zh: 懒洋洋地在岩石上轻弹

descriptosaurus-002138.en: Lapped against the side of the boat

descriptosaurus-002140.en: Trapped by the black world of the vast ocean
descriptosaurus-002140.zh: 被广阔海洋的黑色世界困住

descriptosaurus-002141.en: Tugged at him and sucked him into its swirling surface
descriptosaurus-002141.zh: 拉着他，把他吸进它旋转的表面

descriptosaurus-002144.en: Bent first one way and then the other
descriptosaurus-002144.zh: 以一种方式弯曲，然后再弯曲

descriptosaurus-002146.en: Rose in a huge arch above the boat
descriptosaurus-002146.zh: 在船上方的一个巨大拱门中升起

descriptosaurus-002147.en: Roared as they raced to the beach
descriptosaurus-002147.zh: 当他们跑到海滩时咆哮着

descriptosaurus-002151.en: Flung the boats from side to side
descriptosaurus-002151.zh: 将船从一边扔到另一边

descriptosaurus-002152.en: Wrenched the boats from their anchors

descriptosaurus-002153.en: Threatened to bury it in a watery grave
descriptosaurus-002153.zh: 威胁要把它埋在水坟里

descriptosaurus-002156.en: Pummelled and tossed by the brutal power of the waves
descriptosaurus-002156.zh: 被波浪的残酷力量打击和折腾

descriptosaurus-002157.en: Churned the beach into foaming, yellow sand
descriptosaurus-002157.zh: 将海滩搅动成泡沫，黄色沙子

descriptosaurus-002158.en: Deafening roar as the wave thundered into sight
descriptosaurus-002158.zh: 当海浪轰然响起时，震耳欲聋的咆哮声

descriptosaurus-002159.en: Boom of the waves echoed through the air

descriptosaurus-002161.en: The sea around the island was a shimmering blue.
descriptosaurus-002161.zh: 岛上的海是一片闪烁的蓝色。

descriptosaurus-002162.en: The water in the bay was a vivid, pure green.
descriptosaurus-002162.zh: 海湾里的水是生动的、纯净的绿色。

descriptosaurus-002163.en: She looked down through the crystal clear water to the powdery, white sands below.
descriptosaurus-002163.zh: 她透过晶莹剔透的清澈的水望向下方的粉状白色沙滩。

descriptosaurus-002164.en: The emerald surface of the sea glittered with a million diamonds of sunlight.
descriptosaurus-002164.zh: 大海的翡翠表面闪耀着一百万颗阳光的钻石。

descriptosaurus-002165.en: The waves slid, like the swish of a curtain, onto the powdery white sand.
descriptosaurus-002165.zh: 海浪像窗帘的嗖嗖声一样滑到粉状的白色沙子上。

descriptosaurus-002166.en: The waves curled and lapped against the side of the boat.
descriptosaurus-002166.zh: 海浪卷曲并拍打在船的一侧。

descriptosaurus-002167.en: The blue sea sparkled like a rare jewel and rippled softly in the breeze.
descriptosaurus-002167.zh: 蓝色的大海像一颗稀有的宝石一样闪闪发光，在微风中轻轻荡漾。

descriptosaurus-002168.en: The crystal waves creased the surface of the sea and rolled gently into the cove.
descriptosaurus-002168.zh: 水晶波压在海面上，轻轻地滚进海湾。

descriptosaurus-002169.en: Lapping gently onto the shore, the waves sent circles of water dancing around the rocks.
descriptosaurus-002169.zh: 轻轻地拍在岸边，海浪让水面圈在岩石周围跳舞。

descriptosaurus-002170.en: Crystal clear and as smooth as silk, the turquoise ocean was a picture postcard of paradise.
descriptosaurus-002170.zh: 晶莹剔透，像丝绸一样光滑，绿松石海洋是天堂的明信片。

descriptosaurus-002171.en: It was quiet except for the soothing, rhythmic splash and slosh of the waves creeping into the rock pools.
descriptosaurus-002171.zh: 除了舒缓、有节奏的飞溅和飘入岩石池的海浪的晃动外，它很安静。

descriptosaurus-002172.en: He caught sight of the dark, cold water of the sea far below.
descriptosaurus-002172.zh: 他看到了远处深海的黑暗，冰冷的海水。

descriptosaurus-002173.en: She was surrounded by a black blanket of swirling sea and stormy sky.
descriptosaurus-002173.zh: 她被一条黑色的大海和暴风雨的天空包围着。

descriptosaurus-002174.en: The booming breakers battered the shore.
descriptosaurus-002174.zh: 轰隆隆的破碎者在岸上猛击。

descriptosaurus-002175.en: Ahead and below them it was dark.
descriptosaurus-002175.zh: 前面和他们下面是黑暗的。

descriptosaurus-002176.en: They were trapped by the black world of the deep, restless sea.
descriptosaurus-002176.zh: 他们被深深、不安的大海的黑色世界困住了。

descriptosaurus-002177.en: The sea was dark, heaving and choked with seaweed.
descriptosaurus-002177.zh: 大海是黑暗的，起伏着，被海藻呛住了。

descriptosaurus-002178.en: The tumbling breakers crashed onto the rocks and left an icy mist as they were dragged back to sea.
descriptosaurus-002178.zh: 翻滚的断路器撞到岩石上，在被拖回大海时留下了冰冷的雾气。

descriptosaurus-002179.en: A mass of churning foam rose in an arch high above the boat and threatened to bury it in a watery grave.
descriptosaurus-002179.zh: 一大堆搅动的泡沫在船上方的一个拱门上升起，威胁要把它埋在一个水中的坟墓里。

descriptosaurus-002180.en: The hissing foam pounded the rocks and covered them in an icy mist.
descriptosaurus-002180.zh: 发出嘶嘶声的泡沫敲打着岩石，用冰冷的雾气覆盖了它们。

descriptosaurus-002181.en: As it thundered into sight, the roar of the wave was deafening.
descriptosaurus-002181.zh: 雷鸣般的雷鸣般的风声响起，海浪的轰鸣声震耳欲聋。

descriptosaurus-002182.en: The waves roared in from the sea, surged into the harbour, flung the boats from side to side and wrenched them from their anchors.
descriptosaurus-002182.zh: 海浪从大海中咆哮，冲入港口，将船从一侧扔到另一边，将它们从锚上刮下来。

descriptosaurus-002183.en: He was caught in the heaving, murky water, which tugged at him, sucked him into its swirling surface and dragged him into its inky depths.
descriptosaurus-002183.zh: 他陷入了汹涌的海水中，浑浊的水被拉扯着，将他吸进了旋转的表面，将他拖入了墨水的深处。

descriptosaurus-002184.en: The waves rose higher and higher; thundered nearer and nearer; broke into a roar of boiling foam and raced to the shore like galloping foam horses.
descriptosaurus-002184.zh: 波浪越来越高； 雷声越来越近； 爆发出一阵沸腾的泡沫，像奔腾的泡沫马一样奔向岸边。

descriptosaurus-002185.en: The spray from the waves looked like a bleeding mist in the red light of the setting sun – their thunderous roar like a wounded animal.
descriptosaurus-002185.zh: 海浪中的喷雾在落日的红光中看起来像一团流血的雾气——它们雷鸣般的咆哮声像受伤的动物。

descriptosaurus-002186.en: Like two giants locked in combat, the waves crashed against each other, soaring high in the air, bending first one way and then the other.
descriptosaurus-002186.zh: 就像两个巨人在战斗中被锁在战斗中一样，海浪相互撞击，在空中翱翔，先弯曲，然后是另一个。

descriptosaurus-002305.zh: 秘密，地下隧道和地窖的迷宫

descriptosaurus-002306.zh: 许多商店，艺术画廊和博物馆

descriptosaurus-002317.en: White houses with brightly coloured doors and shutters
descriptosaurus-002317.zh: 有鲜艳的门和百叶窗的白色房子

descriptosaurus-002319.zh: 充满活力，国际化的氛围

descriptosaurus-002320.en: An exciting mix of smells and sounds from around the world
descriptosaurus-002320.zh: 来自世界各地的令人兴奋的气味和声音组合

descriptosaurus-002321.en: Haven from the noise and pollution of the city
descriptosaurus-002321.zh: 城市噪音和污染的避风港

descriptosaurus-002324.en: Pile of stones and shattered walls

descriptosaurus-002331.en: Plastic bags, crisp packets and empty drink bottles
descriptosaurus-002331.zh: 塑料袋、脆包和空饮料瓶

descriptosaurus-002333.en: Lived in a run-down part of the town

descriptosaurus-002334.en: Spread out before him like a concrete jungle
descriptosaurus-002334.zh: 像混凝土丛林一样在他面前展开

descriptosaurus-002335.en: Surrounded by gentle hills and leafy lanes
descriptosaurus-002335.zh: 周围环绕着柔和的山丘和绿树成荫的小巷

descriptosaurus-002336.zh: 蜷缩在村庄周围的绿色

descriptosaurus-002338.en: Nestled at the foot of the mountain

descriptosaurus-002339.zh: 似乎是一个不太可能的地方...

descriptosaurus-002341.en: Buzzing with pavement cafes and street musicians
descriptosaurus-002341.zh: 与人行道咖啡馆和街头音乐家嗡嗡作响

descriptosaurus-002342.en: Alive with smells from the food stalls
descriptosaurus-002342.zh: 充满了食品摊位的气味

descriptosaurus-002346.en: Grime and pollution clung to the houses

descriptosaurus-002349.en: Waste pumped and dumped into the river
descriptosaurus-002349.zh: 废物被泵送并倾倒到河中

descriptosaurus-002351.en: It was a quaint town, with narrow, cobbled streets.
descriptosaurus-002351.zh: 这是一个古色古香的小镇，有狭窄的鹅卵石街道。

descriptosaurus-002352.en: The picturesque market town was surrounded by gentle hills and leafy lanes.
descriptosaurus-002352.zh: 风景如画的集镇被柔和的山丘和绿树成荫的小巷所环绕。

descriptosaurus-002353.en: The sea-side town was a small, enchanting haven from the polluted city.
descriptosaurus-002353.zh: 海边小镇是一个来自污染城市的小而迷人的避风港。

descriptosaurus-002354.en: Ahead of him on the rocky coast was a quaint fishing village.
descriptosaurus-002354.zh: 在岩石海岸的他前面是一个古色古香的渔村。

descriptosaurus-002355.en: The ancient town was a warren of tunnels and narrow, twisting alleys, and a maze of buildings.
descriptosaurus-002355.zh: 古镇是一个由隧道和狭窄、蜿蜒曲折的小巷和迷宫般的建筑物组成的沃伦。

descriptosaurus-002356.en: It was a colourful, cosmopolitan city.
descriptosaurus-002356.zh: 这是一座色彩缤纷的国际化城市。

descriptosaurus-002357.en: The street markets filled the air with an exciting mix of smells and sounds from around the world.
descriptosaurus-002357.zh: 街头市场充满了来自世界各地的令人兴奋的气味和声音组合。

descriptosaurus-002358.en: The wide, tree-lined streets were bright and cheerful, lined with pavement cafes and alive with the sounds of street musicians.
descriptosaurus-002358.zh: 宽阔的绿树成荫的街道明亮而欢快，两旁是人行道咖啡馆，街道音乐家的声音充满活力。

descriptosaurus-002359.en: The city was bustling with tourists, eager to explore the scores of shops, art galleries and museums.
descriptosaurus-002359.zh: 这座城市挤满了游客，渴望探索许多商店、艺术画廊和博物馆。

descriptosaurus-002360.en: Nestling around the village green, the sleepy village seemed an unlikely place for an adventure.
descriptosaurus-002360.zh: 沉睡的村庄依偎在村庄的绿地周围，似乎是一个冒险的地方。

descriptosaurus-002361.en: The village was no more than a pile of stones and shattered walls.
descriptosaurus-002361.zh: 村子不过是一堆石头和破碎的墙壁。

descriptosaurus-002362.en: She lived in a run-down part of the city.
descriptosaurus-002362.zh: 她住在城市的一个破败的地方。

descriptosaurus-002363.en: Wood, not glass, filled the windows.
descriptosaurus-002363.zh: 木头，不是玻璃，填满了窗户。

descriptosaurus-002365.en: Rotting rubbish and broken glass lined the streets.
descriptosaurus-002365.zh: 腐烂的垃圾和碎玻璃在街道上排成一列。

descriptosaurus-002366.en: Plastic bags and crisp packets flapped like streamers from the trees.
descriptosaurus-002366.zh: 塑料袋和脆包像树上的飘带一样飘扬。

descriptosaurus-002367.en: Empty drink bottles rattled in the gutter.
descriptosaurus-002367.zh: 空荡荡的饮料瓶在排水沟里嘎嘎作响。

descriptosaurus-002368.en: They could see the city spread out before them, with its black veil of smoke and towering chimneys.
descriptosaurus-002368.zh: 他们可以看到这座城市在他们面前蔓延开来，黑色的烟雾和高耸的烟囱。

descriptosaurus-002369.en: Most of the houses had been built from cardboard, or anything that could be rescued to provide shelter.
descriptosaurus-002369.zh: 大多数房屋都是用纸板或任何可以救出的东西来提供庇护的。

descriptosaurus-002370.en: The houses were crowded together and blackened by soot and smog.
descriptosaurus-002370.zh: 房子挤在一起，被烟灰和烟雾遮住了。

descriptosaurus-002371.en: It was a ghost town of deserted houses crawling with mould and damp – empty shells with gaping windows like haunted eyes.
descriptosaurus-002371.zh: 这是一个充满霉菌和潮湿的空屋的鬼城——空壳，窗户像闹鬼的眼睛。

descriptosaurus-002372.en: Years of grime and pollution clung to the houses, spewed from the big, ugly factories that shadowed the streets.
descriptosaurus-002372.zh: 多年的污垢和污染紧贴着房屋，从街道上的大而丑陋的工厂喷射而出。

descriptosaurus-002373.en: A warren of secret, underground tunnels and cellars was used to move around the city and to hide from invaders in times of danger.
descriptosaurus-002373.zh: 一个秘密的地下隧道和地窖的沃伦被用来在城市周围移动并在危险时期躲避入侵者。

descriptosaurus-002429.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-002438.zh: 像螺旋弹簧一样的危险曲线系列

descriptosaurus-002439.zh: 郁郁葱葱的绿色田野的拼布

descriptosaurus-002453.zh: 在陡峭的下降中开始向下

descriptosaurus-002460.en: Clouds of dust sprayed the windscreen
descriptosaurus-002460.zh: 防风玻璃上喷洒着尘云

descriptosaurus-002462.zh: 她沿着蜿蜒的乡间小路从一个村庄到另一个村庄。

descriptosaurus-002463.en: His route took him through quiet country lanes and patchworks of lush green fields.
descriptosaurus-002463.zh: 他的路线带他穿过安静的乡间小路和茂密的绿色田野。

descriptosaurus-002464.en: The narrow, winding road followed the coast for miles, past sandy bays and a shimmering turquoise sea.
descriptosaurus-002464.zh: 狭窄蜿蜒的道路沿着海岸行驶数英里，经过沙湾和闪闪发光的绿松石海。

descriptosaurus-002465.en: The arrow-straight desert road shimmered in the intense heat.
descriptosaurus-002465.zh: 箭头直的沙漠之路在高温下闪闪发光。

descriptosaurus-002466.en: It was a huge, dirty city clogged with fumes and traffic.
descriptosaurus-002466.zh: 这是一个巨大的肮脏城市，被烟雾和交通堵塞。

descriptosaurus-002467.en: The city centre was circled by wide motorways carrying streams of traffic belching out fumes, but never moving very fast.
descriptosaurus-002467.zh: 市中心被宽阔的高速公路环绕，交通拥挤，喷出烟雾，但从未移动得很快。

descriptosaurus-002468.en: Like strings of spaghetti, roads circled and split the town.
descriptosaurus-002468.zh: 就像一串串意大利面一样，道路盘旋并分裂了城镇。

descriptosaurus-002469.en: The road started downwards in a steep descent and crabbed along the mountain in a series of perilous curves, twisting and turning like a coiled spring.
descriptosaurus-002469.zh: 这条路从陡峭的下降开始向下，沿着山脉以一系列危险的弯道向下爬，像盘绕的弹簧一样扭曲和转动。

descriptosaurus-002470.en: The car shuddered along the bone-shaking trail.
descriptosaurus-002470.zh: 车子在摇摇欲坠的小路上颤抖着。

descriptosaurus-002471.en: Clouds of dust sprayed the windscreen and the car leaped into the air as the front tyres struck the potholes.
descriptosaurus-002471.zh: 当前轮胎撞到坑洞时，灰尘云喷洒了挡风玻璃，汽车跃入空中。

descriptosaurus-002635.en: Impossible to see behind the high, wooden gates

descriptosaurus-002659.zh: 将他们的内容洒在路径上

descriptosaurus-002662.zh: 长长的砾石驱动器穿过郁郁葱葱、整洁的草坪中间。

descriptosaurus-002663.zh: 庄园被高高的红砖墙包围着。

descriptosaurus-002668.zh: 大门设置在墙上，狡猾地隐藏在阴影中。

descriptosaurus-002669.en: Weeds and ivy had eaten their way into the cracks of the wall and spread their tentacles into every crevice.
descriptosaurus-002669.zh: 杂草和常春藤已经进食墙的裂缝，将它们的触手伸向每一个缝隙中。

descriptosaurus-002670.en: Bushes crept and wriggled over the drive, which was now just a thin strip steeped in shadow.
descriptosaurus-002670.zh: 灌木丛爬行并在驱动器上扭动，现在只是一条浸在阴影中的薄带。

descriptosaurus-002671.en: The warehouse was surrounded by a tall fence, at least three metres high, topped with steel spikes and razor wire.
descriptosaurus-002671.zh: 仓库被一个高高的栅栏包围着，至少三米高，上面有钢钉和铁丝网。

descriptosaurus-002672.en: The drive was paved, but grass grew in every crevice and moss clung to the surface like mould on bread.
descriptosaurus-002672.zh: 驱动器已经铺好了，但在每一个缝隙中都长出了草，苔藓像面包上的霉菌一样粘在表面上。

descriptosaurus-002673.en: They looked through the twisted railings and in front of them in the gloom were dark, crumbling stones, thorny bushes and knee-high grass.
descriptosaurus-002673.zh: 他们透过扭曲的栏杆看了看，眼前的阴影中是黑暗、摇摇欲坠的石头、多刺的灌木和膝盖高的草地。

descriptosaurus-002674.en: Beyond loomed the ghostly shadow of the house.
descriptosaurus-002674.zh: 超越了屋子里幽灵般的阴影。

descriptosaurus-002675.en: The back of the house was a huge carpet of lush, green grass.
descriptosaurus-002675.zh: 房子的后面是一片茂密的绿草地毯。

descriptosaurus-002676.en: Grassy slopes rolled down from the house to a beautiful wilderness of huge trees and wild flowers.
descriptosaurus-002676.zh: 草地从房子里滚下来，变成了美丽的大树和野花的荒野。

descriptosaurus-002677.en: Huge terracotta pots, brimming with brightly coloured flowers, sat either side of the front door.
descriptosaurus-002677.zh: 巨大的赤陶盆，鲜艳的花朵，坐在前门的两侧。

descriptosaurus-002678.en: Brightly coloured plants were arranged in symmetrical rows and colours, and bordered the edge of the lawn.
descriptosaurus-002678.zh: 色彩鲜艳的植物以对称的行和颜色排列，并与草坪的边缘接壤。

descriptosaurus-002679.en: Honeysuckle clung to the majestic oak tree, which spread its enormous limbs over the centre of the garden.
descriptosaurus-002679.zh: 金银花紧贴着雄伟的橡树，它将巨大的四肢张开在花园的中心。

descriptosaurus-002680.en: The front garden was wild and overgrown.
descriptosaurus-002680.zh: 前花园是野生的和杂草丛生的。

descriptosaurus-002681.en: Plastic bags instead of blossoms flapped on the bushes.
descriptosaurus-002681.zh: 塑料袋而不是花朵在灌木丛上拍打。

descriptosaurus-002682.en: It was a spidery tangle of trees, bushes, weeds and long, knee-high grass.
descriptosaurus-002682.zh: 那是一片蜘蛛般的树木、灌木丛、杂草和膝盖高的长草。

descriptosaurus-002683.en: The grass was withered and brown, and the flowers wilting, starved of water and choked with weeds.
descriptosaurus-002683.zh: 草枯萎了，棕色，花朵枯萎，缺乏水，被杂草呛住。

descriptosaurus-002684.en: The garden was full of junk: battered, old furniture, rusty metal frames and rubbish bags ripped and spewing their contents on the ground.
descriptosaurus-002684.zh: 花园里到处都是垃圾：破旧的家具、生锈的金属框架和垃圾袋被撕破并喷洒在地上。

descriptosaurus-002797.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-002798.en: Farmhouse was over four hundred years old
descriptosaurus-002798.zh: 这间农舍已有四百多年历史

descriptosaurus-002799.zh: 维多利亚式房屋的街道

descriptosaurus-002811.en: White, stone bungalow with a green tiled roof
descriptosaurus-002811.zh: 白色，石头平房，绿色瓷砖屋顶

descriptosaurus-002816.en: Bay window at the side of the front door

descriptosaurus-002818.zh: 精心雕刻的白色百叶窗

descriptosaurus-002824.zh: 巨大的，肮脏的，摇摇欲坠的地方

descriptosaurus-002828.en: Pile of stones and shattered walls

descriptosaurus-002829.zh: 摇摇欲坠的烟囱和悬挂的排水沟

descriptosaurus-002834.en: Only ragged traces of glass in the windows
descriptosaurus-002834.zh: 只有窗户里有破烂的玻璃痕迹

descriptosaurus-002836.en: Situated at the end of a narrow dirt track
descriptosaurus-002836.zh: 位于一条狭窄的土路的尽头

descriptosaurus-002837.zh: 建在一个宁静的避风港

descriptosaurus-002839.zh: 被陌生而险恶的乡村包围

descriptosaurus-002840.en: Set right in the heart of the forest

descriptosaurus-002841.en: Located in the centre of the town

descriptosaurus-002842.en: On the outskirts of the city

descriptosaurus-002846.en: Made out of great, stone slabs

descriptosaurus-002850.zh: 用优雅的百叶窗框起来

descriptosaurus-002851.en: Flanked by a sweetly scented herb garden
descriptosaurus-002851.zh: 旁边是一个香味浓郁的药草园

descriptosaurus-002852.zh: 被金银花和茉莉花闷死

descriptosaurus-002856.zh: 从腐烂的窗台中伸出来

descriptosaurus-002858.en: As if gnawed by hundreds of starving rats
descriptosaurus-002858.zh: 仿佛被数百只饥饿的老鼠啃过

descriptosaurus-002860.en: The wooden hunting lodge was set right in the heart of the forest.
descriptosaurus-002860.zh: 木制狩猎小屋位于森林的中心。

descriptosaurus-002861.en: She lived in an old, terraced cottage at the end of a narrow dirt track.
descriptosaurus-002861.zh: 她住在一条狭窄的土路尽头的一座古老的梯田小屋里。

descriptosaurus-002862.en: The farmhouse was over four hundred years old.
descriptosaurus-002862.zh: 农舍已有四百多年的历史。

descriptosaurus-002863.en: It was made out of great stone slabs and had a red tiled roof.
descriptosaurus-002863.zh: 它由巨大的石板制成，并有一个红色的瓷砖屋顶。

descriptosaurus-002864.en: She lived in a street of terraced Victorian houses, each with a bay window at the side of the front door.
descriptosaurus-002864.zh: 她住在维多利亚时代的街道上，前门的一侧都有一个凸窗。

descriptosaurus-002865.en: The red-brick manor house was set in ten acres of woodland.
descriptosaurus-002865.zh: 红砖庄园位于十英亩的林地中。

descriptosaurus-002866.en: It was a tall, imposing house and its numerous towers made it look like a fortress.
descriptosaurus-002866.zh: 这是一座高大而壮观的房子，它众多的塔楼使它看起来像一座堡垒。

descriptosaurus-002867.en: The hotel was a modern glass and metal building, ten storeys high.
descriptosaurus-002867.zh: 酒店是一座现代化的玻璃和金属建筑，高十层。

descriptosaurus-002868.en: The modern, semi-detached house was in a quiet cul-de-sac and shielded from the road by a line of pine trees.
descriptosaurus-002868.zh: 这座现代化的半独立式房屋位于一个安静的死胡同中，并被一排松树挡住了道路。

descriptosaurus-002869.en: They had rented an impressive single-storey villa.
descriptosaurus-002869.zh: 他们租了一栋令人印象深刻的单层别墅。

descriptosaurus-002870.en: Its front was painted peach and the windows were framed by carved white shutters.
descriptosaurus-002870.zh: 它的正面被漆成桃子，窗户由雕刻的白色百叶窗框住。

descriptosaurus-002871.en: It was a charming, inviting home with an arched wooden porch covered in honeysuckle and flanked by a sweetly scented herb garden.
descriptosaurus-002871.zh: 这是一个迷人的、诱人的家，有一个拱形木门廊，上面覆盖着金银花，两侧是一个香味浓郁的药草园。

descriptosaurus-002873.en: It was a pile of stones, shattered walls and empty, gaping window frames.
descriptosaurus-002873.zh: 那是一堆石头、破碎的墙壁和空荡荡的窗框。

descriptosaurus-002875.en: It was the type of place that made people quicken their step as they passed.
descriptosaurus-002875.zh: 正是这种地方让人们在经过时加快了脚步。

descriptosaurus-002876.en: Ivy clasped the walls of the house and curled through the roof.
descriptosaurus-002876.zh: 常春藤紧紧地抱住了房子的墙壁，蜷缩在屋顶上。

descriptosaurus-002877.en: It was a rickety old cottage with dark green moss spreading across the walls like mould on bread.
descriptosaurus-002877.zh: 那是一座摇摇晃晃的旧小屋，深绿色的苔藓在墙壁上蔓延开来，就像面包上的霉菌一样。

descriptosaurus-002879.en: Its stonework was decayed and crumbling, its windows boarded up, paint peeling and sills rotting.
descriptosaurus-002879.zh: 它的石制品腐烂和摇摇欲坠，窗户被木板封住，油漆剥落和窗台腐烂。

descriptosaurus-002880.en: It was a huge, dirty, ramshackle place, with broken windows and a roof that leaked like a colander.
descriptosaurus-002880.zh: 这是一个巨大、肮脏、摇摇欲坠的地方，窗户破碎，屋顶像漏勺一样泄漏。

descriptosaurus-002881.en: Only ragged traces of glass remained in the windows – sharp spears jutting out of rotting sills.
descriptosaurus-002881.zh: 窗户上只剩下破烂的玻璃痕迹——锋利的长矛从腐烂的窗台上伸出来。

descriptosaurus-002883.en: Its crumbling chimneys and hanging gutters were clogged with rotting leaves and the walls were pitted, as if they had been gnawed by hundreds of starving rats.
descriptosaurus-002883.zh: 它摇摇欲坠的烟囱和悬挂的排水沟被腐烂的树叶堵塞，墙壁被坑了，就好像它们被数百只饥饿的老鼠啃咬一样。

descriptosaurus-002934.en: Led to a door with stained-glass panels
descriptosaurus-002934.zh: 通向带有彩色玻璃面板的门

descriptosaurus-002935.en: Led from the yard into the main part of the house
descriptosaurus-002935.zh: 从院子里引到房子的主要部分

descriptosaurus-002938.en: Opened out onto a large hall

descriptosaurus-002940.en: The entrance was blocked by a metal gate carved with ancient symbols.
descriptosaurus-002940.zh: 入口处被一扇刻有古符号的金属门挡住了。

descriptosaurus-002941.en: The heavy, metal door opened out onto a vast, wood-panelled hall.
descriptosaurus-002941.zh: 沉重的金属门通向一个巨大的木板大厅。

descriptosaurus-002942.en: The front step was set deep in the wall and led to a door with stained-glass panels.
descriptosaurus-002942.zh: 前面的台阶深深地设置在墙上，通向一扇带有彩色玻璃面板的门。

descriptosaurus-002943.en: A steel-shuttered door towered above them and rattled in the wind.
descriptosaurus-002943.zh: 一扇铁门高耸于他们之上，随风而动。

descriptosaurus-002944.en: They went through a heavy, oak door, which led from the courtyard into the main part of the house.
descriptosaurus-002944.zh: 他们穿过一扇沉重的橡木门，从庭院通向房子的主要部分。

descriptosaurus-002945.en: Where the path ended, they were faced by a low, ancient-looking door studded with sharp, black nails.
descriptosaurus-002945.zh: 小路结束的地方，他们面对着一扇低矮的、古老的门，上面镶嵌着锋利的黑色指甲。

descriptosaurus-002986.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-002987.zh: 狭窄的楼梯的黑暗飞行

descriptosaurus-002996.zh: 抛光的白色大理石地板

descriptosaurus-003000.en: Ahead was a flight of stairs

descriptosaurus-003001.en: Led up to the first floor

descriptosaurus-003003.zh: 进入一个广阔的入口大厅

descriptosaurus-003005.en: Swept dramatically down to the entrance hall
descriptosaurus-003005.zh: 戏剧性地向下扫到入口大厅

descriptosaurus-003008.zh: 每个角落都改变了方向

descriptosaurus-003009.en: Steeped in a thick, eerie darkness
descriptosaurus-003009.zh: 沉浸在浓密、怪异的黑暗中

descriptosaurus-003010.en: Wind tore through the draughty corridor

descriptosaurus-003012.en: The door opened onto a long, dimly lit corridor.
descriptosaurus-003012.zh: 门通向一条长长的昏暗走廊。

descriptosaurus-003013.en: The wooden stairs spiralled their way to the rooms upstairs.
descriptosaurus-003013.zh: 木制楼梯螺旋式地向楼上的房间走去。

descriptosaurus-003014.en: The glass doors opened out onto a lobby of polished white marble.
descriptosaurus-003014.zh: 玻璃门通向抛光的白色大理石大厅。

descriptosaurus-003015.en: Her feet sunk into the luxurious red carpet.
descriptosaurus-003015.zh: 她的脚沉入奢华的红地毯。

descriptosaurus-003016.en: The wide staircase swept dramatically down to the entrance hall.
descriptosaurus-003016.zh: 宽阔的楼梯大大扫到了入口大厅。

descriptosaurus-003017.en: They went up the stone steps into the vast, echoing entrance hall.
descriptosaurus-003017.zh: 他们走上石阶进入广阔的回声大厅。

descriptosaurus-003018.en: She was faced with a long corridor steeped in a thick, eerie darkness.
descriptosaurus-003018.zh: 她面对着一条长长的走廊，被厚厚的、怪异的黑暗所笼罩。

descriptosaurus-003019.en: He had entered a narrow hallway and ahead of him was a flight of stairs leading up to the first floor.
descriptosaurus-003019.zh: 他进入了一条狭窄的走廊，前面是一条通往一楼的楼梯。

descriptosaurus-003020.en: A bitter wind tore through the draughty corridors and rattled the windows.
descriptosaurus-003020.zh: 一阵狂风吹过拖曳的走廊，使窗户嘎嘎作响。

descriptosaurus-003021.en: The staircase was dark and gloomy and every step she took was followed by a creaking echo.
descriptosaurus-003021.zh: 楼梯又黑又阴沉，她走的每一步都伴随着吱吱作响的回声。

descriptosaurus-003022.en: The spiral stairs twisted and turned sharply, changing direction at every corner.
descriptosaurus-003022.zh: 螺旋楼梯扭曲和急转，每个角落都改变了方向。

descriptosaurus-003114.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-003117.en: Large, modern kitchen of glass and metal
descriptosaurus-003117.zh: 玻璃和金属的大型现代厨房

descriptosaurus-003118.en: Wooden beams and a stone floor

descriptosaurus-003123.zh: 闪闪发光，擦洗和抛光的木头

descriptosaurus-003135.en: Cloud of dust hung over everything

descriptosaurus-003146.en: Furnished with a huge oak table and sideboard
descriptosaurus-003146.zh: 配有一张巨大的橡木桌子和餐具柜

descriptosaurus-003150.en: Crackling fire sealed the room against the rain outside
descriptosaurus-003150.zh: 噼啪作响的火把房间封住了外面的雨水

descriptosaurus-003154.en: Covered with a layer of crawling damp and mould
descriptosaurus-003154.zh: 覆盖一层爬行的潮湿和模具

descriptosaurus-003155.en: Curtains closed, dirty dishes piled high in the sink
descriptosaurus-003155.zh: 窗帘关上了，脏盘子高高地堆在水槽里

descriptosaurus-003162.en: Bathed in a strange, orange light from the streetlamps
descriptosaurus-003162.zh: 沐浴在路灯的奇怪橙色光中

descriptosaurus-003165.en: Eyes watched and ears listened in the shadows
descriptosaurus-003165.zh: 眼睛在阴影中注视着耳朵

descriptosaurus-003167.en: The room was light and homely.

descriptosaurus-003168.en: The large, rectangular kitchen had wooden beams and a stone floor.
descriptosaurus-003168.zh: 大而矩形的厨房有木梁和石头地板。

descriptosaurus-003169.en: It was a small, cosy lounge with a low, sloping ceiling.
descriptosaurus-003169.zh: 这是一个小而舒适的休息室，天花板很低，很低。

descriptosaurus-003170.en: The study had a wooden floor and was painted cream.
descriptosaurus-003170.zh: 书房有一块木地板，被漆成奶油色。

descriptosaurus-003171.en: The high-ceilinged dining room was furnished with a huge oak table and sideboard.
descriptosaurus-003171.zh: 高天花板的餐厅配有一张巨大的橡木桌子和餐具柜。

descriptosaurus-003172.en: The room was a relaxing haven, furnished with comfy, deep leather couches and large floor cushions.
descriptosaurus-003172.zh: 房间是一个休闲的避风港，配有舒适的深皮沙发和大地板靠垫。

descriptosaurus-003173.en: A fire crackled in the open fireplace, making the living room a snug retreat from the grey, hissing veil of rain outside.
descriptosaurus-003173.zh: 一团火在敞开的壁炉里响起，使客厅从灰色的、嘶嘶作响的雨幕中撤退。

descriptosaurus-003174.en: The kitchen was a warm, welcoming room of gleaming, scrubbed and polished wood.
descriptosaurus-003174.zh: 厨房是一个温暖、温馨的房间，里面有闪闪发光、擦洗和抛光的木头。

descriptosaurus-003175.en: The furniture was old and battered and the carpet dirty and torn.
descriptosaurus-003175.zh: 家具又旧又破，地毯又脏又被撕裂。

descriptosaurus-003176.en: The light flickered as if the bulbs were coming to the end of their days.
descriptosaurus-003176.zh: 灯光闪烁，好像灯泡快到了他们的日子。

descriptosaurus-003177.en: The old house was dark and forbidding.
descriptosaurus-003177.zh: 老房子是黑暗和令人生畏的。

descriptosaurus-003178.en: The only sign of life was a torn curtain hanging across one of the upstairs windows.
descriptosaurus-003178.zh: 唯一的生命迹象是挂在楼上一扇窗户上的窗帘。

descriptosaurus-003179.en: The ground was so thick with rats that it seemed to be covered in a carpet of writhing hair.
descriptosaurus-003179.zh: 地上到处都是老鼠，似乎被一根扭动的头发覆盖着。

descriptosaurus-003180.en: A buzzing strip light hung from the ceiling.
descriptosaurus-003180.zh: 天花板上挂着一道嗡嗡声。

descriptosaurus-003181.en: Its casing was peppered with the bodies of dead flies.
descriptosaurus-003181.zh: 它的外壳上布满了死蝇的尸体。

descriptosaurus-003182.en: The big house was dusty and bare.
descriptosaurus-003182.zh: 大房子里尘土飞扬，光秃秃的。

descriptosaurus-003183.en: All the stairs and corners were secretive places, covered in cobwebs.
descriptosaurus-003183.zh: 所有的楼梯和角落都是秘密的地方，上面覆盖着蜘蛛网。

descriptosaurus-003184.en: A place of shadows and whispers.

descriptosaurus-003185.en: It may have once been a pleasant, comfortable room, but damp, dirt, disuse, mice and spiders had made it their home.
descriptosaurus-003185.zh: 它可能曾经是一个愉快、舒适的房间，但潮湿、污垢、废弃物、老鼠和蜘蛛已经把它变成了他们的家。

descriptosaurus-003186.en: The windows were dirty and smeared with a layer of crawling damp and mould, and only a gloomy light could filter into the room.
descriptosaurus-003186.zh: 窗户脏兮兮的，沾满了一层潮湿和模具的爬行，只有一道阴暗的光线才能透进房间。

descriptosaurus-003187.en: There was a wild, overgrown feel to the place, which made it easy to imagine the spirits of the dead haunting it.
descriptosaurus-003187.zh: 这个地方有一种狂野的杂草丛生的感觉，这让人们很容易想象死者的灵魂在它中萦绕。

descriptosaurus-003188.en: He imagined eyes watching him, ears listening.
descriptosaurus-003188.zh: 他想象着眼睛看着他，耳朵在听。

descriptosaurus-003189.en: It appeared that no-one had lived in the house for some time.
descriptosaurus-003189.zh: 似乎没有人在这所房子里住过一段时间。

descriptosaurus-003190.en: The wallpaper was torn and peeling, the carpet threadbare, the lights shimmering with cobwebs, and a cloud of dust hung over everything.
descriptosaurus-003190.zh: 壁纸被撕裂和剥落，地毯破旧，灯光闪烁着蜘蛛网，灰尘云笼罩着一切。

descriptosaurus-003191.en: The place was in chaos – curtains closed; dirty dishes piled high in the sink; rubbish spilling out of the bin; books, papers and clothes scattered and crumpled.
descriptosaurus-003191.zh: 这个地方一片混乱——窗帘关上了； 脏盘子堆在水槽高处； 垃圾从垃圾箱中溢出； 书籍、纸张和衣服散落和皱巴巴的。

descriptosaurus-003256.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-003258.en: Rim of pale pink on the eastern horizon
descriptosaurus-003258.zh: 东方地平线上淡粉色的边缘

descriptosaurus-003259.en: Glorious explosion of pink and yellow
descriptosaurus-003259.zh: 粉红色和黄色的光荣爆炸

descriptosaurus-003260.zh: 粉红色的云彩像糖果丝

descriptosaurus-003261.zh: 数以百万计的钻石像钻石

descriptosaurus-003264.en: Crystal patterns on the icy windows

descriptosaurus-003267.zh: 垂死的月光和上升的雾气

descriptosaurus-003269.zh: 灌木丛仍然是墨黑色的

descriptosaurus-003270.en: Rising sun like the mouth of an enormous, blazing tunnel
descriptosaurus-003270.zh: 像一条巨大的、炽热的隧道的嘴

descriptosaurus-003271.en: Clinging dew like a shimmering spider’s web
descriptosaurus-003271.zh: 像闪烁的蜘蛛网一样紧贴露水

descriptosaurus-003274.en: Sky changed to orange and then to red
descriptosaurus-003274.zh: 天空变成橙色，然后变成红色

descriptosaurus-003275.en: Exploded in a blaze of pink and gold
descriptosaurus-003275.zh: 在粉红色和金色的火焰中爆炸

descriptosaurus-003276.en: Forest bathed in dawn’s first rays
descriptosaurus-003276.zh: 沐浴在黎明的第一道光芒的森林

descriptosaurus-003281.zh: 鸟儿在树梢上沙沙作响

descriptosaurus-003282.en: Nature came to welcome the new day
descriptosaurus-003282.zh: 大自然来迎接新的一天

descriptosaurus-003283.en: Time of day when nothing moves
descriptosaurus-003283.zh: 一天中什么都没有移动的时间

descriptosaurus-003284.en: Things crept out of the darkness

descriptosaurus-003285.en: Washed with a ghostly, silver light

descriptosaurus-003286.en: Horizon was aflame with the rising sun

descriptosaurus-003287.en: Clinging dew bent the blades of grass
descriptosaurus-003287.zh: 紧贴露水 弯曲草叶

descriptosaurus-003289.en: A rim of pale pink had formed on the eastern horizon.
descriptosaurus-003289.zh: 东方地平线上形成了淡粉色的边缘。

descriptosaurus-003290.en: The first rays of morning sunlight were an alarm call for the forest.
descriptosaurus-003290.zh: 早晨的第一缕阳光是森林的警报。

descriptosaurus-003291.en: The sky changed to orange and then red, and the sun rose in a glorious explosion of pink and gold.
descriptosaurus-003291.zh: 天空变成了橙色，然后变成了红色，太阳升起，粉红色和金色的光彩爆炸。

descriptosaurus-003292.en: The morning light stroked the hedges and glittered on the dew-soaked leaves.
descriptosaurus-003292.zh: 清晨的光线抚摸着树篱，在露水浸透的树叶上闪闪发光。

descriptosaurus-003293.en: Crystal patterns frosted the early morning windows and glittered like starlight on the roofs.
descriptosaurus-003293.zh: 清晨的水晶图案结霜，像屋顶上的星光一样闪闪发光。

descriptosaurus-003294.en: As the sun rose, millions of sparkles like diamonds burst out onto the water, making it dance and shimmer.
descriptosaurus-003294.zh: 随着太阳的升起，数以百万计的钻石像钻石一样喷洒在水面上，让它起舞并闪闪发光。

descriptosaurus-003295.en: Birds moved in the treetops, branches swayed and leaves rustled as nature greeted the sun and the new day.
descriptosaurus-003295.zh: 鸟儿在树梢上移动，树枝摇曳，树叶在大自然迎接太阳和新的一天时沙沙作响。

descriptosaurus-003296.en: As the first calls of the dawn chorus echoed across the land, the eerie, damp gloom of the night was replaced by the soft light of dawn.
descriptosaurus-003296.zh: 当黎明合唱的第一次呼唤在大地上回荡时，黑夜阴森森的阴霾被黎明的柔和光芒所取代。

descriptosaurus-003297.en: The next morning dawned misty and damp.
descriptosaurus-003297.zh: 第二天早上，雾蒙蒙的，湿漉漉的。

descriptosaurus-003298.en: The dawn streets were washed in a ghostly, silver light.
descriptosaurus-003298.zh: 黎明的街道被幽灵般的银光冲刷。

descriptosaurus-003299.en: The clinging dew bent the shivering blades of grass.
descriptosaurus-003299.zh: 紧贴的露水弯曲了草颤抖的草叶。

descriptosaurus-003300.en: The dew spread from blade to blade, clinging to the grass and hedges like a shimmering spider’s web.
descriptosaurus-003300.zh: 露水从叶片到叶片蔓延开来，像闪闪发光的蜘蛛网一样紧贴草地和树篱。

descriptosaurus-003301.en: It was that dim, grey hour when things were just creeping out of darkness, the bushes still inky black, and the sky colourless and cheerless.
descriptosaurus-003301.zh: 那是那个昏暗的灰色时刻，事情刚刚从黑暗中爬出来，灌木仍然是漆黑的黑色，天空无色无色。

descriptosaurus-003302.en: Just visible on the eastern horizon, the rising sun was like the mouth of an enormous blazing tunnel.
descriptosaurus-003302.zh: 就在东方地平线上可见，初升的太阳就像一条巨大的炽热隧道的河口。

descriptosaurus-003350.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-003355.zh: 像蓬松的棉球一样的云

descriptosaurus-003364.en: Screaming frenzy of rain and thunder

descriptosaurus-003365.en: Angry crimson lines like wounds in the sky
descriptosaurus-003365.zh: 愤怒的深红色线条像天空中的伤口

descriptosaurus-003366.en: Sun was a dim, pale eye, behind a socket of grey haze
descriptosaurus-003366.zh: 太阳是一只昏暗的、苍白的眼睛，在一个灰色的阴霾插座后面

descriptosaurus-003368.en: Grey of dawn replaced by a clear, blue sky
descriptosaurus-003368.zh: 黎明的灰色被晴朗的蓝天所取代

descriptosaurus-003369.en: Clouds drifted slowly across the sky

descriptosaurus-003370.en: Sun blazed beneath the clouds in a golden haze
descriptosaurus-003370.zh: 太阳在云层下燃烧着金色的阴霾

descriptosaurus-003374.en: Moon swung between light and an eerie gloom
descriptosaurus-003374.zh: 月亮在光线和怪异的阴影之间摇摆

descriptosaurus-003375.en: Clouds rushed at him like the crest of a killer wave
descriptosaurus-003375.zh: 云朵像杀手般的波峰一样冲向他

descriptosaurus-003377.en: Wispy white clouds dotted the vivid blue sky.
descriptosaurus-003377.zh: 纤细的白云点缀着鲜艳的蓝天。

descriptosaurus-003378.en: Clouds, like fluffy cotton balls, drifted slowly across the sky.
descriptosaurus-003378.zh: 云，像蓬松的棉球，在天空中缓慢飘过。

descriptosaurus-003379.en: Beams of light tinted the clouds with blazing colours of red and amber.
descriptosaurus-003379.zh: 光束用红色和琥珀色的炽热色彩照亮了云彩。

descriptosaurus-003380.en: The rain had passed and the grey sky was lit by a glorious rainbow.
descriptosaurus-003380.zh: 雨已经过去了，灰色的天空被一道灿烂的彩虹照亮了。

descriptosaurus-003381.en: Great, icy grey mountains of cloud glided like mist over the ground.
descriptosaurus-003381.zh: 大而冰冷的灰色云层像雾一样滑过地面。

descriptosaurus-003382.en: The sky was as grey as a thunder cloud and grim with the menace of rain.
descriptosaurus-003382.zh: 天空像雷云一样灰蒙蒙的，带着雨水的威胁。

descriptosaurus-003383.en: The moon swung between light and an eerie gloom, as the dense, black rain clouds drifted across the sky.
descriptosaurus-003383.zh: 月亮在光线和怪异的阴霾之间摇摆，浓密的黑色雨云在天空中飘荡。

descriptosaurus-003384.en: The clouds had swollen and grown an ominous black, rushing at him like the crest of a killer wave, threatening to drown him in their stormy embrace.
descriptosaurus-003384.zh: 云层肿胀，变成了不祥的黑色，像杀手般的波峰一样冲向他，威胁要淹死在他们暴风雨的怀抱中。

descriptosaurus-003456.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-003461.zh: 像天上的火焰一样燃烧的星星

descriptosaurus-003463.en: Night air like a warm blanket
descriptosaurus-003463.zh: 像温暖的毯子一样的夜间空气

descriptosaurus-003466.en: Eerie, silver light of the full moon
descriptosaurus-003466.zh: 令人毛骨悚然，满月的银光

descriptosaurus-003468.en: Darkness on either side of the torch was like a wall
descriptosaurus-003468.zh: 火炬两侧的黑暗就像一堵墙

descriptosaurus-003479.zh: 像钻石项链一样闪闪发光

descriptosaurus-003485.en: Like a blanket putting out a candle

descriptosaurus-003486.en: Inky fingers of darkness clung to his ankles
descriptosaurus-003486.zh: 黑暗的手指紧贴着他的脚踝

descriptosaurus-003487.en: Moon was drowned in heavy clouds
descriptosaurus-003487.zh: 月亮淹没在厚厚的云层中

descriptosaurus-003488.en: Cast leafy shadows on the ground
descriptosaurus-003488.zh: 在地上投下绿树成荫的阴影

descriptosaurus-003489.en: Bathed the land in a ghostly reflection of daylight
descriptosaurus-003489.zh: 沐浴在阳光的幽灵般的反射中

descriptosaurus-003490.en: Only a fleeting glimpse of the full moon to guide them
descriptosaurus-003490.zh: 只有短暂的一瞥满月引导他们

descriptosaurus-003491.en: Hid what might lay behind the trees, watching and waiting
descriptosaurus-003491.zh: 隐藏树后可能出现的东西，看着和等待

descriptosaurus-003492.zh: 充满了危险的、闪烁的阴影

descriptosaurus-003495.en: Shimmered in the distance like ghostly eyes
descriptosaurus-003495.zh: 像幽灵般的眼睛在远处闪烁

descriptosaurus-003497.en: Brought the fear of the invisible predator
descriptosaurus-003497.zh: 带来了隐形捕食者的恐惧

descriptosaurus-003498.en: Imagined all sorts of terrors lurking in the misty night
descriptosaurus-003498.zh: 想象着潜伏在雾蒙蒙的夜晚的各种恐怖

descriptosaurus-003500.en: The moon washed the land in a gentle light.
descriptosaurus-003500.zh: 月亮以温和的光线冲洗了这片土地。

descriptosaurus-003501.en: The last rays of the sun painted the hills with a hazy, golden mist.
descriptosaurus-003501.zh: 最后一道阳光照在山上，一股朦胧的金色雾气。

descriptosaurus-003502.en: The stars glittered like a diamond necklace in the black, velvet sky.
descriptosaurus-003502.zh: 星星在黑色天鹅绒天空中像钻石项链一样闪闪发光。

descriptosaurus-003503.en: The night was pierced in thousands of places with sparkling, rainbowcoloured light.
descriptosaurus-003503.zh: 夜晚在成千上万的地方被闪闪发光，彩虹色的光芒刺穿。

descriptosaurus-003504.en: The day had been hot and the night sky lay like a warm blanket over the land.
descriptosaurus-003504.zh: 白天很热，夜空像一条温暖的毯子一样覆盖着大地。

descriptosaurus-003505.en: There was no moon, but the sky was lit up by the blazing stars cascading out of the night sky.
descriptosaurus-003505.zh: 没有月亮，但天空被从夜空中倾泻而出的炽热的星星照亮了。

descriptosaurus-003506.en: Although the sun had gone and dusk was falling, there was still some heat left from the day and the forest glowed with a gentle warmth.
descriptosaurus-003506.zh: 虽然太阳已经消失，黄昏正在下山，但白天还剩下一些热量，森林散发出温柔的温暖。

descriptosaurus-003507.en: The moon was drowned in heavy clouds.
descriptosaurus-003507.zh: 月亮淹没在厚厚的云层中。

descriptosaurus-003508.en: The ground was full of dangerous, flitting shadows.
descriptosaurus-003508.zh: 地面上充满了危险的、闪烁的阴影。

descriptosaurus-003509.en: The trunks of the trees were framed against the moon like the bars of a prison.
descriptosaurus-003509.zh: 树干像监狱的酒吧一样被围在月亮上。

descriptosaurus-003510.en: The approach of dusk brought the secretive, nocturnal creatures gliding into the night.
descriptosaurus-003510.zh: 黄昏的临近，将那些神秘的夜行动物滑入黑夜。

descriptosaurus-003511.en: The sun fell like a sinking stone and a black cloak was drawn across the sky.
descriptosaurus-003511.zh: 太阳像一块下沉的石头一样落下，天空中画着一条黑色的斗篷。

descriptosaurus-003512.en: The moon glowed behind the clouds and bathed the land in a ghostly reflection of daylight.
descriptosaurus-003512.zh: 月亮在云层后面发光，将大地沐浴在日光的幽灵般的倒影中。

descriptosaurus-003513.en: There was a small circle of light from the torch, but either side was like a wall of darkness.
descriptosaurus-003513.zh: 火炬上有一小圈光，但两边就像一堵黑暗的墙。

descriptosaurus-003514.en: The shadows of the trees seemed to lean towards each other, whispering in the silence.
descriptosaurus-003514.zh: 树的阴影似乎互相倾斜，在寂静中低语。

descriptosaurus-003515.en: The trees stood silent and dark, hiding what might lay behind, watching and waiting.
descriptosaurus-003515.zh: 树木寂静而黑暗，隐藏着可能存在的东西，看着和等待。

descriptosaurus-003516.en: They only had a fleeting glimpse of the moon to guide them as it scudded across the horizon, appearing briefly from behind the dark clouds.
descriptosaurus-003516.zh: 当月亮在地平线上飞驰而过时，他们只是短暂地瞥见了月亮来引导他们，从乌云的后面短暂地出现。

descriptosaurus-003517.en: The air seemed to be quivering with anticipation as a curtain of darkness was drawn across the sky, bringing with it the fear of an invisible predator.
descriptosaurus-003517.zh: 空气似乎在期待中颤抖着，一道黑暗的窗帘被卷入天空，带来了对无形捕食者的恐惧。

descriptosaurus-003518.en: The beam from the light cast a thin strip of flickering light in front of him, whilst behind the inky fingers of darkness clung to his heels.
descriptosaurus-003518.zh: 光的光束在他面前投射出一条闪烁的光线，而黑暗的手指后面则紧贴着他的脚跟。

descriptosaurus-003617.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-003620.en: One of those spring days when ...

descriptosaurus-003624.zh: 风铃草铺成一片绚烂的花毯

descriptosaurus-003625.en: Flowers were like piles of jewels

descriptosaurus-003626.zh: 清新的绿色装饰的春天

descriptosaurus-003629.en: Vibrant sights and sounds of spring
descriptosaurus-003629.zh: 充满活力的景象和春天的声音

descriptosaurus-003636.en: Waking world of new growth and colour
descriptosaurus-003636.zh: 清醒的新增长和色彩世界

descriptosaurus-003645.zh: 装饰冬天的光秃秃的树枝

descriptosaurus-003647.zh: 像一堆珠宝一样堆积如山

descriptosaurus-003648.en: Sprinkled tiny diamonds on the rivers

descriptosaurus-003649.en: Stretched as far as the eye could see

descriptosaurus-003653.en: Lurched unsteadily on their new legs
descriptosaurus-003653.zh: 不稳地在他们的新腿上蹒跚而行

descriptosaurus-003655.en: She was enveloped by the vivid, sparkling treasures of spring.
descriptosaurus-003655.zh: 她被春天的生动、闪闪发光的宝藏包围着。

descriptosaurus-003656.en: Bracken and ferns unfurled and stretched.
descriptosaurus-003656.zh: 蕨菜和蕨类植物展开并拉伸。

descriptosaurus-003657.en: Creepers crawled out of hiding in search of the sun.
descriptosaurus-003657.zh: 爬行者爬出来寻找太阳。

descriptosaurus-003658.en: The scent of the bluebells was flung like wafts of perfume into the air.
descriptosaurus-003658.zh: 风的气味像一股香水一样飘向空中。

descriptosaurus-003659.en: The forest floor was a carpet of bluebells dancing in the breeze.
descriptosaurus-003659.zh: 森林地面是一片风铃草在微风中跳舞的地毯。

descriptosaurus-003660.en: They were welcomed by wave after wave of the gently nodding heads of daffodils.
descriptosaurus-003660.zh: 他们受到了轻轻点头的水仙花的一波又一波的欢迎。

descriptosaurus-003661.en: Winter had relaxed its grip and the world was waking to new growth, colour and sound.
descriptosaurus-003661.zh: 冬天放松了它的控制，世界正在唤醒新的成长、色彩和声音。

descriptosaurus-003662.en: The colours of spring shouted and sang – rubies and emeralds, sapphires and opals.
descriptosaurus-003662.zh: 春天的色彩大喊大叫——红宝石和祖母绿、蓝宝石和蛋白石。

descriptosaurus-003663.en: The ground was erupting with emerald shoots, woken from their wintry slumber.
descriptosaurus-003663.zh: 大地爆发了翡翠的芽，从寒冷的沉睡中醒来。

descriptosaurus-003664.en: Crocuses smiled their greeting and tulips waved as they pushed their way towards the sun.
descriptosaurus-003664.zh: 番红花微笑着问候，郁金香挥舞着，向太阳推去。

descriptosaurus-003665.en: It was as if, overnight, nature had painted the hills in reds, yellows and greens and sprinkled tiny diamonds on the rivers to shimmer and dance in the fresh morning sun.
descriptosaurus-003665.zh: 就好像一夜之间，大自然把山丘漆成了红色、黄色和绿色，在河流上撒上小钻石，在清新的晨光中闪闪发光。

descriptosaurus-003666.en: Squirrels scampered up the trees to the melody of the songbirds marking their territory.
descriptosaurus-003666.zh: 松鼠爬上树木，听着标志着它们领土的鸣禽的旋律。

descriptosaurus-003667.en: Magpies rushed to hide their stolen treasure in the fresh, green cloak covering winter’s bare branches.
descriptosaurus-003667.zh: 喜鹊冲着把他们偷来的宝藏藏在覆盖着冬天光秃秃的树枝的新鲜绿色斗篷中。

descriptosaurus-003668.en: The fields were full of lambs, calves and foals lurching unsteadily on their new legs.
descriptosaurus-003668.zh: 田野里到处都是羔羊、小牛和小马驹，它们的新腿上摇摇晃晃地摇晃着。

descriptosaurus-003669.en: Hidden in the branches, the open, anxious beaks of the baby sparrows pushed their way out of the nest.
descriptosaurus-003669.zh: 隐藏在树枝上的小麻雀的开阔而焦虑的喙从巢穴中挤出。

descriptosaurus-003772.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-003774.zh: 闪烁的蓝色，令人眼花缭乱

descriptosaurus-003781.en: Air thick with the scent of honeysuckle
descriptosaurus-003781.zh: 充满金银花香味的空气

descriptosaurus-003788.en: Spikes of yellow and white flowers

descriptosaurus-003790.en: Pink and white of blossoming trees
descriptosaurus-003790.zh: 盛开的树木的粉红色和白色

descriptosaurus-003792.en: Golden corn, red poppies and yellow gorse
descriptosaurus-003792.zh: 金色玉米、红罂粟和黄色金雀花

descriptosaurus-003798.en: Sun’s merciless heat like an invisible hammer
descriptosaurus-003798.zh: 太阳的无情热像一把无形的锤子

descriptosaurus-003800.en: Blazed from a clear, blue sky

descriptosaurus-003802.en: Bathed the room in a brilliant light
descriptosaurus-003802.zh: 在明亮的灯光下为房间沐浴

descriptosaurus-003804.en: Painted the hills with a hazy, golden mist
descriptosaurus-003804.zh: 用朦胧的金色迷雾画山

descriptosaurus-003806.en: Shimmered over the fields in a haze

descriptosaurus-003807.en: Trees fluttered in the warm breeze
descriptosaurus-003807.zh: 在温暖的微风中飘扬的树木

descriptosaurus-003808.en: Tickled his face like a feather
descriptosaurus-003808.zh: 像羽毛一样挠着他的脸

descriptosaurus-003809.en: Splashed with red poppies and yellow gorse
descriptosaurus-003809.zh: 溅上红色罂粟花和黄色金黄色

descriptosaurus-003810.en: Alive with splashes of red and bright orange berries
descriptosaurus-003810.zh: 活着的红色和鲜橙色浆果的飞溅

descriptosaurus-003811.zh: 覆盖着一层紫色的石南花

descriptosaurus-003813.en: Hung in masses from vivid green stems
descriptosaurus-003813.zh: 用生动的绿色茎成群结队地悬挂

descriptosaurus-003820.en: Drifted through the air in a misty haze
descriptosaurus-003820.zh: 在朦胧的阴霾中飘过空气

descriptosaurus-003823.zh: 安顿在他汗流浃背的身体上

descriptosaurus-003826.zh: 起泡了他们的嘴唇和皮肤

descriptosaurus-003827.en: Mouth was parched and skin dry

descriptosaurus-003829.en: Cowered under the hammer blow of the sun’s glare
descriptosaurus-003829.zh: 被太阳眩光的锤击而畏缩

descriptosaurus-003830.en: Every bit of moisture had been stolen by the sun
descriptosaurus-003830.zh: 每一点水分都被太阳偷走了

descriptosaurus-003832.en: The sky was a shimmering, dazzling blue.
descriptosaurus-003832.zh: 天空是一片闪闪发光的蓝色。

descriptosaurus-003833.en: Red blossoms hung in masses from vivid green stems.
descriptosaurus-003833.zh: 红色的花朵大量悬挂在生动的绿色茎上。

descriptosaurus-003834.en: The golden corn was splashed with red poppies and yellow gorse.
descriptosaurus-003834.zh: 金色的玉米上溅满了红色罂粟花和黄色的金雀花。

descriptosaurus-003835.en: The hedge was alive with splashes of red and bright orange berries and the hills cloaked with purple heather.
descriptosaurus-003835.zh: 树篱充满了红色和明亮的橙色浆果，山丘上覆盖着紫色的石南花。

descriptosaurus-003836.en: The sun poured in through the windows and bathed the room in a brilliant light.
descriptosaurus-003836.zh: 太阳从窗户倾泻而出，在房间里沐浴在明亮的光线下。

descriptosaurus-003837.en: The sun blazed from a cloudless sky and millions of sparkles, like diamonds, glittered on the water.
descriptosaurus-003837.zh: 太阳从无云的天空中闪耀，数以百万计的闪光如钻石在水面上闪闪发光。

descriptosaurus-003838.en: The sun’s rays drenched the forest and painted the hills with a hazy, golden mist.
descriptosaurus-003838.zh: 太阳的光芒淹没了森林，在山上涂上了一层朦胧的金色雾气。

descriptosaurus-003839.en: The gentle breeze tickled his face like a feather and brought with it the smell of freshly mown grass.
descriptosaurus-003839.zh: 微风像羽毛一样在他的脸上挠痒痒，带来了新鲜割草的气味。

descriptosaurus-003840.en: The air around him was filled with the scent of honeysuckle and the symphony of joyous birdsong.
descriptosaurus-003840.zh: 他周围的空气充满了金银花的香味和欢乐的鸟鸣的交响曲。

descriptosaurus-003841.en: Among the clicking of crickets and the lazy humming of bees, the aroma of barbecued food lingered in the air.
descriptosaurus-003841.zh: 在蟋蟀的咔哒声和蜜蜂的懒洋洋的嗡嗡声中，烧烤食物的香气在空气中徘徊。

descriptosaurus-003842.en: It was stifling hot and the air was still.

descriptosaurus-003843.en: The hot, wet air was like an invisible hammer pounding at his senses.
descriptosaurus-003843.zh: 炎热潮湿的空气就像一把无形的锤子敲打着他的感官。

descriptosaurus-003844.en: The sun’s rays crashed down fiercely on his eyes and blinded him with its dazzling glare.
descriptosaurus-003844.zh: 太阳的光芒猛烈地落在他的眼睛上，用耀眼的眩光使他失明。

descriptosaurus-003845.en: The humid air coiled itself around him and settled on his sweating body.
descriptosaurus-003845.zh: 潮湿的空气盘旋在他周围，并在他汗流浃背的身体上安定下来。

descriptosaurus-003846.en: The searing sun blinded them and blistered their lips and skin.
descriptosaurus-003846.zh: 灼热的太阳使他们失明，并使他们的嘴唇和皮肤起泡。

descriptosaurus-003847.en: The sun beat down on her, stealing the moisture from her mouth and sapping her strength.
descriptosaurus-003847.zh: 太阳照在她身上，从她嘴里偷走了水分，削弱了她的力量。

descriptosaurus-003848.en: The sun’s merciless heat bounced off the rocks and soaked into the land, until the earth itself seemed to burn.
descriptosaurus-003848.zh: 太阳无情的热量从岩石中反弹，浸入大地，直到地球本身似乎燃烧。

descriptosaurus-003849.en: The mid-afternoon sun burned like a furnace and everything in its path cowered and withered under its hammer blow.
descriptosaurus-003849.zh: 午后的阳光像熔炉一样燃烧，它的道路上的一切都在锤击下畏缩了。

descriptosaurus-003850.en: As the sun rose, the temperature soared, until she was suffocating in the intolerable heat.
descriptosaurus-003850.zh: 随着太阳升起，温度飙升，直到她在无法忍受的热量中窒息。

descriptosaurus-003851.en: The forest was a hot, steamy, churning chaos; the heat clinging to the trees and drifting through the air in a misty haze.
descriptosaurus-003851.zh: 森林是一片炎热、潮湿、翻腾的混乱； 热量粘在树木上，在雾气中飘荡在空气中。

descriptosaurus-003876.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-003879.en: In their suits of red and gold
descriptosaurus-003879.zh: 在他们的红色和金色西装中

descriptosaurus-003881.zh: 像蓬松的棉球一样的云

descriptosaurus-003890.en: The branches were painted with autumn’s crisp leaves of green and yellow, gold and red.
descriptosaurus-003890.zh: 树枝上画着秋天的绿色和黄色、金色和红色的清脆叶子。

descriptosaurus-003891.en: The leaves on the trees were dressed in their suits of red and gold.
descriptosaurus-003891.zh: 树上的叶子都穿着红色和金色的西装。

descriptosaurus-003892.en: The rays of sunlight burst through the storm and painted a glorious rainbow over the grey sky.
descriptosaurus-003892.zh: 阳光透过暴风雨，在灰色的天空中喷射出一道灿烂的彩虹。

descriptosaurus-003893.en: The trees danced in the brisk breeze, whilst their crackling leaves rushed across the ground.
descriptosaurus-003893.zh: 树木在微风中翩翩起舞，而噼啪作响的树叶则冲过地面。

descriptosaurus-003894.en: Above her, clouds like fluffy cotton balls drifted across the sky and, below, autumn’s crisp leaves crunched under her feet.
descriptosaurus-003894.zh: 在她上方，像蓬松的棉球一样的云飘过天空，下面，秋天清脆的叶子在她的脚下嘎吱作响。

descriptosaurus-003959.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-003961.zh: 冰霜，闪闪发光的人行道

descriptosaurus-003964.zh: 像钻石项链一样闪闪发光

descriptosaurus-003966.en: White and shimmering on the hills

descriptosaurus-003967.en: Delicate showers like tiny pieces of lace
descriptosaurus-003967.zh: 精致的淋浴，像小块的花边

descriptosaurus-003968.en: Smell of pine needles and cinnamon

descriptosaurus-003969.en: Freezing breath in clouds around them
descriptosaurus-003969.zh: 在他们周围的云中冻结呼吸

descriptosaurus-003971.en: Savage, bone-crushing cold like the jaws of a vice
descriptosaurus-003971.zh: 像虎钳的下巴一样野蛮，骨折的寒冷

descriptosaurus-003972.en: No horizon to the white world

descriptosaurus-003980.en: Fell from the branches in delicate showers
descriptosaurus-003980.zh: 在微妙的淋浴间从树枝上掉下来

descriptosaurus-003981.en: Sprinkled the ground like a white dust

descriptosaurus-003984.en: Glittered like starlight on the roofs
descriptosaurus-003984.zh: 像屋顶上的星光一样闪闪发光

descriptosaurus-003985.en: Breath smoked in the freezing air
descriptosaurus-003985.zh: 在冰冷的空气中冒着烟熏的气息

descriptosaurus-003986.en: Savage cold took their breath away
descriptosaurus-003986.zh: 野蛮的寒冷让他们屏住呼吸

descriptosaurus-003987.zh: 像酸一样烫伤他们的皮肤

descriptosaurus-003988.en: Sunk its teeth into his bones
descriptosaurus-003988.zh: 把它的牙齿埋进他的骨头里

descriptosaurus-003990.en: Heaped over the fields and buildings
descriptosaurus-003990.zh: 堆积在田野和建筑物上

descriptosaurus-003992.en: Trapped in a white, whirling wall of flakes
descriptosaurus-003992.zh: 被困在一片白色的、旋转的薄片中

descriptosaurus-003993.en: Bowed their heads and buried their feet

descriptosaurus-003994.en: Struggled to see in the wind-whipped snow
descriptosaurus-003994.zh: 在风吹过的雪中挣扎着看

descriptosaurus-004001.en: The snow lay white and shimmering on the distant hills.
descriptosaurus-004001.zh: 雪白在远处的山丘上闪闪发光。

descriptosaurus-004002.en: They woke up to a fairytale world cloaked in snow.
descriptosaurus-004002.zh: 他们醒来，发现了一个被雪遮住的童话世界。

descriptosaurus-004003.en: The frost glittered like a diamond necklace on the spider’s web.
descriptosaurus-004003.zh: 霜像蜘蛛网上的钻石项链一样闪闪发光。

descriptosaurus-004004.en: Crystal patterns frosted the early morning windows and glittered like starlight on the roofs.
descriptosaurus-004004.zh: 清晨的水晶图案结霜，像屋顶上的星光一样闪闪发光。

descriptosaurus-004005.en: Snow fell like tiny pieces of lace and sprinkled the ground like a white dust.
descriptosaurus-004005.zh: 雪像小块的花边一样落下，像白尘一样洒在地上。

descriptosaurus-004006.en: Icicles hung from the trees like crystal earrings, whilst the snow made a crisp carpet beneath her feet.
descriptosaurus-004006.zh: 冰柱像水晶耳环一样挂在树上，而雪在她的脚下铺了一层清脆的地毯。

descriptosaurus-004007.en: As they passed underneath, the snow, too heavy for the branches, fell in delicate showers on their heads.
descriptosaurus-004007.zh: 当他们从下面经过时，雪太重了，不适合树枝，在他们的头上落下了微妙的阵雨。

descriptosaurus-004008.en: Their breath was in clouds around them.
descriptosaurus-004008.zh: 他们的呼吸在他们周围的云层中。

descriptosaurus-004009.en: The ferocity of the cold took their breath away.
descriptosaurus-004009.zh: 寒冷的凶猛让他们大吃一惊。

descriptosaurus-004010.en: There was no horizon to the white world.

descriptosaurus-004011.en: It was a billowy, white ocean blending into the sky.
descriptosaurus-004011.zh: 那是一片波涛汹涌的白色海洋，融入了天空。

descriptosaurus-004012.en: The bitter wind rubbed against her ankles and scattered the leaves in front of her.
descriptosaurus-004012.zh: 苦风吹着她的脚踝，散落在她面前的叶子。

descriptosaurus-004013.en: The snow created a thick, muffled silence and fell with a muted thump.
descriptosaurus-004013.zh: 雪形成了厚厚的沉默，并以柔和的砰砰声倒下。

descriptosaurus-004014.en: The savage, bone-crushing cold sank its teeth into his bones and gnawed away from the inside.
descriptosaurus-004014.zh: 野蛮的，骨头破碎的寒冷将牙齿咬进了他的骨头，从里面啃了下来。

descriptosaurus-004015.en: They were trapped in a white, whirling wall of flakes that bowed their heads and buried their feet.
descriptosaurus-004015.zh: 他们被困在一堵白色的、旋转的薄片墙中，低下头，埋葬了他们的脚。

descriptosaurus-004016.en: The village looked wild and strange under the snow, which blanketed the fields and buildings and lay in piles on the dark road.
descriptosaurus-004016.zh: 村子在雪地下看起来狂野而陌生，覆盖着田野和建筑物，在黑暗的道路上成堆地躺着。

descriptosaurus-004017.en: The trees were ice sculptures, with long icicles that fell like daggers.
descriptosaurus-004017.zh: 树木是冰雕，长长的冰柱像匕首一样落下。

descriptosaurus-004018.en: They were surrounded by ice, which cracked and growled under their weight, until eventually it split like a lightning bolt.
descriptosaurus-004018.zh: 他们被冰块包围，在他们的重量下破裂和咆哮，直到最终它像闪电一样裂开。

descriptosaurus-004078.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-004084.en: Like a steady downpour of tears
descriptosaurus-004084.zh: 像是一阵持续倾盆大雨的泪水

descriptosaurus-004091.en: Drawn by the wind into an icy curtain

descriptosaurus-004092.en: Pelted the trees and beat on the bushes
descriptosaurus-004092.zh: 向树上打了个脚，打在灌木丛中

descriptosaurus-004093.en: Scattered showers of blossoms onto the ground

descriptosaurus-004094.en: Dripped from every fern and leaf like the tick of a very slow clock
descriptosaurus-004094.zh: 像一个非常慢的时钟的滴答声，从每棵蕨类植物和叶子上滴下来

descriptosaurus-004095.en: Grass shivered in the freezing rain

descriptosaurus-004096.en: Drove along the road like smoke
descriptosaurus-004096.zh: 像烟雾一样沿着马路行驶

descriptosaurus-004098.en: Exploded like spots of ink on the windowsill
descriptosaurus-004098.zh: 像窗台上的墨点一样爆炸

descriptosaurus-004102.en: Chilly stream poured down his neck

descriptosaurus-004105.en: The first, heavy drops of rain had started to fall Drops the size of bullets hammered at the windows.
descriptosaurus-004105.zh: 第一个，大雨开始落下，落在窗户上的子弹大小。

descriptosaurus-004106.en: Layers of pregnant clouds clung to the mountain and blanketed the forest.
descriptosaurus-004106.zh: 一层层怀孕的云层紧贴着山，覆盖了森林。

descriptosaurus-004107.en: The rain was hammering down and a chilly stream poured down his face.
descriptosaurus-004107.zh: 雨水冲了下来，一股冰冷的溪流从他的脸上倾泻而下。

descriptosaurus-004108.en: The trees flinched and the grass shivered in the freezing rain.
descriptosaurus-004108.zh: 树木退缩了，草在冰冷的雨中颤抖着。

descriptosaurus-004109.en: Melting chips of ice hammered on his head and face, and streamed down the back of his neck.
descriptosaurus-004109.zh: 融化的冰块砸在他的头和脸上，从他的脖子后面流了下来。

descriptosaurus-004110.en: The dancing hail hung in a cloud and drove along the road like smoke.
descriptosaurus-004110.zh: 跳舞的冰雹挂在云中，像烟雾一样沿着马路行驶。

descriptosaurus-004111.en: The rain was a steady downpour of tears, crashing to earth and spreading darkness and damp.
descriptosaurus-004111.zh: 雨水不断倾盆大雨，落到大地，蔓延黑暗和潮湿。

descriptosaurus-004112.en: The puddles jumped to life as pellets of water drummed the surface.
descriptosaurus-004112.zh: 水坑在水面上鼓起，水坑跳跃起来。

descriptosaurus-004113.en: The downpour had flooded the gutters.
descriptosaurus-004113.zh: 倾盆大雨淹没了排水沟。

descriptosaurus-004114.en: Even after the rain had stopped, water dripped like the tick of a very slow clock.
descriptosaurus-004114.zh: 即使在雨停了之后，水也像一个非常慢的时钟滴答作响。

descriptosaurus-004157.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-004162.en: Mist was like an icy breath

descriptosaurus-004169.en: Blanketed everything like a padded quilt
descriptosaurus-004169.zh: 像衬垫被子一样覆盖所有东西

descriptosaurus-004173.en: Flicked its tongue into every gap
descriptosaurus-004173.zh: 把舌头伸进每一个缝隙

descriptosaurus-004174.en: Prowled and slithered over their feet
descriptosaurus-004174.zh: 在他们的脚上徘徊和滑行

descriptosaurus-004175.en: Covered his feet and muffled all sound
descriptosaurus-004175.zh: 遮住了他的脚，把所有的声音都闷住了

descriptosaurus-004176.en: Drifted up from the soggy soil
descriptosaurus-004176.zh: 从湿漉漉的土壤中漂流

descriptosaurus-004177.en: Filled the air with its slinky, grey arms
descriptosaurus-004177.zh: 用紧身灰色的手臂填满空气

descriptosaurus-004178.en: Twisted the trees into monstrous shapes
descriptosaurus-004178.zh: 将树木扭曲成可怕的形状

descriptosaurus-004179.en: Waited a moment and then slipped back along the path
descriptosaurus-004179.zh: 等了一会儿，然后沿着小路滑回去

descriptosaurus-004180.en: Hung like a stilled breath on everything that it touched
descriptosaurus-004180.zh: 像静止的呼吸一样挂在它所触及的一切上

descriptosaurus-004182.en: There was a blanket of grey mist floating above the grass.
descriptosaurus-004182.zh: 草地上飘着一层灰色的雾气。

descriptosaurus-004183.en: The mist rose and spread to fill the air with its slinky, grey arms.
descriptosaurus-004183.zh: 薄雾升起并蔓延开来，用它紧身的灰色手臂填满了空气。

descriptosaurus-004184.en: The mist was like an icy breath descending from the mountain.
descriptosaurus-004184.zh: 雾气像是从山上降下来的冰冷的气息。

descriptosaurus-004185.en: The fog blanketed everything like a padded quilt.
descriptosaurus-004185.zh: 雾气像衬垫被子一样覆盖了一切。

descriptosaurus-004186.en: The wind moaned and howled like a ghostly spirit and dragged with it a veil of stinging mist from the river.
descriptosaurus-004186.zh: 风像幽灵般的灵魂呻吟和嚎叫，随之拖出河流中的刺痛雾气。

descriptosaurus-004187.en: A brooding mist crept low along the ground, prowling around them, slithering over their feet.
descriptosaurus-004187.zh: 一股沉思的雾气沿着地面缓缓爬行，在他们周围徘徊，滑过他们的脚。

descriptosaurus-004188.en: Coils of mist drifted up from the soggy soil and hung like a stilled breath on everything they touched.
descriptosaurus-004188.zh: 一圈雾气从湿漉漉的土壤中飘出，像静止的呼吸一样悬在他们所触摸的一切上。

descriptosaurus-004189.en: A damp, yellow fog hung over the park and twisted the trees into monstrous shapes.
descriptosaurus-004189.zh: 公园上方一片潮湿的黄色雾气将树木扭曲成可怕的形状。

descriptosaurus-004190.en: The fog crept up on the house like a ghostly serpent, slid along the window, flicked its tongue into the corners of the house, waited a moment and then slipped back along the path.
descriptosaurus-004190.zh: 雾气像一条幽灵般的蛇一样爬上屋子，沿着窗户滑落，把舌头滑进房子的角落，等了片刻，然后沿着小路滑回去。

descriptosaurus-004269.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-004287.en: Bent the branches and stole their leaves
descriptosaurus-004287.zh: 弯下树枝，偷走他们的叶子

descriptosaurus-004289.en: Rushed through the grass and chased the leaves in circles
descriptosaurus-004289.zh: 冲过草地，围着树叶转了一圈

descriptosaurus-004290.en: Rattled the bare branches of the shivering trees
descriptosaurus-004290.zh: 颤抖着树枝上的光秃秃的树枝

descriptosaurus-004291.en: Tore the clouds like a shredded veil
descriptosaurus-004291.zh: 像撕碎的面纱一样撕裂云层

descriptosaurus-004292.en: Darkened the air with billowing clouds of dust
descriptosaurus-004292.zh: 用滚滚的尘土使空气变暗

descriptosaurus-004296.en: Beat like a fist against the roof

descriptosaurus-004299.en: Tore at his clothes with its invisible fingers
descriptosaurus-004299.zh: 用无形的手指撕裂他的衣服

descriptosaurus-004301.en: Struggled to stay on his feet

descriptosaurus-004302.en: Wind shoved, pulled, tugged at him ferociously
descriptosaurus-004302.zh: 风猛地推着，拉着，猛地拉着他

descriptosaurus-004303.en: Tried to lift the skin from his bones and the hair from his head
descriptosaurus-004303.zh: 试图从他的骨头和头上的头发上提起皮肤

descriptosaurus-004304.zh: 叹了口气，在他们身上呻吟着

descriptosaurus-004305.zh: 诡异的风叹了口气，低声说道

descriptosaurus-004307.en: Branches creaked eerily in the breeze
descriptosaurus-004307.zh: 树枝在微风中诡异地吱吱作响

descriptosaurus-004308.zh: 像生锈的铰链一样磨碎在一起

descriptosaurus-004310.zh: 像沸腾的水壶一样尖叫

descriptosaurus-004312.en: The gentle breeze tickled his face like a feather.
descriptosaurus-004312.zh: 微微的微风像羽毛一样在他的脸上发痒。

descriptosaurus-004313.en: The leaves waved gently in the breeze.
descriptosaurus-004313.zh: 叶子在微风中轻轻挥动。

descriptosaurus-004314.en: A welcome breeze sprang up and brought relief from the burning heat.
descriptosaurus-004314.zh: 迎来一阵微风，缓解了燃烧的热量。

descriptosaurus-004315.en: The warm, gentle breeze stirred their hair and caressed their faces.
descriptosaurus-004315.zh: 温暖的微风拂过他们的头发，抚摸着他们的脸。

descriptosaurus-004316.en: The stammering gusts tore the clouds like a shredded veil.
descriptosaurus-004316.zh: 结结巴巴的阵风像撕碎的面纱一样撕裂了云层。

descriptosaurus-004317.en: The car rocked and shuddered under the force of the wind.
descriptosaurus-004317.zh: 汽车在风的力量下摇晃着，颤抖着。

descriptosaurus-004318.en: The branches quivered as they were stabbed by the wind.
descriptosaurus-004318.zh: 树枝被风刺伤时颤抖着。

descriptosaurus-004320.en: It screamed over the house and beat like a fist against the roof.
descriptosaurus-004320.zh: 它在房子上尖叫，像拳头一样敲打着屋顶。

descriptosaurus-004321.en: The wind was lashing against the windows and hammering at the glass.
descriptosaurus-004321.zh: 风吹在窗户上，敲打着玻璃。

descriptosaurus-004322.en: The wind whined through the trees and bent the tops of the branches.
descriptosaurus-004322.zh: 风吹过树林，弯曲着树枝的顶部。

descriptosaurus-004323.en: A breath of wind ghosted past him, tickling his ear like a feather and making the skin at the back of his neck prickle with foreboding.
descriptosaurus-004323.zh: 一阵风从他身边掠过，他的耳朵像羽毛一样发痒，让他脖子后面的皮肤因不祥而刺痛。

descriptosaurus-004324.en: The trunks arched in the swirling wind, which bent their branches and stole their leaves.
descriptosaurus-004324.zh: 树干在旋转的风中拱起，弯曲着树枝，偷走了叶子。

descriptosaurus-004325.en: The wind screamed like a boiling kettle as it blustered around the house.
descriptosaurus-004325.zh: 风像沸腾的水壶一样在屋子里咆哮。

descriptosaurus-004326.en: He staggered back and forth, side to side, struggling to stay on his feet, as the wind shoved and tugged at him fiercely, hunting him like a beast.
descriptosaurus-004326.zh: 他左右摇摇晃晃地来回摇摇晃晃地站着，挣扎着站着，风猛地推着他，像野兽一样猛烈地追着他。

descriptosaurus-004359.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-004367.en: Struggled and howled in fits and starts
descriptosaurus-004367.zh: 时而挣扎，时而断断续续地呼啸。

descriptosaurus-004371.en: Tore the night sky apart and ripped its belly
descriptosaurus-004371.zh: 撕裂夜空并撕裂它的肚子

descriptosaurus-004372.en: Blinded him as it flickered in and out
descriptosaurus-004372.zh: 把他弄瞎了，因为它进进出出

descriptosaurus-004374.en: Streaked through the streets like an exploding firework
descriptosaurus-004374.zh: 像爆炸的烟花一样在街道上划过

descriptosaurus-004376.en: Thunder rumbled ominously and then crashed and howled overhead.
descriptosaurus-004376.zh: 雷声不祥地响起，然后在头顶坠毁并呼啸而过。

descriptosaurus-004377.en: The thunder rumbled closer and closer, the lightning followed almost immediately.
descriptosaurus-004377.zh: 雷声越来越近，闪电几乎立刻跟在了一起。

descriptosaurus-004378.en: An immense guillotine blade of lightning streaked across the horizon and illuminated it with a stark blue-whiteness.
descriptosaurus-004378.zh: 一道巨大的断头台闪电划过地平线，用鲜明的蓝白色照亮了它。

descriptosaurus-004379.en: Thunder boomed through the house, shaking it to its core, and streaking through the streets like an exploding firework.
descriptosaurus-004379.zh: 雷声在房子里轰隆一声，摇晃着它的核心，像爆炸的烟花一样在街道上划过。

descriptosaurus-004380.en: Lightning tore through the sky, blinding him as it flickered in and out.
descriptosaurus-004380.zh: 闪电在天空中撕裂，当它闪烁时，他把他弄瞎了。

descriptosaurus-004381.en: Suddenly, dazzling arrows of lightning tore the night sky apart, ripping its belly and flooding the land.
descriptosaurus-004381.zh: 突然，耀眼的闪电之箭撕裂了夜空，撕裂了它的肚子，淹没了大地。

descriptosaurus-004382.en: It was as if the heavens were being torn apart by the jagged spears of lightning – the thunder howling their pain.
descriptosaurus-004382.zh: 就好像天空被锯齿状的闪电长矛撕裂了——雷声在呼啸而过。

descriptosaurus-004481.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-004485.en: Warm, sweet, pungent smell of coffee
descriptosaurus-004485.zh: 温暖、甜美、刺鼻的咖啡气味

descriptosaurus-004488.en: Scent of orange and lemon blossoms

descriptosaurus-004490.en: Flowers and spices from around the world
descriptosaurus-004490.zh: 来自世界各地的鲜花和香料

descriptosaurus-004493.zh: 消毒剂和抛光剂的气味

descriptosaurus-004504.en: Thick, rancid smell of warm petrol
descriptosaurus-004504.zh: 温暖的汽油浓浓的酸臭味

descriptosaurus-004505.en: Overwhelming smell of rotten fish and cat’s urine
descriptosaurus-004505.zh: 腐烂的鱼和猫尿的压倒性气味

descriptosaurus-004512.en: Air was thick with the scent of ...
descriptosaurus-004512.zh: 空气很浓，散发着浓浓的气息……

descriptosaurus-004516.en: Came from the rotting bin bags

descriptosaurus-004518.en: Gave off a smell of rot and decaying corpses
descriptosaurus-004518.zh: 散发出腐烂和腐烂的尸体的味道

descriptosaurus-004519.en: Seeped from the damp, mouldy curtains
descriptosaurus-004519.zh: 从潮湿、发霉的窗帘中渗出

descriptosaurus-004524.en: Caught in the back of her throat

descriptosaurus-004525.zh: 遮住他们的鼻子和嘴巴

descriptosaurus-004528.en: The air was thick with the scent of honeysuckle.
descriptosaurus-004528.zh: 空气中弥漫着金银花的香味。

descriptosaurus-004529.en: The warm air was scented with rosemary and orange blossom.
descriptosaurus-004529.zh: 温暖的空气散发着迷迭香和橙花的香味。

descriptosaurus-004530.en: The lavender bush wafted its scent in through the open window.
descriptosaurus-004530.zh: 薰衣草灌木从敞开的窗户吹来了它的香味。

descriptosaurus-004531.en: They were surrounded by the perfume of the honeysuckle that clung to the oak tree.
descriptosaurus-004531.zh: 他们被粘在橡树上的金银花的香水包围着。

descriptosaurus-004532.en: It was as if all the flowers and spices of the world had been blended together and tossed in the air.
descriptosaurus-004532.zh: 就好像世界上所有的花朵和香料都被混合在一起，被抛在空中。

descriptosaurus-004533.en: Wafting in the air was the sweet smell of roasting vegetables and chicken.
descriptosaurus-004533.zh: 飘在空中的是烤蔬菜和鸡肉的甜味。

descriptosaurus-004534.en: The fragrance of freshly mown grass and tree blossoms drifted towards her.
descriptosaurus-004534.zh: 鲜嫩的草和树花的香味飘向她。

descriptosaurus-004535.en: The kitchen was filled with the warm, sweet aroma of coffee brewing.
descriptosaurus-004535.zh: 厨房里充满了咖啡冲泡的温暖、甜美的香气。

descriptosaurus-004536.en: The smell of pine needles and cinnamon filled the room with the scents of Christmas.
descriptosaurus-004536.zh: 松针和肉桂的气味充满了圣诞节的气味。

descriptosaurus-004537.en: She needed to leave the room to escape the smell of dust and mould.
descriptosaurus-004537.zh: 她需要离开房间以逃避灰尘和霉菌的气味。

descriptosaurus-004538.en: A stench of rottenness and decay wafted up from the darkness and stung his nostrils.
descriptosaurus-004538.zh: 一股腐烂和腐烂的恶臭从黑暗中飘起，刺痛了他的鼻孔。

descriptosaurus-004539.en: Even the plants seemed to give off a smell of rot and decaying corpses.
descriptosaurus-004539.zh: 甚至植物似乎也散发出腐烂和腐烂尸体的气味。

descriptosaurus-004540.en: As he opened the trunk, a dank, musty smell was released into the cold air.
descriptosaurus-004540.zh: 当他打开后备箱时，一股潮湿的霉味被释放到冷空气中。

descriptosaurus-004541.en: Her stomach churned, as the revolting smell of rotten fish drifted towards her.
descriptosaurus-004541.zh: 她的胃在翻腾，腐烂的鱼的气味飘向她。

descriptosaurus-004542.en: The thick, rancid smell of warm petrol dogged the air and caught in the back of their throats.
descriptosaurus-004542.zh: 温暖的汽油浓浓的、酸酸的气味使空气中的气味阻碍了空气，并卡在了他们的喉咙后部。

descriptosaurus-004543.en: They covered their nose and mouth to block out the putrefying smell of rotting meat.
descriptosaurus-004543.zh: 他们遮住了鼻子和嘴巴，以阻挡腐烂肉的腐烂气味。

descriptosaurus-004544.en: A pungent smell of rotting rubbish came from the bulging bin bags, rancid in the heat and crawling with termites.
descriptosaurus-004544.zh: 一股刺鼻的腐烂垃圾的气味来自膨胀的垃圾袋，在高温下腐烂并爬上白蚁。

descriptosaurus-004545.en: Clutching her hand to her mouth, she bent over and retched violently.
descriptosaurus-004545.zh: 她把手抱在嘴边，弯下腰，猛烈地干呕。

descriptosaurus-004546.en: She coughed and retched as the putrefying smell of decaying flesh wafted towards her.
descriptosaurus-004546.zh: 她咳嗽着干呕，腐肉的腐烂气味扑面而来。

descriptosaurus-004683.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-004699.zh: 冰冷的呼吸贴在他的脸上

descriptosaurus-004705.en: Burning heat of the sun on her arms
descriptosaurus-004705.zh: 太阳在她手臂上燃烧的热量

descriptosaurus-004711.zh: 从燃烧的热量中解脱出来

descriptosaurus-004715.en: Tore at his face and hands

descriptosaurus-004718.en: Clutched him in their thorny grasp
descriptosaurus-004718.zh: 在他们棘手的手中抓住他

descriptosaurus-004725.zh: 像酸一样烫伤她的皮肤

descriptosaurus-004726.en: Sank its teeth into her bones
descriptosaurus-004726.zh: 把它的牙齿塞进她的骨头里

descriptosaurus-004727.en: Gripped him like a clenched fist
descriptosaurus-004727.zh: 像紧握的拳头一样抓住他

descriptosaurus-004729.en: Enveloped her like a damp towel

descriptosaurus-004732.en: The rock was as smooth as polished slate.
descriptosaurus-004732.zh: 岩石像抛光的石板一样光滑。

descriptosaurus-004733.en: The hand that held his was as smooth as velvet.
descriptosaurus-004733.zh: 握着他的手像天鹅绒一样光滑。

descriptosaurus-004734.en: A breath of wind, like rippling silk, tickled his ear.
descriptosaurus-004734.zh: 一阵风，如丝绸般的丝绸，在他的耳朵里挠痒痒。

descriptosaurus-004735.en: As the wind rose, she wrapped the warm, woollen coat tightly around her.
descriptosaurus-004735.zh: 随着风的升起，她将温暖的羊毛外套紧紧地包裹在她身上。

descriptosaurus-004736.en: The cold water of the pool was a welcome relief from the burning heat.
descriptosaurus-004736.zh: 游泳池的冷水是从燃烧的热量中解脱出来的一个可喜的缓解。

descriptosaurus-004737.en: The coat was rough and scratched at his skin.
descriptosaurus-004737.zh: 外套粗糙，划伤他的皮肤。

descriptosaurus-004738.en: Her feet slipped on the squelching mud and she was sent tumbling into the murky water.
descriptosaurus-004738.zh: 她的脚滑落在柔和的泥浆上，她被送入浑浊的水中。

descriptosaurus-004739.en: Something sleek and slimy slithered over his shoe and plucked at his ankle.
descriptosaurus-004739.zh: 有什么光滑而粘糊糊的东西滑过他的鞋子，抓住了他的脚踝。

descriptosaurus-004740.en: The jagged edges of the gate tore his hand as he pushed it open.
descriptosaurus-004740.zh: 当他推开时，大门的锯齿状边缘撕裂了他的手。

descriptosaurus-004741.en: He ducked, as a swish of wings rushed through the air and the invisible predator brushed his head with its furry body.
descriptosaurus-004741.zh: 他躲开了，一阵翅膀在空中冲过，无形的捕食者用毛茸茸的身体擦了擦头。

descriptosaurus-004742.en: The prickly spines tangled in his clothes, clutching him in their thorny grasp.
descriptosaurus-004742.zh: 刺绣在他的衣服上的刺刺，抓住他的棘手抓握着他。

descriptosaurus-004743.en: His hand touched something at the bottom of the bag; something slimy, like a dead fish.
descriptosaurus-004743.zh: 他的手摸了摸袋子底部的东西； 粘稠的东西，像一条死鱼。

descriptosaurus-004744.en: He crashed through the trees on the shore of the lake, but was held by the creeping, slimy water plants that crawled down the hillside and trapped his legs.
descriptosaurus-004744.zh: 他在湖岸上的树木上坠毁，但被爬下山坡并困住他的腿的爬行、粘糊糊的水生植物抱住了。

descriptosaurus-004745.en: The chill air rubbed at her legs.
descriptosaurus-004745.zh: 寒冷的空气在她的腿上摩擦。

descriptosaurus-004746.en: The hot, wet air enveloped her like a damp towel.
descriptosaurus-004746.zh: 潮湿的空气像湿毛巾一样包裹着她。

descriptosaurus-004747.en: The hot fingers of dust clawed all over them.

descriptosaurus-004748.en: It was a savage, bone-crushing cold that scalded his skin like acid.
descriptosaurus-004748.zh: 那是一种野蛮、骨折的寒冷，像酸一样把他的皮肤烫伤。

descriptosaurus-004749.en: She felt the heat of the sun on her exposed arms – a burning, stinging heat.
descriptosaurus-004749.zh: 她感觉到太阳的热量在她裸露的手臂上——燃烧着刺痛的热量。

descriptosaurus-004750.en: Robert could feel the icy breath on the back of his neck.
descriptosaurus-004750.zh: 罗伯特能感觉到脖子后面冰冷的呼吸。

descriptosaurus-004751.en: Shivers ran down his spine, as if he had been touched by acid.
descriptosaurus-004751.zh: 颤抖着从他的脊椎上跑下来，仿佛被酸感触到了。

descriptosaurus-004752.en: As she inhaled, the dry air hurt her nose and burnt her nostrils.
descriptosaurus-004752.zh: 当她吸入时，干燥的空气会伤害她的鼻子，烧伤她的鼻孔。

descriptosaurus-004832.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-004833.zh: 轻柔的，喃喃自语的声音

descriptosaurus-004841.en: Birds singing, insects humming, butterflies hovering
descriptosaurus-004841.zh: 鸟儿歌唱，昆虫嗡嗡作响，蝴蝶盘旋

descriptosaurus-004842.en: Gentle rhythm of frogs and nocturnal insects
descriptosaurus-004842.zh: 青蛙和夜间昆虫的温柔节奏

descriptosaurus-004846.en: Gentle roll of the waves on the shore
descriptosaurus-004846.zh: 岸边的海浪轻轻的滚动

descriptosaurus-004850.en: Sounds of spring drifted through the air
descriptosaurus-004850.zh: 春天的声音在空气中飘荡
