descriptosaurus-004854.zh: 昆虫在花朵周围嗡嗡作响

descriptosaurus-004855.zh: 小牛为他们的母亲大喊大叫

descriptosaurus-004858.zh: 短暂而突然的翅膀飞舞

descriptosaurus-004859.en: Wind chimes clinked in the breeze

descriptosaurus-004861.en: Hum of the fridge, whirr of the washing machine, gurgle of the pipes
descriptosaurus-004861.zh: 冰箱的嗡嗡声，洗衣机的呼呼声，管道的咯咯声

descriptosaurus-004863.en: The air was full of soft, murmuring sounds.
descriptosaurus-004863.zh: 空气中充满了柔和的低语声。

descriptosaurus-004864.en: The room was quiet except for the crackling of the fire.
descriptosaurus-004864.zh: 除了火的噼啪声，房间里很安静。

descriptosaurus-004865.en: The dusk birdsong was suddenly silenced and replaced by the gentle rhythm of frogs and nocturnal insects.
descriptosaurus-004865.zh: 黄昏鸟鸣突然沉默，取而代之的是青蛙和夜间昆虫的柔和节奏。

descriptosaurus-004866.en: The garden was full of sound – birds singing, insects humming and dragonflies darting.
descriptosaurus-004866.zh: 花园里充满了声音——鸟儿唱歌，昆虫嗡嗡作响，蜻蜓飞奔。

descriptosaurus-004867.en: The air around him was bright and cheerful, filled with the sound of lapping water and a symphony of joyous birdsong.
descriptosaurus-004867.zh: 他周围的空气明亮而欢快，充满了拍打水的声音和欢乐的鸟鸣的交响曲。

descriptosaurus-004868.en: The silence was broken by the whisper of a soft breeze through the trees and the rustle of nature creeping into the sun.
descriptosaurus-004868.zh: 寂静被轻微的微风吹过树木和大自然的沙沙声打破。

descriptosaurus-004869.en: They sat in the shade of the majestic oak tree and lounged lazily to the sound of humming bees, sizzling grasshoppers and clicking crickets.
descriptosaurus-004869.zh: 他们坐在雄伟的橡树树荫下，懒洋洋地悠闲地躺着，听到蜂拥而至的蜂鸣声、炙热的蚱蜢和咔哒声。

descriptosaurus-004870.en: The familiar sounds of the house reassured him – the hum of the fridge, whirr of the washing machine and gurgle of pipes in the airing cupboard.
descriptosaurus-004870.zh: 房子熟悉的声音让他放心——冰箱的嗡嗡声、洗衣机的呼啸声和通风柜里的管道发出的咯咯声。

descriptosaurus-004871.en: Everywhere, the sounds of spring pierced the air – calves bawling and lambs bleating, calling for their mothers.
descriptosaurus-004871.zh: 到处都是春天的声音——小牛大喊大叫，羔羊在呼喊，呼唤着他们的母亲。

descriptosaurus-004872.en: In the distance he could hear the bubble and trickle of a stream as it danced down the slopes.
descriptosaurus-004872.zh: 在远处，他能听到一股小溪的泡沫和细小的水流，沿着斜坡跳舞。

descriptosaurus-004905.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-004913.en: Old house was silent and secretive

descriptosaurus-004914.en: No sound, just a dark, eerie gloom
descriptosaurus-004914.zh: 没有声音，只是黑暗，怪异的阴暗

descriptosaurus-004915.zh: 只有她自己喘不过气来的呼吸

descriptosaurus-004917.en: Surrounded by a wall of silence

descriptosaurus-004921.en: Wrapped around them like a thick blanket
descriptosaurus-004921.zh: 像一条厚毯子一样包裹着他们

descriptosaurus-004924.en: As if the world was holding its breath

descriptosaurus-004925.en: Quiet of something waiting in the dark
descriptosaurus-004925.zh: 在黑暗中等待的东西的安静

descriptosaurus-004926.en: Made them feel isolated from the rest of the world
descriptosaurus-004926.zh: 让他们感到与世界其他地方隔绝

descriptosaurus-004927.en: Moved in a silence of anxiety and suspense
descriptosaurus-004927.zh: 在焦虑和悬念的沉默中感动

descriptosaurus-004929.en: The room had gone very quiet.

descriptosaurus-004930.en: It was as if time had stopped.

descriptosaurus-004931.en: The old house was silent and secretive.
descriptosaurus-004931.zh: 老房子是寂静而神秘的。

descriptosaurus-004933.en: He was surrounded by a wall of silence.
descriptosaurus-004933.zh: 他被一堵沉默的墙包围着。

descriptosaurus-004934.en: There was a deep silence, as if they were in a padded room.
descriptosaurus-004934.zh: 一片寂静，仿佛他们在一个软垫的房间里。

descriptosaurus-004936.en: The silence of something waiting in the dark, holding its breath.
descriptosaurus-004936.zh: 在黑暗中等待的东西的寂静，屏住了呼吸。

descriptosaurus-004937.en: When the echoes had died away, there was only silence thudding in her ears.
descriptosaurus-004937.zh: 当回声消失时，她的耳朵里只有寂静。

descriptosaurus-004939.en: A throbbing silence, which wrapped around them like a thick blanket.
descriptosaurus-004939.zh: 一个跳动的寂静，像一条厚厚的毯子一样环绕着他们。

descriptosaurus-004944.en: Just an eerie silence and her own gasping breath.
descriptosaurus-004944.zh: 只是一阵诡异的沉默和她自己喘不过气来的气息。

descriptosaurus-004945.en: The silence came surging back, wrapping round them, making them feel isolated from the rest of the world.
descriptosaurus-004945.zh: 寂静涌上心头，环绕着他们，让他们感到与世界其他地方隔绝。

descriptosaurus-004946.zh: 第 3 节 – 安静噪音

descriptosaurus-005009.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-005010.en: In the passage ahead of him ...

descriptosaurus-005013.en: Somewhere at the back of the room
descriptosaurus-005013.zh: 在房间后面的某个地方

descriptosaurus-005021.en: Drip, drip of water like a leaking tap
descriptosaurus-005021.zh: 滴水，像漏水的水龙头一样滴水

descriptosaurus-005028.en: Creaks and rustlings of the old house
descriptosaurus-005028.zh: 老房子的吱吱声和沙沙声

descriptosaurus-005032.en: Moved closer to his hiding place

descriptosaurus-005033.en: Beneath the quiet he could hear ...

descriptosaurus-005039.en: Whispers rode on the wind through the empty branches
descriptosaurus-005039.zh: 低语声顺风穿过空荡荡的树枝

descriptosaurus-005041.en: Like a huge creature sucking in air
descriptosaurus-005041.zh: 就像一个吸吮空气的巨大生物

descriptosaurus-005042.en: Thud and click as the door creaked open
descriptosaurus-005042.zh: 砰的一声，门吱吱作响地打开

descriptosaurus-005044.zh: 刮擦的声音震动了地板

descriptosaurus-005046.en: A faint, wheezing noise came from the back of the room.
descriptosaurus-005046.zh: 房间后面传来一阵微弱的喘息声。

descriptosaurus-005047.en: The crisp night breeze ruffled her hair, sighed into her ear and whispered through the trees.
descriptosaurus-005047.zh: 清脆的夜风吹拂着她的头发，在她的耳朵里叹了口气，在树林里低语。

descriptosaurus-005048.en: It was a dark, desolate place, where ghosts sigh and moan on stormy nights.
descriptosaurus-005048.zh: 那是一个黑暗、荒凉的地方，在暴风雨的夜晚，鬼魂会叹息和呻吟。

descriptosaurus-005049.en: The holly trees gave a prickly murmur.
descriptosaurus-005049.zh: 冬青树发出刺耳的杂音。

descriptosaurus-005050.en: The whispers were not far behind, riding on the wind through the empty branches.
descriptosaurus-005050.zh: 耳语不远，随风穿过空荡荡的树枝。

descriptosaurus-005051.en: The quiet was broken by a thud and click and the key turned in the lock.
descriptosaurus-005051.zh: 安静被砰的一声打破，钥匙转入锁中。

descriptosaurus-005052.en: The ancient hinges groaned as the door was edged open.
descriptosaurus-005052.zh: 当门被打开时，古老的铰链呻吟着。

descriptosaurus-005053.en: The noises seemed to be closing in on them – the tick of a beetle, the whine of a mosquito, the rustle of leaves, the snap of a twig.
descriptosaurus-005053.zh: 噪音似乎在接近它们——甲虫的蜱虫、蚊子的呜呜声、树叶的沙沙声、树枝的咔哒声。

descriptosaurus-005054.en: As the bushes shivered, there was a drip, drip of water like the sound of a leaking tap.
descriptosaurus-005054.zh: 随着灌木丛的颤抖，有一滴水滴水，就像漏水的声音一样。

descriptosaurus-005055.en: As she moved through the trees, the leaves rustled and brushed her head like dry, dead fingers.
descriptosaurus-005055.zh: 当她穿过树林时，叶子像干枯的手指一样轻轻地擦过她的头。

descriptosaurus-005056.en: The silence was filled with noises from the draught blowing through the gap in the window – the swish of curtains, creak of a door and the clink of a light.
descriptosaurus-005056.zh: 寂静充满了来自窗户缝隙的吃水的噪音——窗帘的嗖嗖声、门的吱吱声和灯光的叮当声。

descriptosaurus-005057.en: She held her breath as the floorboards creaked and he moved closer to her hiding place.
descriptosaurus-005057.zh: 当地板吱吱作响时，她屏住了呼吸，他靠近了她的藏身之处。

descriptosaurus-005058.zh: 第 4 节 – 惊人的噪音

descriptosaurus-005163.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-005164.zh: 巨大的，缓慢的，摇晃的脚

descriptosaurus-005167.en: Squeak of a boot heel on the tiled floor
descriptosaurus-005167.zh: 在瓷砖地板上的靴跟的吱吱声

descriptosaurus-005168.en: Thump and thud of pursuers’ feet
descriptosaurus-005168.zh: 追求者的脚的砰砰声和砰砰声

descriptosaurus-005170.en: Loud gasping of a breathless man
descriptosaurus-005170.zh: 一个气喘吁吁的人的大声喘气

descriptosaurus-005171.zh: 焦急的叫喊和恐慌的声音

descriptosaurus-005173.zh: 一声刺耳的，令人毛骨悚然的尖叫声

descriptosaurus-005181.zh: 咕噜声、沙沙声和咆哮声

descriptosaurus-005186.en: Howls and shrieks of concealed creatures
descriptosaurus-005186.zh: 隐藏生物的嚎叫和尖叫声

descriptosaurus-005198.en: Noises died away in their own echoes
descriptosaurus-005198.zh: 噪音在自己的回声中消失了

descriptosaurus-005202.en: Screamed their warning of a predator
descriptosaurus-005202.zh: 尖叫着他们对捕食者的警告

descriptosaurus-005203.en: Bushes rustled with secret scratching of invisible predators
descriptosaurus-005203.zh: 隐形捕食者的秘密刮擦的灌木丛生锈

descriptosaurus-005205.en: Rumbled closer until it filled her ears
descriptosaurus-005205.zh: 翻得更近了，直到它填满了她的耳朵

descriptosaurus-005206.en: Rattled the windows as it wailed by

descriptosaurus-005209.en: Grinding, groaning crack as the ground was ripped apart
descriptosaurus-005209.zh: 当地面被撕开时，磨碎，呻吟的裂缝

descriptosaurus-005210.en: Terrified of what was waiting for him in the shadows
descriptosaurus-005210.zh: 害怕在阴影中等待他的东西

descriptosaurus-005211.en: Made her heart race and hands tremble

descriptosaurus-005212.en: Echoed in his head like a monstrous ghost
descriptosaurus-005212.zh: 像一个怪物一样在他的脑海中回荡

descriptosaurus-005214.en: A desperate howl of pain echoed through the building.
descriptosaurus-005214.zh: 一声绝望的痛苦嚎叫在建筑物中回荡。

descriptosaurus-005215.en: The silence was suddenly broken by the squeak of a boot heel on the tiled floor.
descriptosaurus-005215.zh: 瓷砖地板上的靴子脚跟的吱吱声突然打破了寂静。

descriptosaurus-005216.en: Somewhere off in the distance, a hunting owl shrieked.
descriptosaurus-005216.zh: 在远处的某个地方，一只猎猫尖叫着。

descriptosaurus-005217.en: Something moved in the passage ahead of him.
descriptosaurus-005217.zh: 在他面前的通道中有什么东西移动了。

descriptosaurus-005218.en: Something quick and scuttling like a rat.
descriptosaurus-005218.zh: 像老鼠一样快速而刺耳的东西。

descriptosaurus-005219.en: Something huge was moving towards him.
descriptosaurus-005219.zh: 有什么巨大的东西向他移动。

descriptosaurus-005220.en: Its slow, shuffling feet shattered the silence with its echoes.
descriptosaurus-005220.zh: 它缓慢而动摇的脚，用它的回声打破了寂静。

descriptosaurus-005221.en: The silence was broken by the blare of the horn and a screech of tyres.
descriptosaurus-005221.zh: 喇叭声和轮胎的尖叫声打破了寂静。

descriptosaurus-005222.en: A piercing, spine-chilling scream ripped through the air and sent the birds crashing through the trees.
descriptosaurus-005222.zh: 一声刺耳的刺痛的尖叫声在空中撕裂，让鸟儿撞在树上。

descriptosaurus-005223.en: Beneath the quiet, there was a trembling among the leaves and then the snap of a twig resounded like a gunshot.
descriptosaurus-005223.zh: 在宁静之下，树叶间传来一阵颤抖，然后一根树枝的响声像枪声一样响起。

descriptosaurus-005224.en: The dried brown leaves crunched under her feet, growing louder and louder, becoming snapping thuds as she broke into a run.
descriptosaurus-005224.zh: 干枯的棕色叶子在她的脚下嘎吱作响，越来越响亮，当她跑步时，它变得砰砰作响。

descriptosaurus-005225.en: The deafening wind echoed like a horn and rattled the windows as it wailed by.
descriptosaurus-005225.zh: 震耳欲聋的风像喇叭一样回荡，在窗户的哀号中嘎嘎作响。

descriptosaurus-005226.en: There was a sickening crack that made the walls shake.
descriptosaurus-005226.zh: 有一个令人作呕的裂缝让墙壁摇晃。

descriptosaurus-005227.en: Then, the shattering crash of breaking glass and splintering woodwork, as the walls collapsed.
descriptosaurus-005227.zh: 然后，随着墙壁倒塌，玻璃碎裂和木制品碎裂的碎裂声。

descriptosaurus-005228.en: As she tried to creep past the building, the stones crunched under her feet and announced her presence.
descriptosaurus-005228.zh: 当她试图爬过大楼时，石头在她的脚下嘎吱作响，宣布她的存在。

descriptosaurus-005229.en: A piercing screech tore through the deserted warehouse, as the metal shutter opened into the silent darkness.
descriptosaurus-005229.zh: 一道刺耳的尖叫声撕裂了空荡荡的仓库，金属百叶窗打开了寂静的黑暗。

descriptosaurus-005230.en: Suddenly, she heard the rustle of a night hunter.
descriptosaurus-005230.zh: 突然，她听到了夜猎人的沙沙声。

descriptosaurus-005231.en: She was frozen to the spot, afraid to move, terrified of what was waiting in the shadows.
descriptosaurus-005231.zh: 她被冻在了原地，害怕移动，害怕在阴影中等待的东西。

descriptosaurus-005232.en: The silence was pierced by the screech of a gull – a sound like a cold omen that sent a chill down his spine.
descriptosaurus-005232.zh: 寂静被海鸥的尖叫声刺穿——一种声音就像一声冰冷的预兆，让他的脊椎发冷。

descriptosaurus-005233.en: A shriek slashed the air as the monkeys swung through the trees, screaming their warning of the predator rustling through the undergrowth below.
descriptosaurus-005233.zh: 猴子们在树林中荡秋千，尖叫着尖叫着，警告说捕食者在下面的灌木丛中沙沙作响。

descriptosaurus-005258.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-005265.en: He was eleven years old, tall and had curly brown hair.
descriptosaurus-005265.zh: 他十一岁，高个子，有一头棕色的卷发。

descriptosaurus-005266.en: The man was middle-aged and had a sly, crumpled face.
descriptosaurus-005266.zh: 那个男人是中年人，脸上有一张狡猾的、皱巴巴的脸。

descriptosaurus-005267.en: Even though he must have been in his seventies, he was still running five miles a day.
descriptosaurus-005267.zh: 尽管他一定是七十多岁，但他仍然每天跑五英里。

descriptosaurus-005286.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-005287.en: Short, squat and as broad as a bull
descriptosaurus-005287.zh: 短而深蹲，像公牛一样宽

descriptosaurus-005288.en: Small man with stumpy little legs

descriptosaurus-005294.en: An enormous giant of a man
descriptosaurus-005294.zh: 一个巨大的男人的巨人

descriptosaurus-005298.en: John was short, squat and as broad as a bull.
descriptosaurus-005298.zh: 约翰矮个子，蹲着，像公牛一样宽阔。

descriptosaurus-005299.en: A small man, with stumpy little legs, shuffled towards them.
descriptosaurus-005299.zh: 一个小小的小腿，朝着他们的方向走去。

descriptosaurus-005300.en: The girl was elfin, but surprisingly strong for someone so small.
descriptosaurus-005300.zh: 这个女孩是精灵，但对于这么小的人来说却出人意料地强壮。

descriptosaurus-005301.en: Ann was of average height and had a lean, athletic build.
descriptosaurus-005301.zh: 安身高中等，身材苗条，运动身材。

descriptosaurus-005302.en: He was big for his age, with broad, muscular shoulders.
descriptosaurus-005302.zh: 他的年龄很大，肩膀宽阔，肌肉发达。

descriptosaurus-005303.en: The tall, lanky teenager used his long legs to intercept the ball.
descriptosaurus-005303.zh: 这位高大瘦长的少年用他的长腿拦截了球。

descriptosaurus-005304.en: The doorway was blocked by an enormous giant of a man, with huge, powerful shoulders and legs like tree trunks.
descriptosaurus-005304.zh: 门口被一个巨大的巨人挡住了，肩膀巨大，有力的肩膀和腿像树干。

descriptosaurus-005305.en: He shivered as he looked up at the human pyramid towering over him.
descriptosaurus-005305.zh: 抬头看着高耸于他的人体金字塔，他颤抖着。

descriptosaurus-005383.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-005387.zh: 像一个垫得很好的垫子

descriptosaurus-005391.en: Loose skin like huge, fleshy wings on her arms
descriptosaurus-005391.zh: 松散的皮肤就像她手臂上巨大的肉质翅膀

descriptosaurus-005403.en: Tall, thin stick of a man
descriptosaurus-005403.zh: 一个男人的高而薄的棍子

descriptosaurus-005410.zh: 像橄榄球前锋一样身材魁梧

descriptosaurus-005415.en: Slim body with muscular arms and legs
descriptosaurus-005415.zh: 有肌肉的手臂和腿的苗条身体

descriptosaurus-005416.zh: 肌肉发达的手臂和腿部

descriptosaurus-005429.zh: 看起来像一个行走的骷髅

descriptosaurus-005430.en: Looked as if a gust of wind would bend him in half
descriptosaurus-005430.zh: 看起来像一阵风会把他弯成两半

descriptosaurus-005433.en: Looked as if he had shrunk inside his skin
descriptosaurus-005433.zh: 看起来好像他的皮肤缩小了

descriptosaurus-005435.en: Could only walk with the aid of a walking stick

descriptosaurus-005439.en: Santa Claus is a jolly, pot-bellied man with a white beard.
descriptosaurus-005439.zh: 圣诞老人是一个快乐的大腹便便的男人，留着白胡子。

descriptosaurus-005440.en: Her huge pot-belly hung over her trousers like an enormous skin pouch.
descriptosaurus-005440.zh: 她巨大的大肚皮像一个巨大的皮肤袋一样挂在她的裤子上。

descriptosaurus-005441.en: She was short and plump, and cosy like a well-padded cushion.
descriptosaurus-005441.zh: 她又短又丰满，像垫子一样舒适。

descriptosaurus-005442.en: The skin on her arms was loose and flapped like huge, fleshy wings.
descriptosaurus-005442.zh: 她手臂上的皮肤松散，像巨大的肉质翅膀一样拍打着。

descriptosaurus-005443.en: His chins hung in massive folds, covering his neck and slumping onto his chest.
descriptosaurus-005443.zh: 他的下巴挂成巨大的褶皱，捂住脖子，倒在胸前。

descriptosaurus-005444.en: He was short, fat and so flabby his stomach wobbled when he walked.
descriptosaurus-005444.zh: 他身材矮小，胖乎乎的，他走路的时候肚子都在摇晃。

descriptosaurus-005445.en: For someone so short and dumpy, he was very fast on his feet.
descriptosaurus-005445.zh: 对于一个如此矮小和矮胖的人来说，他的脚非常快。

descriptosaurus-005446.en: The gymnast was a petite, dainty woman.
descriptosaurus-005446.zh: 体操运动员是一个娇小、精致的女人。

descriptosaurus-005447.en: She was slim and dainty and walked gracefully like a ballet dancer.
descriptosaurus-005447.zh: 她苗条而精致，像芭蕾舞演员一样优雅地走路。

descriptosaurus-005448.en: The girl was tiny and delicate like a china doll.
descriptosaurus-005448.zh: 这个女孩像中国娃娃一样小而精致。

descriptosaurus-005449.en: The fragile boy looked as if a gust of wind would bend him in half.
descriptosaurus-005449.zh: 脆弱的男孩看起来好像一阵风会把他弯成两半。

descriptosaurus-005450.en: He was a tall, scrawny boy with a face like a weasel.
descriptosaurus-005450.zh: 他是一个高大的，骨瘦如柴的男孩，脸像黄鼠狼。

descriptosaurus-005451.en: He was so emaciated he looked like a walking skeleton.
descriptosaurus-005451.zh: 他如此消瘦，看起来像一个行走的骷髅。

descriptosaurus-005452.en: Robert was a tall, thin stick of a man, with hips that stood out like two tusks.
descriptosaurus-005452.zh: 罗伯特是一根又高又瘦的男人，臀部像两只象牙一样突出。

descriptosaurus-005453.en: She was old, stooped and painfully thin.

descriptosaurus-005454.en: Every step, every painful shuffle, took every ounce of her strength.
descriptosaurus-005454.zh: 每一步，每一次痛苦的洗牌，都占据了她的每一盎司力量。

descriptosaurus-005455.en: He was tall and scrawny like a plucked chicken, with horrid, bony hands and long, clawed fingers.
descriptosaurus-005455.zh: 他又高又瘦，像一只拔鸡一样，有着可怕的、骨瘦如柴的手和长长的爪子。

descriptosaurus-005456.en: Her skin hung in creased folds around her neck and arms, as if she had shrunk inside it.
descriptosaurus-005456.zh: 她的皮肤挂在脖子和手臂上的褶皱褶皱处，仿佛她在里面收缩了一样。

descriptosaurus-005457.en: His father was as broad as a bull and burly like a rugby forward.
descriptosaurus-005457.zh: 他的父亲像公牛一样宽阔，像橄榄球前锋一样魁梧。

descriptosaurus-005458.en: Robert may have had a slim body, but he had broad, powerful shoulders and muscular arms and legs.
descriptosaurus-005458.zh: 罗伯特可能有一个苗条的身体，但他有宽阔、有力的肩膀和肌肉发达的手臂和腿。

descriptosaurus-005459.en: Slim and athletic, Kitty ran with a natural rhythm.
descriptosaurus-005459.zh: 苗条和运动，Kitty 以自然的节奏跑步。

descriptosaurus-005460.en: Robert was old and stooped and could only walk with the aid of a walking stick.
descriptosaurus-005460.zh: 罗伯特老了，弯腰，只能借助手杖走路。

descriptosaurus-005461.en: An old tramp hobbled towards the bench.
descriptosaurus-005461.zh: 一辆老流浪汉蹒跚地走向长凳。

descriptosaurus-005462.en: He was frail, crumpled and hunched like a question mark.
descriptosaurus-005462.zh: 他身体虚弱，像问号一样皱巴巴的驼背。

descriptosaurus-005463.en: He was tall and thin and stood straight-backed like a soldier.
descriptosaurus-005463.zh: 他又高又瘦，像士兵一样直背站立。

descriptosaurus-005464.en: She stood erect, her head held high, with the air of someone who was used to being obeyed.
descriptosaurus-005464.zh: 她直立着，头高昂着，带着一个习惯于服从的人的空气。

descriptosaurus-005496.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-005508.en: Rectangular-shaped face with a high, bald forehead

descriptosaurus-005510.en: She had a long, pointed face like a bird.
descriptosaurus-005510.zh: 她有一张像鸟一样长而尖的脸。

descriptosaurus-005511.en: His once full cheeks were droopy and grey.
descriptosaurus-005511.zh: 他曾经丰满的脸颊下垂而灰白。

descriptosaurus-005512.en: Her wide, round face was framed by a mass of curly black hair.
descriptosaurus-005512.zh: 她宽而圆的脸被一团卷曲的黑色头发所框住。

descriptosaurus-005513.en: He had a very round face and plump hamster cheeks.
descriptosaurus-005513.zh: 他有一张非常圆的脸和丰满的仓鼠脸颊。

descriptosaurus-005514.en: His face was oval-shaped and he had a high, bald forehead.
descriptosaurus-005514.zh: 他的脸是椭圆形的，额头很高，秃顶。

descriptosaurus-005515.en: The little girl looked like a cherub with her plump, heart-shaped face and angelic smile.
descriptosaurus-005515.zh: 小女孩看起来像一个小天使，她丰满、心形的脸和天使般的笑容。

descriptosaurus-005517.en: Her cheeks looked hollow and the flesh was wrinkled and sagging.
descriptosaurus-005517.zh: 她的脸颊看起来很空洞，肉又皱又下垂。

descriptosaurus-005518.en: Her cheekbones were so high, they formed two slashes across her face.
descriptosaurus-005518.zh: 她的颧骨很高，在她的脸上形成了两道斜线。

descriptosaurus-005520.en: Bald, with a thin, angular face, his high, sharp cheekbones gave him a haunted look.
descriptosaurus-005520.zh: 光秃秃的，他那张又瘦又棱角的脸，他高高而锋利的颧骨让他看起来很闹鬼。

descriptosaurus-005522.zh: 第 2 节 – 颜色和纹理

descriptosaurus-005570.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-005578.en: Round, pinkish look of a prize pig
descriptosaurus-005578.zh: 奖猪的圆形，粉红色的外观

descriptosaurus-005581.zh: 像巨型紫色手提箱一样的袋子

descriptosaurus-005582.en: Deep laughter lines in the corners of his eyes and mouth
descriptosaurus-005582.zh: 他的眼角和嘴角深处的笑声

descriptosaurus-005585.en: Like the skin of a lizard

descriptosaurus-005588.en: Sagged with wrinkles beneath her eyes
descriptosaurus-005588.zh: 她的眼睛下有皱纹下垂

descriptosaurus-005591.zh: 给了他一个头骨般的外观

descriptosaurus-005593.en: Laughter lines burnt into her skin
descriptosaurus-005593.zh: 笑声线烧在她的皮肤上

descriptosaurus-005594.en: Lines drew together when he smiled
descriptosaurus-005594.zh: 当他微笑时，线条画在一起

descriptosaurus-005597.zh: 皱纹看起来像残酷的割伤

descriptosaurus-005598.en: Eyes were lost within their wrinkles

descriptosaurus-005599.zh: 在他的眉毛之间挖出线条

descriptosaurus-005600.zh: 给了他一个永久的皱眉

descriptosaurus-005602.en: He was painfully thin and his face deathly pale.

descriptosaurus-005603.en: His face was ashen and twisted with pain.
descriptosaurus-005603.zh: 他的脸色苍白，痛苦地扭曲着。

descriptosaurus-005604.en: Her skin was a sickly, grey colour and hung in wrinkled folds.
descriptosaurus-005604.zh: 她的皮肤是病态的灰色，挂在皱褶的褶皱里。

descriptosaurus-005605.en: He had a ruddy face that had been scrubbed until it glowed.
descriptosaurus-005605.zh: 他有一张红润的脸，一直被擦到发光。

descriptosaurus-005606.en: His face was crumpled, unshaven and grey with anxiety.
descriptosaurus-005606.zh: 他的脸皱巴巴，没有刮胡子，焦虑不安。

descriptosaurus-005607.en: He looked like a walrus, with huge folds of sagging skin drooping from his face.
descriptosaurus-005607.zh: 他看起来像一只海象，脸上下垂的巨大皮肤褶皱。

descriptosaurus-005608.zh: 她苍白的皮肤是半透明的。

descriptosaurus-005609.en: It was almost purple under her eyes and limp and sagging with wrinkles.
descriptosaurus-005609.zh: 她的眼睛下几乎是紫色的，皱巴巴的，皱巴巴的。

descriptosaurus-005610.en: He had a sallow, scarred face and the haunted look of someone who had seen many battles.
descriptosaurus-005610.zh: 他有一张苍白、伤痕累累的脸和一个看过很多战斗的人的闹鬼的表情。

descriptosaurus-005611.en: With her pale, almost colourless skin, she looked like a fragile china doll.
descriptosaurus-005611.zh: 她脸色苍白，几乎是无色的，看起来像一个脆弱的中国娃娃。

descriptosaurus-005612.en: His colourless skin was stretched tight over his face and gave him a skulllike appearance.
descriptosaurus-005612.zh: 他无色的皮肤紧紧地覆盖在他的脸上，给了他一个骷髅般的外观。

descriptosaurus-005613.en: There were shadows and bags like giant, purple suitcases under her eyes.
descriptosaurus-005613.zh: 她的眼睛下有阴影和袋子，就像巨大的紫色手提箱一样。

descriptosaurus-005614.en: Sharp, vertical lines burrowed between his brows and gave him a permanent frown.
descriptosaurus-005614.zh: 尖锐的垂直线条在他的眉毛之间钻出，给了他一个永久的皱眉。

descriptosaurus-005615.en: Laughter lines surrounded her eyes and mouth, burnt by the sun and wind during the hours spent outside with the animals.
descriptosaurus-005615.zh: 笑线环绕着她的眼睛和嘴巴，在与动物一起度过的时间里，被太阳和风烧伤。

descriptosaurus-005616.en: The years had not been kind to her and decay was obvious in a face covered in wrinkles like thin, crumpled paper.
descriptosaurus-005616.zh: 岁月对她并不友善，在一张满是皱纹的脸上，像薄而皱巴巴的纸一样，腐烂很明显。

descriptosaurus-005617.zh: 第 3 节 – 伤口和疤痕

descriptosaurus-005659.zh: 因岁月而变得粗糙多皱的

descriptosaurus-005690.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-005695.en: Mass of angry sores around his lips
descriptosaurus-005695.zh: 他的嘴唇周围有一团愤怒的疮

descriptosaurus-005699.en: Enormous, wrinkled warts on her lip
descriptosaurus-005699.zh: 巨大的，皱巴巴的疣在她的嘴唇上

descriptosaurus-005703.zh: 大量烧焦的、伤痕累累的皮肤

descriptosaurus-005715.zh: 烧成巨大的粉红色斑块

descriptosaurus-005716.en: Shrivelled into a twisted lump of flesh
descriptosaurus-005716.zh: 萎缩成一团扭曲的肉块

descriptosaurus-005717.en: Stretched the width of his jaw

descriptosaurus-005718.en: Ran the length of one side of his face
descriptosaurus-005718.zh: 跑了他脸的一侧的长度

descriptosaurus-005722.en: Eye closed in the puckered folds of a scar
descriptosaurus-005722.zh: 在疤痕的褶皱褶皱中闭上眼睛

descriptosaurus-005723.en: Pulled his eye into a curious squint
descriptosaurus-005723.zh: 把他的眼睛拉进一个奇怪的眯眼

descriptosaurus-005725.en: Dragged his lip to meet his nostril
descriptosaurus-005725.zh: 拖着他的嘴唇迎接他的鼻孔

descriptosaurus-005727.en: His face was a mass of sores and peeling skin.
descriptosaurus-005727.zh: 他的脸上是一团酸痛和剥落的皮肤。

descriptosaurus-005728.en: The swollen, red blisters twisted his lips into a grimace.
descriptosaurus-005728.zh: 肿胀的红色水泡扭动着他的嘴唇，变成了鬼脸。

descriptosaurus-005729.en: The skin on his face and bald skull was scarred and scabbed.
descriptosaurus-005729.zh: 他脸上和秃头头骨上的皮肤伤痕累累，结痂。

descriptosaurus-005730.en: He had a black eye and an angry, purple bruise on his cheek.
descriptosaurus-005730.zh: 他的脸颊上有一只黑色的眼睛和一个愤怒的紫色瘀伤。

descriptosaurus-005731.en: A thin, jagged scar was just visible above his left eyebrow.
descriptosaurus-005731.zh: 他的左眉上方刚刚看到一条细长的锯齿状疤痕。

descriptosaurus-005732.en: One of his cheeks was dragged downwards by an ugly scar.
descriptosaurus-005732.zh: 他的一个脸颊被一道丑陋的伤疤往下拖。

descriptosaurus-005733.en: The scars on his skull were clearly visible through his closely shaved hair.
descriptosaurus-005733.zh: 他头骨上的伤疤通过他剃得很整齐的头发清晰可见。

descriptosaurus-005734.en: One side of his face was a pocked mass of scars and seared skin.
descriptosaurus-005734.zh: 他脸上的一侧是一团斑驳的伤疤和灼热的皮肤。

descriptosaurus-005735.en: The huge pink mole on her upper lip sprouted two long, gristly hairs.
descriptosaurus-005735.zh: 她上唇上的巨大粉红色痣长出了两根长长的毛茸茸的头发。

descriptosaurus-005736.en: The left side of his face was terribly burned.
descriptosaurus-005736.zh: 他的左侧脸被严重烧伤了。

descriptosaurus-005737.en: It was a mass of seared skin and scorched in huge, pink patches.
descriptosaurus-005737.zh: 那是一团灼热的皮肤，被巨大的粉红色斑块烧焦。

descriptosaurus-005738.en: The skin was bunched up around the festering, green wound and oozing pus.
descriptosaurus-005738.zh: 皮肤在溃烂的绿色伤口和渗出的脓液周围堆积起来。

descriptosaurus-005739.en: The skin around one eye had been pulled out of shape and gave her a curious squint.
descriptosaurus-005739.zh: 一只眼睛周围的皮肤已经变形，让她好奇地眯起眼睛。

descriptosaurus-005740.en: He had a scarred and twisted lip, which was pulled up to meet his nostril.
descriptosaurus-005740.zh: 他有一个伤痕累累、扭曲的嘴唇，被拉起来迎接他的鼻孔。

descriptosaurus-005741.en: His face had been disfigured by fire.

descriptosaurus-005742.en: His eyebrows were singed and sprouted at odd angles, and his ear was a shrivelled, gnarled lump.
descriptosaurus-005742.zh: 他的眉毛以奇怪的角度被烧焦和发芽，他的耳朵是一块干瘪的、粗糙的肿块。

descriptosaurus-005743.en: His face was disfigured by a hideous scar that ran the length of one side of his face and pulled his mouth into a permanent snarl.
descriptosaurus-005743.zh: 他的脸上被一道可怕的伤疤毁了，他的脸的一侧长了，把他的嘴拉成一个永久的咆哮。

descriptosaurus-005744.en: His face was a mass of scar tissue that almost closed one eye in its puckered folds.
descriptosaurus-005744.zh: 他的脸是一团疤痕组织，几乎闭合了一只眼睛，褶皱的褶皱处。

descriptosaurus-005799.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-005811.zh: 眼睛像闪闪发光的钻石

descriptosaurus-005818.zh: 凝视着明亮的绿色眼睛

descriptosaurus-005827.en: Peered at her from beneath long lashes

descriptosaurus-005836.zh: 隐藏在巨大的浓密眉毛下

descriptosaurus-005837.en: Took in every detail, every move
descriptosaurus-005837.zh: 把每一个细节，一举一动

descriptosaurus-005839.en: His emerald green eyes sparkled impishly.
descriptosaurus-005839.zh: 他那双绿色的眼睛充满了顽皮的光芒。

descriptosaurus-005840.en: Curly, ink-black eyelashes feathered her beautiful sapphire blue eyes.
descriptosaurus-005840.zh: 卷曲的墨黑色睫毛勾勒出她美丽的蓝宝石蓝眼睛。

descriptosaurus-005841.en: Her eyes were mud brown and as big as saucers.
descriptosaurus-005841.zh: 她的眼睛是灰褐色的，像碟子一样大。

descriptosaurus-005842.en: Kitty’s eyes were like sparkling blue diamonds and always seemed to dance with laughter.
descriptosaurus-005842.zh: 小猫的眼睛像闪闪发光的蓝色钻石，似乎总是带着笑声跳舞。

descriptosaurus-005843.en: Her eyes were velvet-brown and beamed with warmth like candles in the dark.
descriptosaurus-005843.zh: 她的眼睛是天鹅绒棕色的，在黑暗中像蜡烛一样温暖。

descriptosaurus-005844.en: Robert’s mouth was set in a firm line, but his twinkling grey eyes lit up his face.
descriptosaurus-005844.zh: 罗伯特的嘴巴排成一团，但他闪烁的灰色眼睛照亮了他的脸。

descriptosaurus-005845.en: Eyes that were as black as coal peered at her from beneath curly black lashes.
descriptosaurus-005845.zh: 像煤一样黑的眼睛从卷曲的黑色睫毛下凝视着她。

descriptosaurus-005846.en: His steely blue eyes glinted like frost.
descriptosaurus-005846.zh: 他那双坚硬的蓝色眼睛像霜一样闪闪发光。

descriptosaurus-005847.en: His large, staring eyes were an icy grey.
descriptosaurus-005847.zh: 他的大眼睛是冰冷的灰色。

descriptosaurus-005848.en: His bright green eyes burned with a cruel light.
descriptosaurus-005848.zh: 他明亮的绿色眼睛被残酷的光芒灼伤。

descriptosaurus-005849.en: Her eyes were an icy blue – cold and dangerous.
descriptosaurus-005849.zh: 她的眼睛是冰蓝色的——冰冷而危险。

descriptosaurus-005850.en: His eyes were a slate grey and bulging like a frog.
descriptosaurus-005850.zh: 他的眼睛是灰色的，像青蛙一样凸出。

descriptosaurus-005851.en: His eyes were as black as coal and hidden beneath huge bushy eyebrows.
descriptosaurus-005851.zh: 他的眼睛像煤一样黑，藏在浓密的浓密眉毛下。

descriptosaurus-005852.en: His flinty, narrowed eyes were cold and rimmed with bulging blue veins.
descriptosaurus-005852.zh: 他的火光，狭长的眼睛冰冷，充满了蓝色的血管。

descriptosaurus-005853.en: Like a hawk, her eyes were yellow and unblinking and took in every detail, every move.
descriptosaurus-005853.zh: 像鹰一样，她的眼睛是黄色的，没有眨眼，每一个细节，一举一动。

descriptosaurus-005854.en: Her cold blue eyes were almost transparent and made Robert shiver as they drilled into him.
descriptosaurus-005854.zh: 她冰冷的蓝色眼睛几乎是透明的，让罗伯特在钻进他的时候颤抖。

descriptosaurus-005881.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-005882.en: Wide, bulging eyes like a frog
descriptosaurus-005882.zh: 像青蛙一样宽阔的眼睛

descriptosaurus-005890.en: Stared as if he was in a trance

descriptosaurus-005895.en: His narrow, flint grey eyes were like dangerous slits.
descriptosaurus-005895.zh: 他狭窄的燧石灰色眼睛就像危险的狭缝。

descriptosaurus-005896.en: Her eyes were as big as saucers and twinkled with laughter.
descriptosaurus-005896.zh: 她的眼睛像飞碟一样大，笑声闪烁。

descriptosaurus-005897.en: Her small, pig-like eyes were hidden in the folds of her wrinkled, drooping skin.
descriptosaurus-005897.zh: 她那小小的猪般的眼睛藏在她皱巴巴的下垂皮肤的褶皱中。

descriptosaurus-005898.en: He had wide, bulging eyes like a frog, that stared as if he was in a trance.
descriptosaurus-005898.zh: 他的眼睛像青蛙一样大大的，凸出的眼睛，像是在恍惚中凝视着。

descriptosaurus-005899.en: Kitty watched as his small, buggy eyes darted rapidly from one to the other.
descriptosaurus-005899.zh: 凯蒂看着他那双小小的马车快速地从一只眼睛飞快地飞奔到另一只。

descriptosaurus-005917.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-005925.en: Stuck out fiercely at odd angles
descriptosaurus-005925.zh: 以奇怪的角度猛烈地伸出

descriptosaurus-005928.en: Gave her a constant look of surprise
descriptosaurus-005928.zh: 给了她一个惊喜的表情

descriptosaurus-005930.en: Her eyes were curtained by heavy black eyebrows.
descriptosaurus-005930.zh: 她的眼睛被浓重的黑色眉毛遮住了。

descriptosaurus-005931.en: Her thinly plucked, arched eyebrows made her look permanently surprised.
descriptosaurus-005931.zh: 她那微弱的、拱形的眉毛让她看起来永远感到惊讶。

descriptosaurus-005932.en: His bushy eyebrows met in the middle and stuck out fiercely at odd angles.
descriptosaurus-005932.zh: 他浓密的眉毛在中间相遇，以奇怪的角度猛烈地伸出。

descriptosaurus-005933.en: He had deep-set eyes, which were shadowed by a gnarled brow.
descriptosaurus-005933.zh: 他有深深的眼睛，被粗糙的眉毛遮住了。

descriptosaurus-005966.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-005970.en: Narrow mouth and thin, pursed lips
descriptosaurus-005970.zh: 狭窄的嘴唇和薄薄的嘴唇

descriptosaurus-005971.zh: 嘴巴皱巴巴的，皱巴巴的

descriptosaurus-005983.en: Curved upwards into a wide, beaming smile
descriptosaurus-005983.zh: 向上弯曲成宽广的笑容

descriptosaurus-005984.en: Pressed into a tight, thin line
descriptosaurus-005984.zh: 压成一条又细又细的线

descriptosaurus-005986.zh: 卡在一个永久的褶皱中

descriptosaurus-005987.en: Turned down at the corners in a permanent sulk
descriptosaurus-005987.zh: 在一个永久的闷闷不乐的角落里被拒绝了

descriptosaurus-005989.en: She had a tiny rosebud mouth.
descriptosaurus-005989.zh: 她有一个小玫瑰花蕾的嘴。

descriptosaurus-005990.en: Her mouth and plump lips rose in a perfect curve.
descriptosaurus-005990.zh: 她的嘴唇和丰满的嘴唇以完美的曲线隆起。

descriptosaurus-005992.en: Her lips were pale and pressed into a tight, thin line.
descriptosaurus-005992.zh: 她的嘴唇苍白，被压成一条紧绷的细线。

descriptosaurus-005993.en: Saliva dribbled onto his chin from his limp, drooping lip.
descriptosaurus-005993.zh: 唾液从他的下巴上滴落，嘴唇下垂。

descriptosaurus-005994.en: He had a wide, full mouth that seemed stuck in a sneering smile.
descriptosaurus-005994.zh: 他的嘴巴又大又饱满，似乎被一个冷笑的笑容卡住了。

descriptosaurus-005995.en: Her lips looked like they had been blown up by a bicycle pump and stuck in a permanent pucker.
descriptosaurus-005995.zh: 她的嘴唇看起来像是被自行车泵炸毁并卡在一个永久的褶皱中。

descriptosaurus-005996.en: She had a wide mouth and thick lips, which curved upwards into a broad, beaming smile.
descriptosaurus-005996.zh: 她的嘴巴宽阔，嘴唇浓密，向上弯曲成宽广的笑容。

descriptosaurus-006028.en: Great sheet of white, polished teeth

descriptosaurus-006030.en: Two jagged rows of rotting, brown teeth
descriptosaurus-006030.zh: 两排锯齿状的腐烂的棕色牙齿

descriptosaurus-006034.en: Crooked teeth and cracked, flaky lips
descriptosaurus-006034.zh: 弯曲的牙齿和破裂的、片状的嘴唇

descriptosaurus-006039.en: Clicked when she moved her lips

descriptosaurus-006040.en: Curved down over his lower lip

descriptosaurus-006041.en: Teeth bared in a reptilian leer
descriptosaurus-006041.zh: 在爬行动物的眼中露出的牙齿

descriptosaurus-006043.en: Her teeth were like polished pearls.
descriptosaurus-006043.zh: 她的牙齿像抛光的珍珠。

descriptosaurus-006044.en: He had a great sheet of polished, white teeth and a warm smile.
descriptosaurus-006044.zh: 他有一块抛光的白牙和温暖的笑容。

descriptosaurus-006045.en: Her false teeth clicked when she moved her lips.
descriptosaurus-006045.zh: 当她移动她的嘴唇时，她的假牙发出咔哒声。

descriptosaurus-006046.en: A gold-capped molar glinted when he opened his mouth.
descriptosaurus-006046.zh: 张开嘴时，一颗金顶臼齿闪闪发光。

descriptosaurus-006047.en: His teeth jutted out like fangs and curved down over his lower lip.
descriptosaurus-006047.zh: 他的牙齿像尖牙一样突出，在下唇上弯曲。

descriptosaurus-006048.en: His teeth had worn away into yellowing stumps that looked like crumbling tombstones.
descriptosaurus-006048.zh: 他的牙齿已经磨损成发黄的树桩，看起来像摇摇欲坠的墓碑。

descriptosaurus-006049.en: Behind the thick fleshy lips, she could see his stained and crooked teeth.
descriptosaurus-006049.zh: 在厚厚的肉唇后面，她可以看到他被弄脏的牙齿。

descriptosaurus-006050.en: When he snarled, he revealed two jagged rows of brown, rotting teeth.
descriptosaurus-006050.zh: 当他咆哮时，他露出两排锯齿状的棕色，腐烂的牙齿。

descriptosaurus-006105.zh: 被肿胀的红色血管覆盖

descriptosaurus-006109.en: Made him look stern and arrogant

descriptosaurus-006112.en: He had the flattened nose of a boxer.
descriptosaurus-006112.zh: 他有一个拳击手扁平的鼻子。

descriptosaurus-006113.en: Her small, upturned nose was covered in freckles.
descriptosaurus-006113.zh: 她小而上翘的鼻子上长满了雀斑。

descriptosaurus-006114.en: She was a petite woman with a thin, perfectly straight nose.
descriptosaurus-006114.zh: 她是一个娇小的女人，鼻子很瘦，很直。

descriptosaurus-006115.en: His eagle beak of a nose made him look stern and arrogant.
descriptosaurus-006115.zh: 他的鹰嘴巴让他显得严厉而傲慢。

descriptosaurus-006116.en: His wide nostrils flared with every breath like an angry bull.
descriptosaurus-006116.zh: 他宽阔的鼻孔像一头愤怒的公牛一样随着每一次呼吸而张开。

descriptosaurus-006117.en: His bulbous nose was covered in swollen red veins and had clumps of dark wiry hair sprouting from the nostrils.
descriptosaurus-006117.zh: 他的球状鼻子上覆盖着肿胀的红色血管，鼻孔长出一团黑色的细发。

descriptosaurus-006118.en: He had a thin, scarred face and a nose that had been broken so many times it seemed to spreading across his right cheek.
descriptosaurus-006118.zh: 他有一张瘦削的、伤痕累累的脸和一个被打断了很多次的鼻子，似乎在他的右脸颊上蔓延开来。

descriptosaurus-006119.en: He looked at them over his glasses, which were perched on the end of his large, hooked nose.
descriptosaurus-006119.zh: 他看着他们戴在眼镜上的眼镜，这些眼镜栖息在他巨大的钩状鼻子的末端。

descriptosaurus-006120.en: She glanced down at him over her narrow pinched nostrils, as if he was a nasty smell under her nose.
descriptosaurus-006120.zh: 她在狭窄的鼻孔上低头瞥了他一眼，仿佛他的鼻子下有一股难闻的气味。

descriptosaurus-006152.zh: 巨大的，沉重的，悬挂的耳环

descriptosaurus-006154.en: Jutted out on either side of his head

descriptosaurus-006156.zh: 像卷心菜叶子一样的纹理

descriptosaurus-006157.en: Earlobes stretched into long, narrow ovals
descriptosaurus-006157.zh: 耳垂延伸成长而窄的椭圆形

descriptosaurus-006159.en: His huge, cauliflower ears jutted out on either side of his head.
descriptosaurus-006159.zh: 他巨大的花椰菜耳朵在他的头两侧突出。

descriptosaurus-006160.en: His ears were large and veined like a cabbage leaf.
descriptosaurus-006160.zh: 他的耳朵很大，像卷心菜叶一样有纹理。

descriptosaurus-006161.en: Her earlobes were stretched into long narrow ovals by enormous, dangling earrings.
descriptosaurus-006161.zh: 她的耳垂被巨大的悬垂耳环拉伸成狭长的椭圆形。

descriptosaurus-006162.en: His ears were so big it looked like he had two mini satellite dishes attached to either side of his head.
descriptosaurus-006162.zh: 他的耳朵太大了，看起来就像他的头两侧都挂着两个迷你卫星天线。

descriptosaurus-006198.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-006207.en: Veins like rivers on a map
descriptosaurus-006207.zh: 地图上像河流一样的脉

descriptosaurus-006212.en: Felt as cold as a skeleton

descriptosaurus-006215.en: Backed away from the claw-like hand

descriptosaurus-006217.en: Grasped at the air in front of him

descriptosaurus-006221.en: His nails were chipped and encrusted with dirt.
descriptosaurus-006221.zh: 他的指甲被碎裂并沾满了泥土。

descriptosaurus-006222.en: Two enormous shovel-like hands lunged at him.
descriptosaurus-006222.zh: 两只巨大的铲子般的手扑向他。

descriptosaurus-006223.en: She drummed her long, bony fingers on the table impatiently.
descriptosaurus-006223.zh: 她不耐烦地在桌子上用长长的手指敲了敲。

descriptosaurus-006224.en: His hand was a burnt, twisted claw, with blackened talons for nails.
descriptosaurus-006224.zh: 他的手是一根烧焦的、扭曲的爪子，指甲上有黑色的爪子。

descriptosaurus-006225.en: Her old hands were swollen and covered in lumpy blue veins like rivers on a map.
descriptosaurus-006225.zh: 她的老手肿得像地图上的河流一样，浑浊的蓝色血管覆盖着。

descriptosaurus-006226.en: He backed away from the claw-like hand that was grasping at the air in front of him.
descriptosaurus-006226.zh: 他从那抓着眼前的空气的爪状手中后退。

descriptosaurus-006227.en: Her nails were like claws, sharpened to points and dangerous weapons.
descriptosaurus-006227.zh: 她的指甲像爪子一样，尖锐到点和危险的武器。

descriptosaurus-006228.en: She held out a bony hand, which felt as cold as a skeleton when Robert shook it.
descriptosaurus-006228.zh: 她伸出一只瘦骨嶙峋的手，当罗伯特摇晃它时，它感觉像骷髅一样冰冷。

descriptosaurus-006264.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-006267.zh: 像液体铜一样的赤褐色头发

descriptosaurus-006271.en: Silver tufts on either side of his round head
descriptosaurus-006271.zh: 他圆头两侧的银色簇绒

descriptosaurus-006272.en: Hair as white and fluffy as cotton wool
descriptosaurus-006272.zh: 头发像棉绒一样白而蓬松

descriptosaurus-006273.en: Shaggy, grey-streaked hair like a wolf
descriptosaurus-006273.zh: 毛茸茸的，像狼一样的灰色条纹头发

descriptosaurus-006274.en: Thin strip down the centre of his forehead

descriptosaurus-006275.en: Few tufts of grizzled, black hair

descriptosaurus-006282.zh: 头皮像抛光的骨头一样闪闪发光

descriptosaurus-006284.en: Strands combed from one side to the other
descriptosaurus-006284.zh: 从一侧到另一侧梳理的线

descriptosaurus-006287.en: Her unruly orange hair looked like flames blazing around her head.
descriptosaurus-006287.zh: 她不羁的橙色头发看起来像是在她的头上燃烧的火焰。

descriptosaurus-006288.en: His blond hair fluffed out from his head like a dandelion.
descriptosaurus-006288.zh: 他的金色头发像蒲公英一样从头上蓬松。

descriptosaurus-006289.en: Her long white hair hung in thin, limp strands on her shrunken head.
descriptosaurus-006289.zh: 她的长长的白发垂在她缩小的头上。

descriptosaurus-006290.en: Her scalp gleamed like polished bone through her white, sparse hair.
descriptosaurus-006290.zh: 她的头皮像抛光的骨头一样在她稀疏的头发上闪闪发光。

descriptosaurus-006291.en: He had jet black hair, cut short and spiked like a hedgehog.
descriptosaurus-006291.zh: 他有一头乌黑的头发，剪得很短，像刺猬一样尖刺。

descriptosaurus-006292.en: She had shiny black hair that fell in a sheet down her back and fanned across her shoulders.
descriptosaurus-006292.zh: 她有一头闪亮的黑色头发，落在她背上的一张床单上，并在她的肩膀上扇动。

descriptosaurus-006293.en: Her short hair was still thick and dark, but streaked with lines of pure white.
descriptosaurus-006293.zh: 她的短发仍然又厚又黑，但却是纯白色的线条。

descriptosaurus-006294.en: She had a head of tamed, reddish curls that cascaded down her back.
descriptosaurus-006294.zh: 她有一个被驯服的红色卷发，从她的背上倾泻而下。

descriptosaurus-006295.en: He was losing his hair and combed the remaining strands from one side to the other, then greased them heavily in place.
descriptosaurus-006295.zh: 他正在脱发，将剩余的头发从一侧梳到另一侧，然后将它们重重地涂抹在适当的位置。

descriptosaurus-006322.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-006326.en: Tight bun on top of her head

descriptosaurus-006328.en: Fell in a sheet down her back

descriptosaurus-006331.en: Swung rhythmically from side to side
descriptosaurus-006331.zh: 从一边到另一边有节奏地摆动

descriptosaurus-006332.en: Fell around her face like a curtain
descriptosaurus-006332.zh: 像窗帘一样落在她的脸上

descriptosaurus-006335.en: Hung down in two long pigtails
descriptosaurus-006335.zh: 挂在两条长长的辫子里

descriptosaurus-006336.en: Hung behind her like a tail
descriptosaurus-006336.zh: 像尾巴一样挂在她身后

descriptosaurus-006339.en: Held back by a silver headband

descriptosaurus-006340.en: Fastened at the back with a wooden spike

descriptosaurus-006342.en: Her hair hung down in two long pigtails.
descriptosaurus-006342.zh: 她的头发垂成两条长长的辫子。

descriptosaurus-006343.en: Her long black hair fell around her face like a curtain.
descriptosaurus-006343.zh: 她的黑色长发像窗帘一样落在她的脸上。

descriptosaurus-006344.en: Her sandy hair was held back from her face by a silver headband.
descriptosaurus-006344.zh: 她的沙质头发被银色头带从她的脸上拉了回来。

descriptosaurus-006345.en: Her dark hair was pulled back tight to her head and fastened at the back with an enormous wooden spike.
descriptosaurus-006345.zh: 她的黑头发紧紧地拉到她的头上，并用一个巨大的木钉固定在后面。

descriptosaurus-006346.en: She had a head of reddish curls, which cascaded down her back.
descriptosaurus-006346.zh: 她有一个红色的卷发，它从她的背上倾泻而下。

descriptosaurus-006347.en: She had shiny black hair, which fell in a sheet down her back and fanned across her shoulders.
descriptosaurus-006347.zh: 她有一头闪亮的黑色头发，落在她背上的一张床单上，在她的肩膀上扇动着扇子。

descriptosaurus-006348.en: Her hair was gathered on top of her head and held in place by diamond pins that had turned her hair into a sparkling tiara.
descriptosaurus-006348.zh: 她的头发聚集在她的头顶，并用钻石别针固定在适当的位置，将她的头发变成了闪闪发光的头饰。

descriptosaurus-006349.en: Her shiny brown hair swung rhythmically from side to side as she walked.
descriptosaurus-006349.zh: 走路时，她闪亮的棕色头发有节奏地左右摆动。

descriptosaurus-006377.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-006380.en: Short to the nape of her neck

descriptosaurus-006385.en: Stuck up in a tuft at the front
descriptosaurus-006385.zh: 被困在前面的一簇簇中

descriptosaurus-006391.zh: 凝胶在油腻的 quiff 中

descriptosaurus-006392.en: Hung down to hide his face

descriptosaurus-006394.en: Her blonde hair was cropped stylishly in a sleek bob.
descriptosaurus-006394.zh: 她的金色头发被时尚地剪成了时尚的鲍勃。

descriptosaurus-006395.en: She wore her hair short and swept behind her ears.
descriptosaurus-006395.zh: 她的头发很短，扫到了耳朵后面。

descriptosaurus-006396.en: His thick fair hair stuck up in a tuft at the front.
descriptosaurus-006396.zh: 他浓密的白发在前面的一簇簇中竖起。

descriptosaurus-006397.en: He had jet black hair, which was cut short and spiked like a hedgehog.
descriptosaurus-006397.zh: 他有一头乌黑的头发，剪得很短，像刺猬一样尖刺。

descriptosaurus-006398.en: He had curly black hair that was cut close to his head.
descriptosaurus-006398.zh: 他有一头卷曲的黑色头发，靠近他的头。

descriptosaurus-006399.en: His hair had been shaved into a military, scalp-hugging crop.
descriptosaurus-006399.zh: 他的头发被剃成了军人，头皮紧密的作物。

descriptosaurus-006400.en: She had white hair cropped short to the nape of her neck.

descriptosaurus-006425.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-006430.en: Hair was a tangled, wild stack

descriptosaurus-006436.en: Stuck up madly in all directions

descriptosaurus-006437.en: Grew at odd angles out of her head
descriptosaurus-006437.zh: 以奇怪的角度从她的头上长大

descriptosaurus-006439.en: As if he had had an electric shock

descriptosaurus-006440.en: Looked as if it had been cut by a pair of garden shears
descriptosaurus-006440.zh: 看起来好像是被一对花园剪刀剪掉的

descriptosaurus-006441.en: Combed by the fingers of the wind

descriptosaurus-006443.en: Her hair was dry and a tangled wild stack.
descriptosaurus-006443.zh: 她的头发是干的，是一团纠结的野生堆积。

descriptosaurus-007898.zh: 用她的拳头敲打着额头

descriptosaurus-007899.en: Drummed fingers on the table impatiently
descriptosaurus-007899.zh: 不耐烦地在桌子上敲打着手指

descriptosaurus-007905.en: Gripped knuckles until they turned white
descriptosaurus-007905.zh: 抓住指关节，直到它们变白

descriptosaurus-007906.en: Dug nails deep into the skin of her palms
descriptosaurus-007906.zh: 将指甲深深地挖到她手掌的皮肤上

descriptosaurus-007913.en: Stood with arms crossed and hands on hips
descriptosaurus-007913.zh: 双臂交叉站立，双手放在臀部

descriptosaurus-007921.zh: 像一个未开盘的弹簧一样包围

descriptosaurus-007931.en: She dismissed him with an impatient wave of her hand.
descriptosaurus-007931.zh: 她不耐烦地挥手解雇了他。

descriptosaurus-007932.en: He bounded towards them like an uncoiled spring.
descriptosaurus-007932.zh: 他像一个未开盘的弹簧一样向他们飞奔。

descriptosaurus-007933.en: He pounded on the table with his fist and glared at her furiously.
descriptosaurus-007933.zh: 他用拳头敲打着桌子，愤怒地瞪着她。

descriptosaurus-007934.en: He dug his fingers into his scalp and tugged at his hair, until it stood up in wild tufts.
descriptosaurus-007934.zh: 他把手指伸进头皮上，拉扯着他的头发，直到它在野外的簇绒中竖立起来。

descriptosaurus-007935.en: He exhaled once, a long hard gust, put his hands on his hips and spoke very slowly.
descriptosaurus-007935.zh: 他吐了一次，一阵长长的狂风，把手放在臀部，说话很慢。

descriptosaurus-007936.en: She strode into the room, muttering under her breath, and then turned briskly and marched out again, with a stiffback and her head held high in the air.
descriptosaurus-007936.zh: 她大步走进房间，低声咕哝着，然后轻快地转身又走了出去，背部僵硬，头高高举在空中。

descriptosaurus-007937.en: Throwing his head back, he exhaled deeply and closed his eyes.
descriptosaurus-007937.zh: 他把头往后仰，深深地呼了一口气，闭上了眼睛。

descriptosaurus-007938.en: With a howl of rage, he buried his head in his hands and pressed them into his eyes.
descriptosaurus-007938.zh: 怒吼一声，将头埋在手中，将它们压在眼睛里。

descriptosaurus-007939.en: Speechless with rage, she curled her fist and dug her fingers deep into her palms.
descriptosaurus-007939.zh: 愤怒地说不出话来，她蜷缩着拳头，将手指深深地伸进了她的手掌。

descriptosaurus-007940.en: Kitty opened her mouth to speak, but before she could utter a word, Robert silenced her by putting his hand, palm upwards, in the air in front of her.
descriptosaurus-007940.zh: 凯蒂张开嘴要说话，但在她说出一句话之前，罗伯特把手放在她面前的空气中，将他的手掌向上举到了沉默。

descriptosaurus-007987.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-007988.en: Smile as empty as a carcass

descriptosaurus-007996.zh: 偷偷摸摸的，毒蛇的表达

descriptosaurus-008000.en: Dramatic expression of mock concern and sympathy
descriptosaurus-008000.zh: 模拟关注和同情的戏剧性表达

descriptosaurus-008003.en: Face split into a nasty, demonic grin
descriptosaurus-008003.zh: 脸分裂成恶魔般的恶魔般的笑容

descriptosaurus-008005.en: Mouth stretched in a hideous sneer
descriptosaurus-008005.zh: 嘴巴张开，发出可怕的冷笑

descriptosaurus-008007.en: Stretched his mouth into a grisly smile

descriptosaurus-008010.zh: 最纯净的毒液的定向外观

descriptosaurus-008012.en: Trained his steely gaze on her
descriptosaurus-008012.zh: 训练他钢铁般的目光注视着她

descriptosaurus-008014.en: His pale, skull-like face split into an evil grin.
descriptosaurus-008014.zh: 他苍白的骷髅般的脸，变成了邪恶的笑容。

descriptosaurus-008015.en: He curled his lips into a savage sneer.
descriptosaurus-008015.zh: 他的嘴唇变得粗暴的冷笑。

descriptosaurus-008016.en: She directed a look of pure venom at his retreating back.
descriptosaurus-008016.zh: 她用纯净的毒液看着他后退的样子。

descriptosaurus-008017.en: His smile was as empty as a carcass.
descriptosaurus-008017.zh: 他的笑容像尸体一样空虚。

descriptosaurus-008018.en: Her expression suddenly changed to a dramatic look of mock concern and sympathy.
descriptosaurus-008018.zh: 她的表情突然变成了一种戏剧性的关注和同情的表情。

descriptosaurus-008019.en: She took aim with an invisible gun and gave him a slow, demonic leer.
descriptosaurus-008019.zh: 她用无形的枪瞄准，给了他一个缓慢的恶魔般的眼神。

descriptosaurus-008020.en: His mouth twisted into a smirk and his icy blue eyes narrowed to slits.
descriptosaurus-008020.zh: 他的嘴角扭曲成一个假笑，他冰冷的蓝色眼睛变窄了。

descriptosaurus-008021.en: Robert trained his steely gaze on her and stretched his mouth into a grisly smile.
descriptosaurus-008021.zh: 罗伯特用钢铁般的目光盯着她，嘴角露出一个可怕的笑容。

descriptosaurus-008022.en: He raised his eyebrows and glanced at her with a cold, arrogant expression.
descriptosaurus-008022.zh: 他扬起眉毛，冷冷的表情瞥了她一眼。

descriptosaurus-008023.en: He had an amused, callous look on his face, as he watched Kitty writhing on the floor.
descriptosaurus-008023.zh: 当他看着小猫在地板上扭动时，他的脸上有一种有趣、冷酷的表情。

descriptosaurus-008024.en: As he opened the door for them to leave, his mouth twisted into a knowing grin.
descriptosaurus-008024.zh: 当他打开门让他们离开时，他的嘴扭成了一个会心的笑容。

descriptosaurus-008025.en: Snorting with contempt, he bared his yellow teeth in a reptilian sneer.
descriptosaurus-008025.zh: 轻蔑地哼了一声，他露出黄色的牙齿，发出爬行动物的冷笑。

descriptosaurus-008026.en: His mouth curled with revulsion, as she made a despairing lunge at his arm.
descriptosaurus-008026.zh: 他的嘴里充满了反感，她的手臂上做了一个绝望的弓步。

descriptosaurus-008068.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-008070.zh: 像葡萄干一样小而坚硬

descriptosaurus-008078.en: Sparkled like frost – cold and dangerous
descriptosaurus-008078.zh: 像霜一样闪闪发光——寒冷而危险

descriptosaurus-008082.en: His small eyes were as dark and hard as raisins and had a demon-haunted expression.
descriptosaurus-008082.zh: 他的小眼睛像葡萄干一样黑而坚硬，有着恶魔般的表情。

descriptosaurus-008083.en: She stared at Kitty for a moment and then a crafty look flickered in her buggy little eyes.
descriptosaurus-008083.zh: 她盯着小猫看了一会儿，然后她的小眼睛里闪烁着狡猾的表情。

descriptosaurus-008084.en: He stared with unblinking eyes, but his lips twisted in a sneer.
descriptosaurus-008084.zh: 他目光凝重地凝视着，但他的嘴唇却在冷笑中扭曲。

descriptosaurus-008085.en: His feverish, staring eyes bulged in his monstrous face.
descriptosaurus-008085.zh: 他那发烧的眼睛在他怪异的脸上凸出。

descriptosaurus-008086.en: She stared with eyes that sparkled like frost – cold and dangerous.
descriptosaurus-008086.zh: 她凝视着像霜一样闪闪发光的眼睛——冰冷而危险。

descriptosaurus-008118.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-008124.en: Splinter of ice in her voice

descriptosaurus-008125.en: Voice was low, cold and full of menace
descriptosaurus-008125.zh: 声音低沉，冰冷，充满威胁

descriptosaurus-008134.en: Voice was full of malicious laughter
descriptosaurus-008134.zh: 声音充满了恶意的笑声

descriptosaurus-008138.en: Said in a low, vicious tone
descriptosaurus-008138.zh: 用低沉而恶毒的语气说道

descriptosaurus-008139.en: Ordered with a sneer of cold command

descriptosaurus-008141.zh: 像一只恶毒的狗一样咆哮

descriptosaurus-008143.en: Bored into her like a drill

descriptosaurus-008145.zh: 尖锐的话语划破了空气

descriptosaurus-008147.en: Every word he spoke dripped with venom and hate.
descriptosaurus-008147.zh: 他说的每一句话都充满了毒液和仇恨。

descriptosaurus-008148.en: She drew in her breath in a venomous hiss.
descriptosaurus-008148.zh: 她用一阵恶毒的嘶嘶声吸了口气。

descriptosaurus-008149.en: His hard, cold eyes and frosty voice chilled Kitty to the bone.
descriptosaurus-008149.zh: 他坚硬、冰冷的眼睛和冰冷的声音让小猫骨头冷了下来。

descriptosaurus-008150.en: She threw back her head and laughed like a screeching seagull.
descriptosaurus-008150.zh: 她仰起头，笑得像一只尖叫的海鸥。

descriptosaurus-008151.en: Her eyes narrowed dangerously and then she laughed scornfully.
descriptosaurus-008151.zh: 她的眼睛危险地眯了起来，然后轻蔑地笑了起来。

descriptosaurus-008152.en: It was a haunting voice, and one that visited her nightly in her dreams – a voice of ice-cold venom.
descriptosaurus-008152.zh: 这是一个令人难以忘怀的声音，每晚在她的梦中拜访她——一种冰冷的毒液的声音。

descriptosaurus-008153.en: He was used to giving orders; his tone was firm and cold and one that expected to be obeyed without question.
descriptosaurus-008153.zh: 他习惯于下达命令； 他的语气坚定而冰冷，毫无疑问地被要求服从。

descriptosaurus-008154.en: His tone was so sharp that the words seemed to slash the air.
descriptosaurus-008154.zh: 他的语气如此清晰，以至于这些话似乎削减了空气。

descriptosaurus-008189.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-008191.zh: 像一只狼吞虎咽的蜥蜴

descriptosaurus-008192.en: Like a figure carved from stone
descriptosaurus-008192.zh: 像是用石头雕刻的人物

descriptosaurus-008194.en: Like a predator scenting its prey
descriptosaurus-008194.zh: 就像捕食者在嗅着猎物

descriptosaurus-008195.en: Like a panther waiting to pounce
descriptosaurus-008195.zh: 像一只等待突袭的黑豹

descriptosaurus-008201.en: Poised on the balls of his feet

descriptosaurus-008208.en: Glided noiselessly like a dark ghost
descriptosaurus-008208.zh: 像黑鬼一样无声地滑行

descriptosaurus-008210.en: Flexed his fingers and formed them into a fist
descriptosaurus-008210.zh: 弯曲他的手指，形成拳头

descriptosaurus-008211.en: Beckoned them to come to him

descriptosaurus-008212.en: Dismissed them with a wave of her hand
descriptosaurus-008212.zh: 用她的手挥手解雇了他们

descriptosaurus-008214.en: He landed quietly like a cat.

descriptosaurus-008215.en: He was crouched on the edge, like a panther waiting to pounce.
descriptosaurus-008215.zh: 他蹲在边缘，就像一只等待突袭的黑豹。

descriptosaurus-008216.en: He beckoned them to him with a tense jerk of his fingers.
descriptosaurus-008216.zh: 他用手指的紧张抽搐向他招手。

descriptosaurus-008217.en: She dismissed them with a wave of her hand.
descriptosaurus-008217.zh: 她用手挥手解雇了他们。

descriptosaurus-008218.en: He was as silent and motionless as a figure carved from stone.
descriptosaurus-008218.zh: 他像石头雕刻的人物一样沉默、一动不动。

descriptosaurus-008219.en: He stood still and poised, like a cobra about to strike.
descriptosaurus-008219.zh: 他站着不动，像一条眼镜蛇要来袭。

descriptosaurus-008220.en: Kitty leaned forward and grimaced at him malevolently.
descriptosaurus-008220.zh: 凯蒂向前倾身，恶毒地对他做了个鬼脸。

descriptosaurus-008221.en: He was tensed, poised on the balls of his feet, like a predator scenting its prey.
descriptosaurus-008221.zh: 他紧张起来，站在他的脚掌上，就像捕食者的猎物一样。

descriptosaurus-008222.en: He flexed his fingers, formed them into a fist and advanced menacingly.
descriptosaurus-008222.zh: 他伸出手指，将它们变成拳头，威胁性地向前推进。

descriptosaurus-008223.en: Gliding smoothly, noiselessly in the shadows, she was like a dark ghost.
descriptosaurus-008223.zh: 在阴影中流畅地滑行，无声地滑行，她就像一个黑暗的幽灵。

descriptosaurus-008326.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-008329.en: Tongue felt thick and heavy in his mouth
descriptosaurus-008329.zh: 舌头在他的嘴里感到又厚又重

descriptosaurus-008330.en: Fear was like a bitter bile at the back of his throat
descriptosaurus-008330.zh: 恐惧就像喉咙后部的苦涩胆汁

descriptosaurus-008332.en: Prickle of fear in the bottom of his spine
descriptosaurus-008332.zh: 在他脊椎底部的恐惧刺痛

descriptosaurus-008334.en: Like a lead ball in his stomach

descriptosaurus-008337.en: Dread swept through him like a tidal wave
descriptosaurus-008337.zh: 恐惧像潮汐一样席卷他

descriptosaurus-008338.en: Fear settled on him like a dark fog
descriptosaurus-008338.zh: 恐惧像黑雾一样落在他身上

descriptosaurus-008341.en: Fear seized him in its jaws

descriptosaurus-008342.en: Thought of the consequences urged him on
descriptosaurus-008342.zh: 想到后果促使他继续前进

descriptosaurus-008344.en: Every nerve in his body warned him not to...
descriptosaurus-008344.zh: 他体内的每一根神经都警告他不要...

descriptosaurus-008345.en: Could taste the fear in the back of his throat
descriptosaurus-008345.zh: 可以尝到喉咙后部的恐惧

descriptosaurus-008348.en: Blew out her cheeks to stop herself howling
descriptosaurus-008348.zh: 吹出她的脸颊阻止自己嚎叫

descriptosaurus-008351.zh: 恐慌在她的喉咙里冒泡

descriptosaurus-008352.en: Fear choked him with its murderous hands
descriptosaurus-008352.zh: 恐惧用杀人的双手扼住了他

descriptosaurus-008353.zh: 绕着他的气管蜿蜒前行

descriptosaurus-008358.en: Heart abandoned his chest to pound in his throat
descriptosaurus-008358.zh: 心放弃了他的胸膛，在他的喉咙里砰砰直跳

descriptosaurus-008359.en: Squeezed her heart like a vice
descriptosaurus-008359.zh: 像恶习一样挤压她的心

descriptosaurus-008360.zh: 她的太阳穴中涌出鲜血

descriptosaurus-008362.en: Cold sweat poured down his forehead
descriptosaurus-008362.zh: 冰冷的汗水顺着他的额头倾泻而下

descriptosaurus-008364.en: Hairs prickled on the back of his neck
descriptosaurus-008364.zh: 脖子后面的毛发都刺了

descriptosaurus-008365.en: Shivers tore down her spine and racked her body
descriptosaurus-008365.zh: 颤抖着撕裂她的脊椎，绞尽了她的身体

descriptosaurus-008366.en: Like a hundred spiders were scuttling down her back
descriptosaurus-008366.zh: 就像一百只蜘蛛在她的背上偷偷摸摸

descriptosaurus-008368.en: Like a moth fluttering inside her stomach
descriptosaurus-008368.zh: 就像一只飞蛾在她的肚子里飞舞

descriptosaurus-008371.en: Like a volcano erupting inside her
descriptosaurus-008371.zh: 就像一座火山在她体内喷发

descriptosaurus-008373.en: Every nerve in his body warned him not to go any further.
descriptosaurus-008373.zh: 他身体的每一根神经都在警告他不要再往前走。

descriptosaurus-008374.en: All his instincts screamed at him to slip away before he was spotted.
descriptosaurus-008374.zh: 在他被发现之前，他所有的本能都在尖叫着要溜走。

descriptosaurus-008375.en: He was sick with fear, but the thought of the consequences urged him on.
descriptosaurus-008375.zh: 他感到恐惧，但一想到后果就催促他继续前进。

descriptosaurus-008376.en: Her throat was dry, her tongue thick and heavy in her mouth.
descriptosaurus-008376.zh: 她的喉咙干涩，舌头又厚又重。

descriptosaurus-008377.en: Fear choked him with its murderous hands.
descriptosaurus-008377.zh: 恐惧用它杀气腾腾的双手扼住了他。

descriptosaurus-008378.en: It gripped at his throat and strangled his breath into short, shallow gasps.
descriptosaurus-008378.zh: 它咬住他的喉咙，把他的呼吸扼杀在短暂的浅口气中。

descriptosaurus-008379.en: She was struck dead with terror.

descriptosaurus-008380.en: Her heart was beating painfully fast and banging against her ribs.
descriptosaurus-008380.zh: 她的心跳得痛快，撞在了她的肋骨上。

descriptosaurus-008381.en: Her heart missed a beat, squeezed like a vice by the shock.
descriptosaurus-008381.zh: 她的心脏错过了一个节拍，被震动像虎钳一样挤压。

descriptosaurus-008382.en: As the blood pounded in her temples, her brain quickened and all her senses were alert.
descriptosaurus-008382.zh: 当她的太阳穴中的血液被猛烈撞击时，她的大脑加速了，她所有的感官都变得警觉。

descriptosaurus-008383.en: Blowing out her cheeks, she drew a long, shuddering breath and tried to dampen the sense of impending doom.
descriptosaurus-008383.zh: 她吹出脸颊，长长而颤抖的呼吸，试图抑制即将到来的厄运感。

descriptosaurus-008385.en: The hairs on the back of his neck prickled with dread and he was drenched in sweat.
descriptosaurus-008385.zh: 他脖子后面的毛发被恐惧刺痛，汗水湿透了。

descriptosaurus-008386.en: Fear settled on her like a dark fog, bringing a chill that crept over her and that no amount of heat could drive away.
descriptosaurus-008386.zh: 恐惧像黑雾一样降临在她身上，带着一股寒意蔓延到她身上，再多的热量也无法驱散。

descriptosaurus-008387.en: The fear was like an electric shock, pumping shivering waves tearing through his body and making his hair stand on end.
descriptosaurus-008387.zh: 恐惧就像电击，抽动着颤抖的波浪撕裂了他的身体，让他的头发竖了起来。

descriptosaurus-008389.en: It was as if a lead ball had been dropped in his stomach and was blocking his gut.
descriptosaurus-008389.zh: 就好像一个铅球掉在了他的胃里，挡住了他的肠子。

descriptosaurus-008390.en: Her stomach was gripped with anxiety, like a volcano erupting inside her.
descriptosaurus-008390.zh: 她的胃里充满了焦虑，就像一座火山在她体内爆发。

descriptosaurus-008391.en: Something was making her feel very uneasy.
descriptosaurus-008391.zh: 有什么东西让她感到非常不安。

descriptosaurus-008392.en: It was gnawing at her stomach and fluttering as if she had swallowed a butterfly.
descriptosaurus-008392.zh: 它咬着她的肚子，像是吞下了一只蝴蝶一样扑通扑通。

descriptosaurus-008435.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-008449.en: Smile dropped from her face like a theatrical mask
descriptosaurus-008449.zh: 笑容像戏剧面具一样从她的脸上掉了下来

descriptosaurus-008450.en: Cold sweat poured down his face
descriptosaurus-008450.zh: 冷汗从他的脸上倾泻而下

descriptosaurus-008457.en: Bared teeth in an edgy grin

descriptosaurus-008460.en: Her eyes swept over the scene in front of her and her face froze in horror.
descriptosaurus-008460.zh: 她的目光扫过眼前的场景，她的脸惊恐地僵住了。

descriptosaurus-008461.en: She was rooted to the spot, hands trembling and her face ashen and drenched in sweat.
descriptosaurus-008461.zh: 她被扎根于现场，手颤抖，脸色苍白，汗流浃背。

descriptosaurus-008462.en: Her face was expressionless, but inwardly she was fighting to remain calm.
descriptosaurus-008462.zh: 她的脸上没有表情，但内心却在努力保持冷静。

descriptosaurus-008463.en: The smile dropped from her face like a theatrical mask, to be replaced by a look of sheer terror.
descriptosaurus-008463.zh: 笑容像是一个戏剧面具一样从她的脸上掉了下来，取而代之的是一种纯粹的恐惧。

descriptosaurus-008464.en: As she listened to the news, a troubled expression settled on her face.
descriptosaurus-008464.zh: 听着消息，她的脸上浮现出一丝不安的表情。

descriptosaurus-008465.en: Her face was drawn and anxious, as she paced backwards and forwards across the room.
descriptosaurus-008465.zh: 当她在房间里前后踱步时，她的脸被画得很焦虑。

descriptosaurus-008466.en: Her mouth was twisted in a scream that never came.
descriptosaurus-008466.zh: 她的嘴里被一声永远不会来的尖叫而扭曲。

descriptosaurus-008467.en: The smile suddenly fell from her face and her jaw dropped open.
descriptosaurus-008467.zh: 笑容突然从她的脸上掉了下来，她的下巴张开了。

descriptosaurus-008468.en: She bit her lip to stop her teeth chattering like castanets.

descriptosaurus-009753.en: He was bent in half by the cramps in his stomach.
descriptosaurus-009753.zh: 他因胃里的抽筋而弯成两半。

descriptosaurus-009754.en: Holding his breath and gritting his teeth – he staggered to his feet.
descriptosaurus-009754.zh: 屏住呼吸，咬紧牙关——他踉踉跄跄地站了起来。

descriptosaurus-009755.en: As the next of wave of pain surged through his shoulder, he scrunched his eyes shut and bit his lip.
descriptosaurus-009755.zh: 一阵阵的疼痛从他的肩膀上涌出，他皱起了眼睛，咬了咬嘴唇。

descriptosaurus-009756.en: He gasped, as the wave of pain flooded through him.
descriptosaurus-009756.zh: 他倒吸一口凉气，一股痛苦的浪潮席卷了他。

descriptosaurus-009757.en: Scrunching his eyes tight and clenching his fists, he rocked backwards and forwards.
descriptosaurus-009757.zh: 他紧紧地扭动着眼睛，握紧了拳头，前后摇晃着。

descriptosaurus-009758.en: The wound had been torn open and was throbbing savagely.
descriptosaurus-009758.zh: 伤口被撕开，猛烈地跳动着。

descriptosaurus-009759.en: Nostrils flared and deep lines creasing the bridge of his nose, he gritted his teeth and got to his feet.
descriptosaurus-009759.zh: 鼻孔张开，深深的线条折断了他的鼻梁，他咬紧牙关，站了起来。

descriptosaurus-009760.en: Her mouth dropped open and her tongue lolled out.

descriptosaurus-009761.en: With one final gasp, her legs buckled under her and she crashed to the floor.
descriptosaurus-009761.zh: 最后一口气，她的双腿在她身下弯曲，她倒在了地上。

descriptosaurus-009783.en: Looked as if they were going to pop out of his head
descriptosaurus-009783.zh: 看起来好像他们要从他的头上弹出

descriptosaurus-009784.zh: 泪水从她的脸上流下来

descriptosaurus-009786.en: Her mouth gaped like a fish out of water and tears streamed down her face.
descriptosaurus-009786.zh: 她的嘴巴像一条从水里流出的鱼一样张开，泪水从她的脸上流下来。

descriptosaurus-009787.en: As she hit the wall, her head was thrown backwards and her eyes rolled in their sockets, until only the whites were showing.
descriptosaurus-009787.zh: 当她撞到墙上时，她的头向后仰，她的眼睛在他们的窝里翻滚，直到只有白人出现。

descriptosaurus-009825.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-009833.zh: 发出一声低沉的低声呻吟

descriptosaurus-009839.en: She curled into a ball and howled like a wounded animal.
descriptosaurus-009839.zh: 她蜷缩成一个球，像受伤的动物一样嚎叫。

descriptosaurus-009840.en: He winced and put his hands to his head.
descriptosaurus-009840.zh: 他畏缩了一下，把手放在了头上。

descriptosaurus-009841.en: He let out a loud, ragged wail and tugged wildly at his hair.
descriptosaurus-009841.zh: 他发出一声响亮的、衣衫褴褛的哀号，疯狂地拉扯着他的头发。

descriptosaurus-009842.en: She crouched in the corner, with her arms wrapped around her, and let out a small whimper.
descriptosaurus-009842.zh: 她蹲在角落里，双臂搂住她，发出一声轻微的呜咽声。

descriptosaurus-009843.en: Writhing in agony, he clutched his stomach and groaned.
descriptosaurus-009843.zh: 痛苦地扭动着，他紧紧抓住自己的肚子，呻吟着。

descriptosaurus-009844.en: She bent forward with her hands on her knees.
descriptosaurus-009844.zh: 她双手放在膝盖上向前弯曲。

descriptosaurus-009845.en: Gulping for air, her words came in painful gasps.
descriptosaurus-009845.zh: 大口大口大口地说，她的话语是痛苦的喘息声。

descriptosaurus-009846.en: Half-mad with the pain in her back, she released an ear-splitting yell.
descriptosaurus-009846.zh: 半疯了，她的背部疼痛，她发出一声刺耳的叫喊。

descriptosaurus-009904.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-009907.en: Like a puppet with its strings cut
descriptosaurus-009907.zh: 就像一个被剪断的木偶

descriptosaurus-009914.en: Bent over to ease the cramping pain

descriptosaurus-009924.en: Limped slowly, dragging foot behind him
descriptosaurus-009924.zh: 慢慢地一瘸一拐，拖着脚在他身后

descriptosaurus-009927.en: Head lolled from side to side

descriptosaurus-009931.en: The blistering pain made him crumple into a heap.
descriptosaurus-009931.zh: 剧烈的疼痛让他挤成一堆。

descriptosaurus-009932.en: He pressed his hands tightly over his eyes to block out the pain.
descriptosaurus-009932.zh: 他的双手紧紧地压在眼睛上，以阻止疼痛。

descriptosaurus-009933.en: She crouched in a corner, with her arms wrapped tightly around her.
descriptosaurus-009933.zh: 她蹲在角落里，双臂紧紧地搂着她。

descriptosaurus-009934.en: He thrashed wildly – fighting the pain that came again and again.
descriptosaurus-009934.zh: 他疯狂地鞭打——与一次又一次的痛苦作斗争。

descriptosaurus-009935.en: He twisted his head and tugged his hair, trying to escape the searing pain.
descriptosaurus-009935.zh: 他扭着头，扯了扯头发，试图逃避灼热的疼痛。

descriptosaurus-009936.en: She writhed on the floor, clutching her stomach.
descriptosaurus-009936.zh: 她在地板上扭动着，紧紧抓住她的肚子。

descriptosaurus-009937.en: Her eyes rolled in their sockets and sweat streamed from her brow.
descriptosaurus-009937.zh: 她的眼睛在他们的眼窝里翻了个白，她的额头上喷出了汗水。

descriptosaurus-009938.en: She hunched her shoulders and bent forward, hands on knees, gasping for air.
descriptosaurus-009938.zh: 她弯下腰，向前弯曲，双手放在膝盖上，喘着粗气。

descriptosaurus-009939.en: He limped slowly away, with his foot dragging behind him and scraping on the pavement.
descriptosaurus-009939.zh: 他慢慢地一瘸一拐地走开，他的脚被拖到身后，在人行道上刮擦。

descriptosaurus-009940.en: His legs buckled under him and he slumped on the pavement, legs splayed and eyes rolling back in their sockets.
descriptosaurus-009940.zh: 他的腿弯曲在他身下，他倒在人行道上，双腿张开，眼睛在他们的窝里向后翻滚。

descriptosaurus-009941.en: Staggering to a halt, she slumped to the ground.

descriptosaurus-009942.en: Curled in a ball, he shuddered and shivered violently.
descriptosaurus-009942.zh: 他在一个球中蜷缩起来，颤抖着，剧烈地颤抖着。

descriptosaurus-009943.en: Clutching at his stomach, he doubled over, gasping as the pain shuddered through his body.
descriptosaurus-009943.zh: 他紧紧抓住他的肚子，一边倒下，一边喘着粗气，整个人都在颤抖。

descriptosaurus-010165.zh: 飞向他的是一只巨大的青铜蝎子。

descriptosaurus-010166.en: A hideous creature crawled out from behind the tree.
descriptosaurus-010166.zh: 一个可怕的生物从树后爬了出来。

descriptosaurus-010167.en: It was part ape and part scorpion.

descriptosaurus-010168.en: It had the body of a lizard and the head of a badger.
descriptosaurus-010168.zh: 它有蜥蜴的身体和獾的头。

descriptosaurus-010169.en: A winged creature, with a terrifying, demonic face, swooped down from the tree.
descriptosaurus-010169.zh: 一个有翅膀的生物，有一张可怕的恶魔脸，从树上俯冲下来。

descriptosaurus-010170.en: The island was guarded by a fierce sea monster with an enormous, humped, serpentine body and a hideous cockroach head.
descriptosaurus-010170.zh: 岛上被一个凶猛的海怪守卫着，身材庞大，驼背，蛇形的身体和可怕的蟑螂头。

descriptosaurus-010171.en: The three-legged bird had the huge wings of an albatross, the claws of an eagle and hog’s tusks.
descriptosaurus-010171.zh: 这只三足鸟有信天翁的巨大翅膀，鹰的爪子和猪的长牙。

descriptosaurus-010172.en: The vile creature was so terrifying that anyone who looked at it died instantly.
descriptosaurus-010172.zh: 邪恶的生物是如此可怕，以至于任何看到它的人都会立即死亡。

descriptosaurus-010173.en: It looked as if there were two creatures twisted together, but as it moved its huge slime green body, Robert could see that it was actually a two-headed monster, with a racoon head at the front and a beetle head at the back.
descriptosaurus-010173.zh: 看起来好像有两个生物扭在一起，但当它移动着巨大的粘液绿色身体时，罗伯特可以看出它实际上是一个两头怪物，前面有一个浣熊头，后面有一个甲虫头。
