descriptosaurus-010264.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-010272.en: Bare skin around its face and neck
descriptosaurus-010272.zh: 脸和脖子周围的裸露皮肤

descriptosaurus-010273.en: Skin as slippery as polished leather
descriptosaurus-010273.zh: 像抛光皮革一样光滑的皮肤

descriptosaurus-010290.en: Mane and beard like a bison

descriptosaurus-010295.zh: 像丝绸一样柔软的鳞片

descriptosaurus-010298.en: Gleaming feathers of scarlet and gold
descriptosaurus-010298.zh: 猩红色和金色的闪闪发光的羽毛

descriptosaurus-010299.zh: 厚厚的黑色羽毛的鬃毛

descriptosaurus-010300.en: Ring of crimson feathers around its neck
descriptosaurus-010300.zh: 脖子上有一圈深红色的羽毛

descriptosaurus-010304.en: Body armour with spikes on its shoulders

descriptosaurus-010305.en: Tough, armour-plated skin with pointed, bony plates
descriptosaurus-010305.zh: 坚韧，镀甲的皮肤，尖头，骨板

descriptosaurus-010310.en: Ran from its head to the tip of its tail
descriptosaurus-010310.zh: 从它的头到尾巴的尖端

descriptosaurus-010311.en: Ran the length of its body

descriptosaurus-010313.en: Hung loosely on its skeletal body
descriptosaurus-010313.zh: 松散地挂在它的骨骼上

descriptosaurus-010314.zh: 紧紧抓住它无肉的骷髅

descriptosaurus-010321.zh: 覆盖着尖锐的金属羽毛

descriptosaurus-010323.en: Hair and beard made from living grass and vines
descriptosaurus-010323.zh: 由活草和藤蔓制成的头发和胡须

descriptosaurus-010324.en: Covered in studs, spikes and horns

descriptosaurus-010327.en: Bulged with green spots that oozed a yellow liquid
descriptosaurus-010327.zh: 带有渗出黄色液体的绿色斑点

descriptosaurus-010329.zh: 闪闪发光的红色和金色

descriptosaurus-010331.en: It had thick red feathers around its neck.
descriptosaurus-010331.zh: 它的脖子上有厚厚的红色羽毛。

descriptosaurus-010332.en: Porcupine quills ran the length of its body.
descriptosaurus-010332.zh: 豪猪羽毛笔贯穿其身体的长度。

descriptosaurus-010333.en: Its hairy whiskers were long, purple and twitching.
descriptosaurus-010333.zh: 它的毛须长，紫色和抽搐。

descriptosaurus-010334.en: It was half-human, half-hyena, with long, wild green hair.
descriptosaurus-010334.zh: 它是半人半鬣狗，长着野生的绿色头发。

descriptosaurus-010335.en: The sun glinted on the sharp spikes sprouting from its legs.
descriptosaurus-010335.zh: 太阳从腿上冒出的尖尖的尖刺上闪闪发光。

descriptosaurus-010336.en: The five-headed, monstrous beast was covered in bulging, green spots.
descriptosaurus-010336.zh: 这只五头怪物的野兽被凸出的绿色斑点所覆盖。

descriptosaurus-010337.en: No-one dared to go near the caves, which were guarded by vicious female monsters, with boar tusks and hair of writhing, hissing snakes.
descriptosaurus-010337.zh: 没有人敢靠近那些被恶毒的女怪物守卫的洞穴，长着野猪的象牙和扭动的发出嘶嘶声的蛇的头发。

descriptosaurus-010338.en: Below the waist, it was covered in black fur, and above, stinger-tipped tentacles hung from its body.
descriptosaurus-010338.zh: 腰部以下是黑色的毛皮，上面挂着刺尖的触手。

descriptosaurus-010339.en: Grinning maliciously at him was an ugly little goblin, with a sly face and hard, leathery skin covered in warts.
descriptosaurus-010339.zh: 恶意地对他咧嘴一笑的是一个丑陋的小妖精，一个狡猾的脸，坚硬，坚硬的皮肤上覆盖着疣。

descriptosaurus-010457.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-010461.zh: 像螺旋桨一样扭曲的头

descriptosaurus-010464.zh: 狭窄的头和凸起的头骨

descriptosaurus-010470.zh: 死亡的苍白，鳞片状的皮肤

descriptosaurus-010472.en: Some of its flesh was missing

descriptosaurus-010473.en: Horn in the middle of its forehead

descriptosaurus-010474.zh: 像雄鹿一样的金色鹿角

descriptosaurus-010476.en: Sharp tusks like a wild boar
descriptosaurus-010476.zh: 像野猪一样锋利的象牙

descriptosaurus-010478.en: Central horn like a thrusting sword
descriptosaurus-010478.zh: 中央喇叭像一把推力剑

descriptosaurus-010483.en: Hood of purple skin around its head
descriptosaurus-010483.zh: 头顶周围有紫色皮肤罩

descriptosaurus-010485.en: Venom-storing blowhole on top of its head
descriptosaurus-010485.zh: 头顶上的毒液储存气孔

descriptosaurus-010490.en: Savage, needle teeth like spikes on a trap
descriptosaurus-010490.zh: 野蛮，针齿像陷阱上的尖刺

descriptosaurus-010491.zh: 像皮下注射针一样的尖牙

descriptosaurus-010501.en: Curved beak as merciless as a dagger
descriptosaurus-010501.zh: 弯曲的喙像匕首一样无情

descriptosaurus-010502.en: As sharp as the edge of a blade

descriptosaurus-010508.en: Curved from its head like a dagger
descriptosaurus-010508.zh: 像匕首一样从头顶弯曲

descriptosaurus-010509.en: Spiked upwards like a thrusting sword

descriptosaurus-010515.en: Tasted the air in search of its prey

descriptosaurus-010516.en: Dripped with blood from its last kill
descriptosaurus-010516.zh: 滴下最后一次杀戮中的鲜血

descriptosaurus-010518.en: Huge folds of sagging skin drooped from its long, snarling face.
descriptosaurus-010518.zh: 巨大的下垂皮肤褶皱从它长长的、咆哮的脸上垂下。

descriptosaurus-010519.en: Its small, narrow head had a rounded beak like a turtle.
descriptosaurus-010519.zh: 它的小而窄的头有一个像乌龟一样圆形的喙。

descriptosaurus-010520.en: It was small and wrinkled, with a large, knobbly, bald head like a turnip.
descriptosaurus-010520.zh: 它又小又皱，有一个大而多节的光头，像萝卜一样。

descriptosaurus-010521.en: A malicious, demonic face peered through the strands of the web.
descriptosaurus-010521.zh: 一张恶魔般的恶魔面孔透过网中凝视着。

descriptosaurus-010522.en: It had an ape-like face with a beak.
descriptosaurus-010522.zh: 它有一张像猿一样的脸和喙。

descriptosaurus-010523.en: Some of its flesh was missing, as if it had been eaten away by acid.
descriptosaurus-010523.zh: 它的一些肉不见了，好像它被酸吃掉了。

descriptosaurus-010524.en: Two long corkscrew horns grew from its cone-shaped head.
descriptosaurus-010524.zh: 两个长长的螺旋角从锥形的头上长出。

descriptosaurus-010525.en: There was a single, spiral horn in the middle of its forehead.
descriptosaurus-010525.zh: 它的额头中间有一个螺旋喇叭。

descriptosaurus-010526.en: Its bulging skull had two corkscrew horns.
descriptosaurus-010526.zh: 它凸出的头骨有两个螺旋喇叭。

descriptosaurus-010527.en: Rubbery feelers sprouted from its mouth.
descriptosaurus-010527.zh: 橡胶状的触角从嘴里冒出来。

descriptosaurus-010528.en: Huge, spiralling antennae erupted from its head.
descriptosaurus-010528.zh: 巨大的螺旋状天线从它的头部喷出。

descriptosaurus-010529.en: It had a blunt-snouted head, with a central horn that spiked upwards like a thrusting sword.
descriptosaurus-010529.zh: 它有一个钝鼻子的头，一个中央喇叭像一把刺刀的剑一样向上尖刺。

descriptosaurus-010530.en: Stinger-tipped tentacles hung from its enormous, wedge-shaped head.
descriptosaurus-010530.zh: 刺尖的触手悬挂在它巨大的楔形头上。

descriptosaurus-010531.en: A stream of venom shot into the air from the blowhole on top of its head.
descriptosaurus-010531.zh: 一股毒液从头顶的气孔射入空气中。

descriptosaurus-010532.en: Its scaly head was like that of a lizard and was surrounded by a hood of slime green and red skin.
descriptosaurus-010532.zh: 它的鳞片状的头像蜥蜴一样，被粘液和红色皮肤的引擎盖包围。

descriptosaurus-010533.en: Venomous slime drooled from its razor-sharp fangs.
descriptosaurus-010533.zh: 有毒的粘液从锋利的尖牙中流出。

descriptosaurus-010534.en: Savage needle teeth tore at Kitty’s legs, like spikes on a trap.
descriptosaurus-010534.zh: 野蛮的针牙撕裂了小猫的腿，就像陷阱上的尖刺一样。

descriptosaurus-010535.en: It opened its mouth to reveal thin, needle-sharp teeth.
descriptosaurus-010535.zh: 它张开嘴，露出细长的尖牙。

descriptosaurus-010536.en: Fangs curled beneath its chin and dribbled with blood from its last kill.
descriptosaurus-010536.zh: 尖牙在它的下巴下蜷缩着，滴下最后一次杀戮的血迹。

descriptosaurus-010537.en: Its forked tongue flickered constantly, tasting the air in search of its prey.
descriptosaurus-010537.zh: 它的叉舌不断闪烁，品尝空气以寻找猎物。

descriptosaurus-010538.en: It had a cruel, metallic beak that curved from its head like a dagger.
descriptosaurus-010538.zh: 它有一个残酷的金属喙，像匕首一样从它的头上弯曲。

descriptosaurus-010604.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-010614.en: Single round eye like a spotlight
descriptosaurus-010614.zh: 像聚光灯一样的单圆眼

descriptosaurus-010618.zh: 在橡胶状、抽搐的眼茎上

descriptosaurus-010619.zh: 两只抬起的小蝙蝠眼睛

descriptosaurus-010626.en: Bulging and fierce in its hideous face
descriptosaurus-010626.zh: 丑陋的脸庞上鼓起和凶猛

descriptosaurus-010634.en: Glowed like flickering sparks in the dark
descriptosaurus-010634.zh: 像黑暗中闪烁的火花一样发光

descriptosaurus-010639.en: Its beady black eyes glinted with greed.
descriptosaurus-010639.zh: 它那闪亮的黑色眼睛闪烁着贪婪的光芒。

descriptosaurus-010640.en: Its red eyes burned with a cruel light from its long, snarling face.
descriptosaurus-010640.zh: 红色的眼睛从长长的、咆哮的脸上燃烧着残酷的光芒。

descriptosaurus-010641.en: Goggling yellow eyes glinted from rubbery, twitching eye-stalks.
descriptosaurus-010641.zh: 闪烁的黄色眼睛被橡胶般的、抽搐的眼梗闪闪发光。

descriptosaurus-010642.en: It had a single round orange eye in the middle of its forehead.
descriptosaurus-010642.zh: 它的额头中间有一只圆形的橙色眼睛。

descriptosaurus-010643.en: Its glowing red eyes were bulging and fierce in its hideous face.
descriptosaurus-010643.zh: 它那闪闪发光的红色眼睛在它可怕的脸上凸出而凶猛。

descriptosaurus-010644.en: Its eyes were the size of headlights and cast wide beams of light on the ground in front of it.
descriptosaurus-010644.zh: 它的眼睛有大灯那么大，在它前面的地面上投下了宽阔的光束。

descriptosaurus-010645.en: She closed her eyes to escape the cold, staring eyes that drilled into her from its sharp-beaked bird’s head.
descriptosaurus-010645.zh: 她闭上了眼睛，以逃避冰冷的凝视，从尖锐的鸟嘴里钻进了她的眼睛。

descriptosaurus-010646.en: Above a curved beak as sharp as a blade, its bulging orange eyes burned like furnaces.
descriptosaurus-010646.zh: 在像刀片一样锋利的弯曲的喙上，它凸出的橙色眼睛像熔炉一样燃烧。

descriptosaurus-010647.en: Its eyes were on top of long stalks, which twisted and writhed as they followed Kitty’s every movement.
descriptosaurus-010647.zh: 它的眼睛盯着长长的茎，当它们跟随凯蒂的一举一动时，它们扭动着扭动着。

descriptosaurus-010648.en: It had piercing red eyes, which glowed like flickering sparks in the dark.
descriptosaurus-010648.zh: 它有着刺眼的红色眼睛，像黑暗中闪烁的火花一样发光。

descriptosaurus-010650.zh: 第 1 节 – 手臂和手

descriptosaurus-010688.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-010689.en: Long arms like rippling octopus tentacles

descriptosaurus-010696.en: Suckers on the ends of its hands

descriptosaurus-010702.en: Huge, menacing claws as sharp as a dagger
descriptosaurus-010702.zh: 巨大的、威胁性的爪子像匕首一样锋利

descriptosaurus-010704.en: Eagle talons on its fingers were long and deadly
descriptosaurus-010704.zh: 手指上的鹰爪长而致命

descriptosaurus-010707.zh: 折叠，像鸟一样，在它的肩膀下

descriptosaurus-010709.zh: 像无心的蛆虫一样扭动着

descriptosaurus-010712.en: Its arms were small, useless stumps with webbed fingers.
descriptosaurus-010712.zh: 它的手臂很小，毫无用处，有网状手指。

descriptosaurus-010713.en: There were long, deadly, brass talons on the end of her fingers.
descriptosaurus-010713.zh: 她的手指末端有长而致命的黄铜爪子。

descriptosaurus-010714.en: Each of its six fingers had claws as sharp as razor blades.
descriptosaurus-010714.zh: 它的六个手指中的每一个都有像剃须刀片一样锋利的爪子。

descriptosaurus-010715.en: The ends of its fingers were speared by hooked claws like coat hangers.
descriptosaurus-010715.zh: 它的手指的末端被挂在衣架上的钩爪刺成。

descriptosaurus-010716.en: Its arms were so long its knuckles grazed along the ground.
descriptosaurus-010716.zh: 它的手臂如此之长，它的指关节沿着地面擦伤。

descriptosaurus-010717.en: It had short arms that folded, bird-like, under its shoulders.
descriptosaurus-010717.zh: 它的手臂在肩膀下折叠，像鸟一样折叠。

descriptosaurus-010718.en: Dead, white fingers wriggled like mindless maggots from the end of its octopus tentacles.
descriptosaurus-010718.zh: 从章鱼触手的末端，死去的白色手指像无意识的蛆虫一样扭动着。

descriptosaurus-010719.en: As its long arms dragged along the ground, its huge, menacing claws scraped tracks in the earth.
descriptosaurus-010719.zh: 当它长长的手臂拖在地上时，它巨大的、威胁性的爪子在地球上刮伤了痕迹。

descriptosaurus-010720.en: It opened its hand and displayed its claws, which had points as sharp as a dagger.
descriptosaurus-010720.zh: 它张开手，展示了它的爪子，它的尖端像匕首一样锋利。

descriptosaurus-010763.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-010766.en: Legs of a goat and eagle talons

descriptosaurus-010767.en: Six short, thick legs like a hippo’s
descriptosaurus-010767.zh: 像河马的六个短而粗的腿

descriptosaurus-010768.en: Front legs shorter than the hind legs

descriptosaurus-010770.en: Powerful hind legs and a kangaroo tail
descriptosaurus-010770.zh: 强大的后腿和袋鼠尾巴

descriptosaurus-010772.en: Long, agile legs and four-toed feet
descriptosaurus-010772.zh: 长而敏捷的腿和四趾脚

descriptosaurus-010780.en: Suction cups on tips of toes

descriptosaurus-010782.en: Used to crawl on all fours

descriptosaurus-010785.en: Linked to poison glands in its body

descriptosaurus-010787.en: Extended from a thick leg in the middle of its body
descriptosaurus-010787.zh: 从身体中间的粗腿伸出

descriptosaurus-010790.en: The spurs on its front legs were linked to poison glands in its body.
descriptosaurus-010790.zh: 前腿上的马刺与体内的毒腺相连。

descriptosaurus-010791.en: A brown mist gushed from the spurs on its powerful front legs.
descriptosaurus-010791.zh: 一股棕色的雾气从马刺上强大的前腿喷涌而出。

descriptosaurus-010792.en: A single large foot extended from one thick leg in the middle of its body.
descriptosaurus-010792.zh: 一只大脚从身体中间的一条粗腿伸出。

descriptosaurus-010793.en: The giant shuffled clumsily on its tree-trunk legs and large tortoise feet.
descriptosaurus-010793.zh: 巨人笨拙地拖着树干的腿和大乌龟的脚。

descriptosaurus-010794.en: It was a thin, two-legged beast, with seven clawed toes on each foot.
descriptosaurus-010794.zh: 那是一只瘦小的两条腿的野兽，每只脚上有七个爪子的脚趾。

descriptosaurus-010795.en: It had legs like a horse and its cushioned paws were tipped with vulture claws.
descriptosaurus-010795.zh: 它有像马一样的腿，它的软垫爪子上有秃鹰爪子。

descriptosaurus-010796.en: It had two scaly legs and giant chicken feet that ended in sharp claws.
descriptosaurus-010796.zh: 它有两条有鳞的腿和巨大的鸡爪，以锋利的爪子结束。

descriptosaurus-010797.en: Its hind legs were like huge tree trunks, but its front legs were short and skinny and only used when it crawled on all fours.
descriptosaurus-010797.zh: 它的后腿就像巨大的树干，但它的前腿又短又瘦，只有在四肢爬行时才使用。

descriptosaurus-010798.en: It had powerful hind legs and feet, which were tipped with vicious talons.
descriptosaurus-010798.zh: 它有强大的后腿和脚，上面有恶毒的爪子。

descriptosaurus-010799.en: Its powerful hind legs and kangaroo tail acted as a tripod, as it stood motionless, watching them with its darting, red eyes.
descriptosaurus-010799.zh: 它强大的后腿和袋鼠尾巴就像一个三脚架，它一动不动地站着，用它那闪亮的红色眼睛注视着它们。

descriptosaurus-010800.en: Its feet could face backwards and forwards, so it was impossible to tell from its footprints which direction the creature had taken.
descriptosaurus-010800.zh: 它的脚可以向后和向前，因此无法从它的脚印中分辨出这个生物的方向。

descriptosaurus-010811.zh: 鬐甲（动物肩胛之间隆起的部位）

descriptosaurus-010833.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-010845.en: Folded its wings against its shoulders
descriptosaurus-010845.zh: 将它的翅膀折叠在它的肩膀上

descriptosaurus-010847.en: Sent air rushing through the trees

descriptosaurus-010849.en: Long, scaly wings sprouted from its shoulders.
descriptosaurus-010849.zh: 长而有鳞的翅膀从它的肩膀上长出来。

descriptosaurus-010850.en: Winged death spirits haunted the forest.
descriptosaurus-010850.zh: 有翅膀的死亡灵魂在森林中萦绕。

descriptosaurus-010851.en: Huge, black, bat-like wings burst from each wither.
descriptosaurus-010851.zh: 巨大的黑色，蝙蝠状的翅膀从每个枯萎中爆裂出来。

descriptosaurus-010852.en: It fluttered its shiny beetle-wings and stuck its snarling face through the strands of its web.
descriptosaurus-010852.zh: 它飞舞着闪亮的甲虫翅膀，将它咆哮的脸穿过它的网。

descriptosaurus-010853.en: It circled above, folded its long, scaly wings flat against its shoulders and dived towards them.
descriptosaurus-010853.zh: 它在上面盘旋，将长长的鳞片翅膀平放在肩膀上，向它们俯冲。

descriptosaurus-010854.en: The winged death spirits sent the air rushing through the trees with every beat of their huge, bat-like wings.
descriptosaurus-010854.zh: 有翅膀的死亡之灵让空气在树林中奔跑，每一次拍打着巨大的蝙蝠般的翅膀。

descriptosaurus-010901.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-010904.zh: 带刺的，像桨一样的尾巴

descriptosaurus-010905.zh: 长而硬的，像舵一样的尾巴

descriptosaurus-010906.en: Snake’s head at the end of its tail

descriptosaurus-010910.en: Long tail with a spear at the end

descriptosaurus-010911.en: Club at the end of its tail

descriptosaurus-010914.en: Broad, flat tail like a squashed pine cone
descriptosaurus-010914.zh: 像压扁的松果一样宽而扁平的尾巴

descriptosaurus-010917.en: Tipped with four tall, poisonous spines
descriptosaurus-010917.zh: 尖头有四个高大的有毒刺

descriptosaurus-010920.en: Used its tail to swing through the trees
descriptosaurus-010920.zh: 用它的尾巴在树上摆动

descriptosaurus-010921.en: Thrashed the air, searching for its target

descriptosaurus-010923.en: Its thick, heavy tail dragged along behind it.
descriptosaurus-010923.zh: 它粗壮的尾巴拖在它身后。

descriptosaurus-010924.en: The club at the end thumped on the ground with every step.
descriptosaurus-010924.zh: 末端的俱乐部每一步都在地面上砰砰作响。

descriptosaurus-010925.en: Its tail was broad and flat like a squashed pine cone.
descriptosaurus-010925.zh: 它的尾巴宽而平，像压扁的松果。

descriptosaurus-010926.en: The spikes studded along its length made it a lethal weapon.
descriptosaurus-010926.zh: 沿着它的长度镶嵌的尖刺使它成为一种致命的武器。

descriptosaurus-010927.en: It hung from the branch by its long, lemur-like tail and swung towards them, baring its needle-sharp teeth.
descriptosaurus-010927.zh: 它挂在树枝上，长长的狐猴般的尾巴向它们摆动，露出尖锐的牙齿。

descriptosaurus-010928.en: Its four poisonous spines were thrust upwards like spears – thrashing the air – searching for their target.
descriptosaurus-010928.zh: 它的四个毒刺像长矛一样向上推——在空气中掠过——寻找它们的目标。

descriptosaurus-010971.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-010979.en: Smelt of rotting plants and seaweed
descriptosaurus-010979.zh: 腐烂的植物和海藻的气味

descriptosaurus-010980.en: Clung to it like a rotting cloak
descriptosaurus-010980.zh: 像腐烂的斗篷一样紧紧抓住它

descriptosaurus-010983.en: Surrounded by the stench of poisonous acid

descriptosaurus-010984.en: Polluted the air with each beat of its wings
descriptosaurus-010984.zh: 每次拍打翅膀都污染了空气

descriptosaurus-010987.en: Its breath stank of rotting meat.

descriptosaurus-010988.en: The dragon’s breath smelt of smoke and sulphur.
descriptosaurus-010988.zh: 龙的气息闻到了烟雾和硫磺的味道。

descriptosaurus-010989.en: It gave offa pungent odour of decay and rotting flesh.
descriptosaurus-010989.zh: 它散发出腐烂和腐烂的肉味的刺鼻气味。

descriptosaurus-010990.en: A foul-smelling vapour polluted the air with each beat of its wings.
descriptosaurus-010990.zh: 一股恶臭的气味污染了空气的每一次拍打翅膀。

descriptosaurus-010991.en: The stink of rotting meat and decay clung to the beast like a rotting cloak.
descriptosaurus-010991.zh: 腐烂的肉和腐烂的臭味像腐烂的斗篷一样紧贴着野兽。

descriptosaurus-010992.en: Its fur reeked of decaying plants and foul water from years spent in the swamps.
descriptosaurus-010992.zh: 它的皮毛散发着腐烂的植物和在沼泽中度过的多年污水。

descriptosaurus-010993.en: Its breath stank of rotting meat and the blood from its last kill dripped from its fangs.
descriptosaurus-010993.zh: 它腐烂的肉的气息和最后一次杀戮的血液从它的尖牙滴落。

descriptosaurus-010994.en: She retched as the creature drew near and the stench of decay and rotting flesh wafted towards her.
descriptosaurus-010994.zh: 当这个生物接近时，她干呕，腐烂和腐烂的肉体的恶臭向她飘来。

descriptosaurus-010995.en: Even though it was invisible, she knew the death spirit was near, from the pungent odour of decay and rotting flesh that surrounded it.
descriptosaurus-010995.zh: 尽管它是看不见的，但她知道死亡之灵就在附近，因为它周围的腐烂和腐烂的肉体的刺鼻气味。

descriptosaurus-011034.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-011054.en: The sound of its piercing squawk rang in his ears.
descriptosaurus-011054.zh: 刺耳的尖叫声在他耳边响起。

descriptosaurus-011055.en: It threw back its head and let out a mournful howl.
descriptosaurus-011055.zh: 它向后仰头，发出一声悲伤的嚎叫。

descriptosaurus-011056.en: A loud, hooting call echoed through the night.
descriptosaurus-011056.zh: 一个响亮的叫喊声在夜里回荡。

descriptosaurus-011057.en: A blood-curdling howl ripped through the air.
descriptosaurus-011057.zh: 空气中一阵血腥的嚎叫声响起。

descriptosaurus-011058.en: The silence was pierced by a high-pitched scream high in the trees.
descriptosaurus-011058.zh: 寂静被树林中高高的尖叫声刺穿。

descriptosaurus-011059.en: The hideous beast had imitated her father’s voice to lure her into its den.
descriptosaurus-011059.zh: 这只丑陋的野兽模仿了她父亲的声音来引诱她进入它的巢穴。

descriptosaurus-011101.en: Flew through the air in a giant coconut
descriptosaurus-011101.zh: 在一个巨大的椰子中飞过空中

descriptosaurus-011102.en: Passed in a swirl of dust

descriptosaurus-011104.en: Ran in pecking strides like a scuttling lizard
descriptosaurus-011104.zh: 像一只飞快的蜥蜴一样在啄食的步伐中奔跑

descriptosaurus-011105.en: Dragged its clawed foot over the ground

descriptosaurus-011106.en: Slithered very quickly in both directions
descriptosaurus-011106.zh: 在两个方向上滑得很快

descriptosaurus-011107.en: Locked the jaws of its two heads together
descriptosaurus-011107.zh: 把它的两个头的下巴锁在一起

descriptosaurus-011109.en: Moved around on a pair of dancing spider’s legs
descriptosaurus-011109.zh: 用一对跳舞的蜘蛛腿四处走动

descriptosaurus-011110.en: Moved around by skiing on its enormous feet
descriptosaurus-011110.zh: 通过用巨大的脚滑雪移动

descriptosaurus-011111.en: Floated across the snow like a mist

descriptosaurus-011114.en: It floated across the snow like a mist and left no footprints.
descriptosaurus-011114.zh: 它像雾一样飘过雪地，没有留下任何脚印。

descriptosaurus-011115.en: It covered its movements by spurting a yellow cloud out of its snout.
descriptosaurus-011115.zh: 它通过从鼻子喷出一朵黄色的云来掩盖它的运动。

descriptosaurus-011116.en: It moved towards them and then passed by in a swirl of dust.
descriptosaurus-011116.zh: 它向他们移动，然后在一团尘埃中经过。

descriptosaurus-011117.en: One moment it was standing upright on its hind legs and then – it locked its two ends together and rolled like a hoop towards him.
descriptosaurus-011117.zh: 有一刻，它的后腿直立，然后——它把它的两端锁在一起，像一个箍一样向他滚动。

descriptosaurus-011118.en: It walked slowly – clumsily dragging its clawed foot over the ground.
descriptosaurus-011118.zh: 它慢慢地走着——笨拙地把爪子拖到地上。

descriptosaurus-011119.en: There was a rush of air as the witch flew over his head in a huge coconut.
descriptosaurus-011119.zh: 当女巫在一个巨大的椰子中飞过他的头顶时，一阵空气涌动。

descriptosaurus-011120.en: Using a skull to steer the vessel, she circled above and screeched with laughter.
descriptosaurus-011120.zh: 她用头骨指着船只，在上面盘旋，大笑起来。

descriptosaurus-011121.en: As he drew closer, the spirit vanished in a cloud of mist and reappeared behind him.
descriptosaurus-011121.zh: 随着他越来越近，灵魂在雾云中消失了，在他身后重新出现。

descriptosaurus-011164.zh: 短语 – 名词和形容词

descriptosaurus-011174.zh: 海藻洞穴中隐藏的贝壳

descriptosaurus-011177.en: Guarded the treasures of the dead

descriptosaurus-011179.en: Tunnelled underground and uprooted trees in its path
descriptosaurus-011179.zh: 隧道地下和连根拔起的树木在其路径上

descriptosaurus-011181.en: Came out of the water at night

descriptosaurus-011182.en: Stood in the middle of the ocean

descriptosaurus-011183.en: Lodged itself in a house and lived in the boots
descriptosaurus-011183.zh: 住在房子里，住在靴子里

descriptosaurus-011185.en: It stood in the middle of the ocean and, at a distance, appeared to be an enormous rock.
descriptosaurus-011185.zh: 它矗立在海洋的中间，远处，似乎是一块巨大的岩石。

descriptosaurus-011186.en: It hid in the rocks and only came out at night to search for prey.
descriptosaurus-011186.zh: 它躲在岩石中，晚上才出来寻找猎物。

descriptosaurus-011187.en: They found the tiny creature living in a seashell hidden by seaweed caves.
descriptosaurus-011187.zh: 他们发现生活在海藻洞穴的贝壳中的微小生物。

descriptosaurus-011188.en: It lived underground and tunnelled through the earth, uprooting trees in its path.
descriptosaurus-011188.zh: 它生活在地下，穿越地球，将树木连根拔起。

descriptosaurus-011189.en: The lake was guarded by a huge, humped monster that stretched from shore to shore.
descriptosaurus-011189.zh: 湖由一个巨大的、驼背的怪物守卫着，从岸边延伸到岸边。

descriptosaurus-011190.en: Its humps looked like islands dotted across the water.
descriptosaurus-011190.zh: 它的驼峰看起来像散布在水面上的岛屿。

descriptosaurus-011191.en: The hag lived in a house guarded by a fence of human bones, lit by skulls with glowing eyes.
descriptosaurus-011191.zh: 女巫住在一个被人骨栅栏守卫的房子里，被骷髅照亮，眼睛发光。

descriptosaurus-011192.en: The vicious spirit had sneaked into their house and was living in the boots.
descriptosaurus-011192.zh: 恶毒的灵魂潜入他们的房子，住在靴子里。

descriptosaurus-011194.zh: 第 1 节 – 改变外观

descriptosaurus-011252.en: Transformed from a human to an animal and back again
descriptosaurus-011252.zh: 从人类转变为动物，然后再回来

descriptosaurus-011253.en: Detached its upper body in order to fly at night
descriptosaurus-011253.zh: 为了在夜间飞行而拆下上半身

descriptosaurus-011255.en: Arms transformed into huge front legs
descriptosaurus-011255.zh: 手臂变成了巨大的前腿

descriptosaurus-011256.zh: 翅膀从她的肩膀上长出来

descriptosaurus-011257.en: Nose stretched into a sharp beak

descriptosaurus-011258.zh: 指甲被拉成尖头的爪子

descriptosaurus-011259.en: Sprouted thick, dark hair on its face

descriptosaurus-011260.en: Rose from the grave as a wisp of smoke
descriptosaurus-011260.zh: 从坟墓中升起，像一缕烟雾

descriptosaurus-011262.en: Wore a pointed hat that made her invisible
descriptosaurus-011262.zh: 戴着一顶让她隐形的尖帽

descriptosaurus-011263.en: Transformed into a mist and drifted away

descriptosaurus-011264.en: Changed its colour to blend with its surroundings
descriptosaurus-011264.zh: 改变其颜色以与周围环境融为一体

descriptosaurus-011266.en: The spirit rose from the grave as a wisp of smoke and appeared like the corpse lying beneath the ground.
descriptosaurus-011266.zh: 灵魂从坟墓中升起，像一缕烟雾，像是躺在地下的尸体一样出现了。

descriptosaurus-011267.en: He could grow or shrink at will.
descriptosaurus-011267.zh: 他可以随意成长或缩小。

descriptosaurus-011268.en: One moment he was an enormous man and the next, the size of a blade of grass.
descriptosaurus-011268.zh: 一瞬间，他是一个巨大的人，下一刻，一片草叶那么大。

descriptosaurus-011269.en: The only sign of her presence was the tinkle of the tiny silver bells, which were attached to the pointed hat she wore to make herself invisible.
descriptosaurus-011269.zh: 她出现的唯一迹象是微小的银色铃铛的叮当声，它附在她戴着的尖帽上，让自己隐形。

descriptosaurus-011270.en: As his face sprouted thick, dark hair, his limbs twisted and writhed.
descriptosaurus-011270.zh: 当他的脸发芽浓密的黑发时，他的四肢扭曲和扭动。

descriptosaurus-011271.en: He crouched down on his arms, which had transformed into huge front legs.
descriptosaurus-011271.zh: 他蹲在他的手臂上，变成了巨大的前腿。

descriptosaurus-011272.en: Her black cloak spread, as wings sprouted from her shoulders.
descriptosaurus-011272.zh: 她的黑色斗篷张开，翅膀从她的肩膀上长出来。

descriptosaurus-011273.en: Her nose stretched into a sharp beak and, flapping her wings, she flew into the trees – transformed into a raven.
descriptosaurus-011273.zh: 她的鼻子伸成一个锋利的喙，拍打着翅膀，飞进了树上——变成了一只乌鸦。

descriptosaurus-011274.en: He appeared as a normal human during the day, but at night, his head and neck detached from his body and flew about with huge, bat-like wings, leaving his severed torso hidden in the house.
descriptosaurus-011274.zh: 他白天像正常人一样出现，但在晚上，他的头和脖子从他的身体上分离出来，长着巨大的蝙蝠般的翅膀飞来飞去，把他被切断的躯干藏在房子里。

descriptosaurus-011275.en: It was impossible to track, as it could turn its feet to face backwards and still run at incredible speeds.
descriptosaurus-011275.zh: 它是不可能的，因为它可以将脚向后转，并且仍然以令人难以置信的速度奔跑。

descriptosaurus-011306.en: Fed on dead bodies in graveyards

descriptosaurus-011307.en: Drank the fresh blood of cattle

descriptosaurus-011308.en: Ate its tail, which grew back
descriptosaurus-011308.zh: 吃了它的尾巴，它又长回来了

descriptosaurus-011309.en: Travelled vast distances in a flash of smoke
descriptosaurus-011309.zh: 在一道烟雾中走得很远

descriptosaurus-011312.en: Imitated the voice of any human it had heard
descriptosaurus-011312.zh: 模仿它听到的任何人的声音

descriptosaurus-011313.en: Stole the souls of dead bodies before they were buried
descriptosaurus-011313.zh: 在尸体被埋葬之前偷走了尸体的灵魂

descriptosaurus-011314.en: Seeped into the minds of children
descriptosaurus-011314.zh: 渗透到孩子们的脑海中

descriptosaurus-011315.en: Devoured dreams and twisted them into nightmares
descriptosaurus-011315.zh: 吞噬了梦想并将它们扭曲成噩梦

descriptosaurus-011316.en: Appeared as an omen of death

descriptosaurus-011476.zh: 它被光明吓坏了，只会在黑暗中出现。

descriptosaurus-011477.en: The crow of the rooster would kill it, so as dawn approached, it returned to its lair deep underground.

descriptosaurus-011809.en: Part 5 Grammar in a creative context
descriptosaurus-011809.zh: 第 5 部分 创意环境中的语法

descriptosaurus-011812.en: The chapters in Part 5 provide models (poems, sentences, passages) that teach pupils how to embed description and imagery in their writing by using phrases and sentence structures in accordance with the requirements of the National Curriculum, but in a creative context.
descriptosaurus-011812.zh: 第 5 部分中的章节提供了模型（诗歌、句子、段落），这些模型（诗歌、句子、段落）教导学生如何根据国家课程的要求使用短语和句子结构在写作中嵌入描述和意象，但要在创造性的背景下。

descriptosaurus-011813.en: The whole unit has been based on a forest setting.
descriptosaurus-011813.zh: 整个单元都是基于森林环境。

descriptosaurus-011815.en: This starts with modelling the structures in a variety of poems, which provides an ideal opportunity for developing a vocabulary bank for that particular setting.
descriptosaurus-011815.zh: 这首先要对各种诗歌中的结构进行建模，这为为特定环境开发词汇库提供了理想的机会。

descriptosaurus-011816.en: It also enables the focus to be broken down into small ‘chunks,’ to be imitated, practised and, therefore, absorbed.
descriptosaurus-011816.zh: 它还可以将焦点分解成小的“块”，被模仿、练习并因此被吸收。

descriptosaurus-011818.en: The vocabulary accumulated through writing the poems is then used in a series of modelled sentences. Punctuation and sentence structure are important to convey meaning
descriptosaurus-011818.zh: 然后将通过写诗积累的词汇用于一系列模拟句子中。 标点符号和句子结构对传达意义很重要

descriptosaurus-012048.zh: 越过墙壁，它的骨头状，手臂状的触手可以到达。

descriptosaurus-012049.zh: 在巨大的树干中，它隐藏着它的秘密，古老的空洞。

descriptosaurus-012052.en: I have heard the leaves rustling in the wind.
descriptosaurus-012052.zh: 我听说叶子在风中沙沙作响。

descriptosaurus-012053.en: I have heard their whispered threats.
descriptosaurus-012053.zh: 我听说过他们低声的威胁。

descriptosaurus-012054.en: I have heard the snapping of a twig.
descriptosaurus-012054.zh: 我听过一根树枝的折断。

descriptosaurus-012055.en: I have seen the darkened spaces.

descriptosaurus-012056.en: I have seen the ghostly shadows cloaked in mist.
descriptosaurus-012056.zh: 我见过幽灵般的阴影笼罩在迷雾中。

descriptosaurus-012057.en: I have touched the dagger-like thorns.
descriptosaurus-012057.zh: 我触摸了像匕首一样的荆棘。

descriptosaurus-012058.en: I have smelled the decaying carpet of rotting leaves.
descriptosaurus-012058.zh: 我闻到腐烂的树叶腐烂的地毯。

descriptosaurus-012059.en: I have felt the squelching mud around my ankles.
descriptosaurus-012059.zh: 我感觉到脚踝周围的泥泞。

descriptosaurus-012060.en: And a strange sensation is gripping the back of my neck.
descriptosaurus-012060.zh: 一种奇怪的感觉抓住了我的脖子后面。

descriptosaurus-012061.en: She has heard the alarm call for the forest.
descriptosaurus-012061.zh: 她听到了对森林的警报。

descriptosaurus-012062.en: She has heard the birds singing at dawn.
descriptosaurus-012062.zh: 她听到了黎明时分的鸟儿在唱歌。

descriptosaurus-012063.en: She has heard their joyful chorus.
descriptosaurus-012063.zh: 她听过他们欢快的合唱。

descriptosaurus-012064.en: She has seen the sun rise in an explosion of orange.
descriptosaurus-012064.zh: 她看到太阳在橙色爆炸中升起。

descriptosaurus-012065.en: She has touched the liquid diamonds of the morning dew.
descriptosaurus-012065.zh: 她触摸了晨露的液体钻石。

descriptosaurus-012066.en: She has felt the crunch of frosty leaves beneath her feet.
descriptosaurus-012066.zh: 她感受到了脚下冰冷的树叶的嘎吱声。

descriptosaurus-012067.en: She has smelled the sweet scent of pine needles.

descriptosaurus-012068.en: And a wonderful glow of happiness is pulsing in her veins.
descriptosaurus-012068.zh: 一股奇妙的幸福光芒在她的血管中跳动。

descriptosaurus-012071.en: Slowly, towards the ruined archway, he slunk and slithered.
descriptosaurus-012071.zh: 慢慢地，他朝着破败的拱门走去，滑倒了。

descriptosaurus-012072.en: Suddenly, in the trees, a flickering movement, he glimpsed and noted.
descriptosaurus-012072.zh: 突然，在树林里闪烁的动作，他瞥见并注意到。

descriptosaurus-012073.en: Urgently, under the cover of a bush, he sank and dropped.
descriptosaurus-012073.zh: 紧急，在灌木丛的掩护下，他沉了下去。

descriptosaurus-012074.en: Anxiously, between the prickly thorns, he crouched and hid.
descriptosaurus-012074.zh: 焦急地，在刺痛的荆棘之间，他蹲下身子躲了起来。

descriptosaurus-012075.en: Instantly, to the other side of the bush, he spun and whirled.
descriptosaurus-012075.zh: 瞬间，他转身到灌木的另一边，旋转并旋转。

descriptosaurus-012076.en: Frantically, out of the reach of the claws, he jerked and ducked.
descriptosaurus-012076.zh: 疯狂地，从爪子的伸手可及的地方，他抽搐着躲开了。

descriptosaurus-012077.en: Quickly, away from its slavering jaws, he scuttled and scurried.
descriptosaurus-012077.zh: 很快，他远离了它的下巴，他偷偷摸摸地跑了起来。

descriptosaurus-012078.en: Desperately, through the tangled undergrowth, he darted and dashed.
descriptosaurus-012078.zh: 绝望地，穿过纠缠不清的灌木丛，他冲过来冲去。

descriptosaurus-012079.en: Constantly, in the slimy swamp, he slipped and stumbled.
descriptosaurus-012079.zh: 不断地，在黏糊糊的沼泽中，他滑倒了，跌跌撞撞。

descriptosaurus-012081.en: (Subordinate Clauses, Compound Verbs and Prepositional Phrases)

descriptosaurus-012082.en: In case someone was watching, he crawled, and slithered closer to the ruined archway.
descriptosaurus-012082.zh: 万一有人在看，他爬了，滑到了被毁坏的拱门附近。

descriptosaurus-012083.en: While he was looking for the entrance, he glimpsed and noted a flickering movement in the trees.
descriptosaurus-012083.zh: 当他在寻找入口时，他瞥了一眼，注意到树上闪烁的动作。

descriptosaurus-012084.en: When he spotted the movement, he froze, and waited in the shadows.
descriptosaurus-012084.zh: 当他发现这个动作时，他僵住了，在阴影中等待。

descriptosaurus-012085.en: Before he could be spotted, he ducked, and crawled under the cover of the bush.
descriptosaurus-012085.zh: 还没等他被发现，他就躲开，爬到灌木丛的掩护下。

descriptosaurus-012086.en: Because he was terrified of the thundering steps, he crouched, and huddled between the prickly thorns.
descriptosaurus-012086.zh: 因为他害怕雷鸣般的脚步，他蹲下身子，蜷缩在刺痛的荆棘之间。

descriptosaurus-012087.en: When it got close to where he was hiding, he spun, and rolled to the other side of the bush.
descriptosaurus-012087.zh: 当它靠近他藏身的地方时，他转身，滚到灌木的另一边。

descriptosaurus-012088.en: Because it had spotted his movement, it clawed and thrashed at the undergrowth.
descriptosaurus-012088.zh: 因为它发现了他的动作，它抓住了灌木丛。

descriptosaurus-012089.en: As it attacked, he ducked and dodged away from the dagger-like claws.
descriptosaurus-012089.zh: 当它攻击时，他躲开并躲开了匕首般的爪子。

descriptosaurus-012090.en: While it was thrashing at the undergrowth, he scuttled and scrabbled out of his hiding place.
descriptosaurus-012090.zh: 当它在灌木丛中翻腾时，他悄悄地从藏身处爬了出来。

descriptosaurus-012091.en: Before it could spot him, he darted and hurtled down the twisting trail.
descriptosaurus-012091.zh: 在它发现他之前，他冲了过去，冲下了曲折的小路。

descriptosaurus-012092.en: Because the path was uneven, he slipped and stumbled towards the entrance.
descriptosaurus-012092.zh: 因为路不平，他滑倒了，跌跌撞撞地走向入口。

descriptosaurus-012095.en: As quietly as he could, he slunk and slithered, crept and crawled, closer to the ruined archway.
descriptosaurus-012095.zh: 他尽可能安静地溜走、滑行、爬行和爬行，靠近被毁坏的拱门。

descriptosaurus-012096.en: Out of the corner of his eye, he peered and peeked, glanced and glimpsed, a flickering movement in the trees.
descriptosaurus-012096.zh: 他用眼角的余光仔细打量，又偷偷张望；目光匆匆掠过，只见有什么在林间一闪而过。

descriptosaurus-012097.en: Without waiting a moment longer, he stopped and froze, watched and waited, in the shadows.
descriptosaurus-012097.zh: 没有再等一刻，他停下来，在阴影中停下来，看着和等待着。

descriptosaurus-012098.en: As quick as lightning, he ducked and sank, dived and crawled, under the cover of the bush.
descriptosaurus-012098.zh: 就像闪电一样，他在灌木丛的掩护下躲避、沉没、潜水和爬行。

descriptosaurus-012099.en: With every thudding step towards him
descriptosaurus-012099.zh: 随着向他迈进的每一步

descriptosaurus-012101.en: Moments later, he spun and whirled, rolled and slid, to the other side of the bush.
descriptosaurus-012101.zh: 片刻之后，他旋转、旋转、滚动和滑动到灌木丛的另一边。

descriptosaurus-012103.en: Not a moment too soon, he jerked and ducked, swayed and dodged, away from the dagger-like claws.

descriptosaurus-012115.zh: 巨大的天篷挡住了光线。

descriptosaurus-012117.zh: 纠结的灌木丛创造了秘密路径。

descriptosaurus-012126.en: When the spidery tangle of trees and bushes smothers the path; When rotting leaves hide the roots that wriggle across the ground; When the thick tangled branches spread and twist to form dark overhead tunnels and secret paths; When the ceiling of thick branches shuts out the sky; When the path is covered in darkness; When the branches twist and grate against each other like rusty hinges; When the creepers strangle the trees, then the forest has become a forbidden, impenetrable maze.
descriptosaurus-012126.zh: 当树木和灌木的蜘蛛般的缠结使道路窒息时； 当腐烂的叶子隐藏在地面上蠕动的根部时； 当厚厚的树枝蔓延和扭曲，形成黑暗的头顶隧道和秘密路径时； 当厚树枝的天花板将天空关闭时； 当路径被黑暗覆盖时； 当树枝像生锈的铰链一样扭曲和磨碎时； 当爬行者勒死树木时，森林变成了一个禁忌的、无法穿透的迷宫。

descriptosaurus-012127.en: Until you have seen the magnificent forest of majestic trees like vivid green umbrellas; Until you have observed their beautiful green cloaks; Until you have glimpsed the brightly coloured creepers like party streamers; Until you have spotted the swaying tide of blazing bluebells; Until you have stared in amazement at the pale ivory snowdrops with their dainty drooping bells; Until you have marvelled at the glistening icicles like liquid diamonds hanging from the branches, then you haven’t fully wondered at the magic of nature.
descriptosaurus-012127.zh: 直到你看到壮丽的树林，如生动的绿色雨伞； 直到你观察到他们美丽的绿色斗篷； 直到你瞥见了色彩鲜艳的爬行者，比如派对彩带； 直到你发现了炽热的风信子的摇摆不定的浪潮； 直到你惊讶地盯着苍白的象牙雪花莲，它们精致的下垂铃铛； 直到您惊叹于悬挂在树枝上的液体钻石，如闪闪发光的冰柱，那么您还没有完全怀疑大自然的魔力。

descriptosaurus-012130.en: Arching tunnels stretching endlessly towards the shadows, scratching barriers spread across the trails, tangling trap clutching at limbs.
descriptosaurus-012130.zh: 拱起的隧道无止境地延伸到阴影，抓挠在小径上蔓延的障碍，缠绕在四肢上的缠结陷阱。

descriptosaurus-012131.en: The menacing forbidden forest, a dark secretive maze, looms ahead.
descriptosaurus-012131.zh: 险恶的禁林，一个黑暗的秘密迷宫，在前方若隐若现。

descriptosaurus-012132.en: At dusk, in the ghostly grey, in the shivering shadows, with a sinister dance, from the whistling breeze.
descriptosaurus-012132.zh: 黄昏时分，在幽灵般的灰色中，在颤抖的阴影中，带着邪恶的微风，带着邪恶的舞蹈。

descriptosaurus-012135.en: The wind, a frosty wintry breeze, whined and howled, rushing through the undergrowth, rustling the leaves, bending the branches, stealing the leaves, chasing the fallen leaves in circles.
descriptosaurus-012135.zh: 风，一阵寒冷的寒风，呜咽着嚎叫，冲过灌木丛，沙沙作响，弯曲树枝，偷走树叶，盘旋追逐落叶。

descriptosaurus-012137.en: Wherever he looked, wherever he moved, the tangled, thorny barriers were a spiked trap: to grasp at his arms, to clutch at his ankles, to scratch at his face, to capture him in their barbed spider’s web – a prickly barricade guarding the trail.
descriptosaurus-012137.zh: 无论他走到哪里，无论他走到哪里，纠结的、多刺的障碍都是一个尖刺的陷阱：抓住他的手臂，抓住他的脚踝，抓挠他的脸，抓住他的带刺蜘蛛网中的他——一条多刺的路障。

descriptosaurus-012142.zh: A 部分 – 详细信息

descriptosaurus-012143.zh: 扩展名词短语 (ENP) 和明喻

descriptosaurus-012148.zh: 扩展名词短语 (ENP) 和明喻

descriptosaurus-012149.en: The secret, ancient forest loomed ahead of them.
descriptosaurus-012149.zh: 秘密的古老森林在他们面前隐约可见。

descriptosaurus-012150.en: They were faced with a dark, dense, impenetrable forest.
descriptosaurus-012150.zh: 他们面临着一片黑暗、茂密、无法穿透的森林。

descriptosaurus-012151.en: The leafy shadows flickered eerily in the moonlight.
descriptosaurus-012151.zh: 绿叶的阴影在月光下诡异地闪烁。

descriptosaurus-012152.en: The colourful blossoms danced gleefully in the wind.
descriptosaurus-012152.zh: 五颜六色的花朵在风中欢快地跳舞。

descriptosaurus-012153.en: Clusters of dazzling yellow daffodils nodded their heads in greeting.
descriptosaurus-012153.zh: 一簇簇耀眼的黄色水仙花点点头问候。

descriptosaurus-012154.en: Thickets of gnarled, vicious vines blocked the narrow path.
descriptosaurus-012154.zh: 丛生的恶毒藤蔓挡住了狭窄的小路。

descriptosaurus-012155.en: The oak tree had a trunk like melting candle wax.
descriptosaurus-012155.zh: 橡树有一根像融化的蜡烛蜡一样的树干。

descriptosaurus-012156.en: The yew tree had a trunk like an enormous cavern.
descriptosaurus-012156.zh: 紫杉树有一个像巨大的洞穴一样的树干。

descriptosaurus-012157.en: Cloaked in mist, the trees looked like ghostly, stooped figures.
descriptosaurus-012157.zh: 笼罩在迷雾中的树木，看起来像幽灵般的，弯腰的人物。

descriptosaurus-012158.en: Carpeted in bluebells, the forest floor looked like a swaying sapphire tide.
descriptosaurus-012158.zh: 森林地面铺着风铃草，看起来像是摇曳的蓝宝石潮汐。

descriptosaurus-012159.en: He was greeted by wave after wave of dazzling yellow daffodils.
descriptosaurus-012159.zh: 一波又一波的黄色水仙花迎接他。

descriptosaurus-012160.en: He was greeted by wave after wave of the nodding yellow heads of dazzling daffodils.
descriptosaurus-012160.zh: 迎接他的是一波又一波的黄水仙子的点点头。

descriptosaurus-012161.en: The entrance was blocked by wave after wave of vicious thorns.
descriptosaurus-012161.zh: 入口被一波又一波的恶毒刺挡住了。

descriptosaurus-012162.en: The entrance was blocked by wave after wave of the piercing barbed needles of vicious thorns.
descriptosaurus-012162.zh: 入口被刺穿的刺穿刺针刺穿恶毒刺针。

descriptosaurus-012163.en: It was a secret, ancient forest with huge towering trees.
descriptosaurus-012163.zh: 这是一片秘密的古老森林，有巨大的高耸树木。

descriptosaurus-012164.en: The forest floor, with its thick layer of pine needles, muffled her footsteps.
descriptosaurus-012164.zh: 森林地面，厚厚的一层松针，压抑了她的脚步。

descriptosaurus-012165.en: The forest floor, with its layer of crispy golden leaves, crunched under her feet.
descriptosaurus-012165.zh: 森林地面，一层酥脆的金色叶子，在她的脚下嘎吱作响。

descriptosaurus-012166.en: The ceiling of thick tangled branches, like a crooked arch, covered the path in flickering shadows.
descriptosaurus-012166.zh: 厚厚的树枝的天花板像弯曲的拱门，在闪烁的阴影中覆盖了路径。

descriptosaurus-012167.en: The carpet of pale ivory snowdrops, like dainty drooping bells, covered the clearing in a rippling white cloak.
descriptosaurus-012167.zh: 苍白的象牙雪花莲的地毯，就像精致的下垂铃铛，披着波浪状的白色斗篷。

descriptosaurus-012168.en: She had entered a mystical, magical forest of ancient yew trees with enormous crooked trunks.
descriptosaurus-012168.zh: 她进入了一个神秘的、神奇的森林，里面长着巨大的弯曲树干。

descriptosaurus-012169.en: She waded through a swaying tide of blazing bluebells: their delicate, fragrant scent wafted through the air.
descriptosaurus-012169.zh: 她在一阵摇摇欲坠的风铃草中涉水：它们细腻、芬芳的气味在空气中飘荡。

descriptosaurus-012171.en: The wind, which hissed through the trees, sounded like whispered threats.
descriptosaurus-012171.zh: 风在树林中嘶嘶作响，听起来像是低声威胁。

descriptosaurus-012172.en: The wind, which sighed through the trees, sounded like soothing whispers.
descriptosaurus-012172.zh: 风在树林中叹息，听起来像是舒缓的耳语。

descriptosaurus-012173.en: The forest floor was a writhing, buzzing cloud of bugs that flitted and scuttled through the undergrowth.
descriptosaurus-012173.zh: 森林地面是一团扭动的、嗡嗡作响的虫云，在灌木丛中飞驰而过。

descriptosaurus-012174.en: She skipped through the crispy golden leaves, which crunched under her feet.
descriptosaurus-012174.zh: 她跳过了酥脆的金色叶子，在她的脚下嘎吱作响。

descriptosaurus-012175.en: She edged deeper into the tangled thicket, whose branches twisted together to form a gloomy tunnel.
descriptosaurus-012175.zh: 她更深入地进入纠缠不清的灌木丛中，树枝扭曲在一起，形成了一条阴暗的隧道。

descriptosaurus-012176.en: She crept into the shadows, where her footsteps were muffled by a thick layer of pine needles.
descriptosaurus-012176.zh: 她爬进了阴影，她的脚步被一层厚厚的松针所掩盖。

descriptosaurus-012177.en: The forest, which had magnificent ancient yew trees and narrow, twisting trails, was mystical and magical.
descriptosaurus-012177.zh: 这片森林有着壮丽的古老紫杉树和狭窄的曲折小径，是神秘而神奇的。

descriptosaurus-012178.en: The hunting howl, whose loud hoot pierced the silence, suddenly flew above them like a white shadow.
descriptosaurus-012178.zh: 狩猎嚎叫，其响亮的叫声刺穿了寂静，突然像白影一样在他们上方飞来飞去。

descriptosaurus-012179.en: The track, which seemed to get narrower with every step, was littered with fallen trees, patches of bramble and strips of swampy ground.
descriptosaurus-012179.zh: 这条小径似乎每一步都变得越来越窄，到处都是倒下的树木、一片片荆棘和沼泽地带。

descriptosaurus-012180.en: They headed deeper into the forest, where the path narrowed and where the tangled spider’s web of thorns had blocked the path.
descriptosaurus-012180.zh: 他们深入森林，路径变窄，纠缠的蜘蛛的荆棘网挡住了道路。

descriptosaurus-012182.en: The forest floor, a layer of crispy golden leaves, crunched under her feet.
descriptosaurus-012182.zh: 森林地面，一层酥脆的金色叶子，在她的脚下嘎吱作响。

descriptosaurus-012183.en: It was an ancient forest, a magical forest, with magnificent towering trees.
descriptosaurus-012183.zh: 那是一片古老的森林，一座神奇的森林，树木壮丽。

descriptosaurus-012184.en: Ivory snowdrops, dainty drooping bells, carpeted the forest floor.
descriptosaurus-012184.zh: 象牙色的雪花莲，精致的下垂铃铛，铺在森林的地板上。

descriptosaurus-012185.en: They waded through a blazing carpet of bluebells, a swaying, knee-deep tide, whose delicate, fragrant scent lingered in the air.
descriptosaurus-012185.zh: 他们涉过一片炽热的风信子地毯，一种摇晃的、膝盖深的潮汐，其微妙的芬芳气息在空气中徘徊。

descriptosaurus-012186.en: The forest floor, a writhing, buzzing carpet, was covered in flitting, scuttling bugs and beetles, midges and termites.
descriptosaurus-012186.zh: 森林地面是一块扭动、嗡嗡作响的地毯，上面覆盖着飘逸的、飞溅的虫子和甲虫、蠓和白蚁。

descriptosaurus-012187.en: The forest floor, a thick layer of pine needles, muffled her footsteps as she moved through the shadows.
descriptosaurus-012187.zh: 森林的地板上，一层厚厚的松针，在她穿过阴影时掩盖了她的脚步声。

descriptosaurus-012189.en: Ahead of them, a narrow, uneven path twisted through the trees.
descriptosaurus-012189.zh: 在他们前面，一条狭窄的、不平坦的小路穿过树林。

descriptosaurus-012190.en: In the moonlight, the trees were like crooked, ghostly figures.
descriptosaurus-012190.zh: 在月光下，树木像弯曲的幽灵般的人物。

descriptosaurus-012191.en: In the shadows around the trees, the squelching mud clutched at their feet.
descriptosaurus-012191.zh: 在树林周围的阴影中，压抑的泥浆抓住了他们的脚。

descriptosaurus-012192.en: Beneath his feet, the tangled undergrowth grasped at his ankles.
descriptosaurus-012192.zh: 在他的脚下，纠结的灌木抓住了他的脚踝。

descriptosaurus-012193.en: Beneath his feet, the tangled undergrowth grasped at his ankles, making him slip, stumble and fall constantly.
descriptosaurus-012193.zh: 在他的脚下，纠结的灌木抓住了他的脚踝，让他不断地滑倒、跌倒和跌倒。

descriptosaurus-012194.en: Above the trees, clouds like fluffy cotton balls drifted across the sky, while below, autumn’s crackling leaves rushed across the ground.
descriptosaurus-012194.zh: 树上像蓬松的棉球一样飘过天空，而在下方，秋天的噼啪作响的树叶在地面上冲过来。

descriptosaurus-012195.en: All of a sudden, an icy wintry breeze whined and creaked through the bare branches.
descriptosaurus-012195.zh: 突然，一阵冰冷的寒风在光秃秃的树枝上发出呜呜声和吱吱声。

descriptosaurus-012196.en: During the storm, the petals had been shaken offthe bush, and lay like a carpet of pink confetti on the floor.
descriptosaurus-012196.zh: 在暴风雨中，花瓣从灌木丛中摇晃，像一块粉红色的五彩纸屑一样铺在地板上。

descriptosaurus-012197.en: In the blink of an eye, the storm arrived to bow the trees, shake their branches and steal their leaves.
descriptosaurus-012197.zh: 一眨眼，暴风雨就到了，鞠躬树木，摇晃着树枝，偷走了叶子。

descriptosaurus-012198.en: Within minutes, the branches were bare: stripped of their autumn cloaks.
descriptosaurus-012198.zh: 几分钟之内，树枝光秃秃的：剥去了秋天的斗篷。

descriptosaurus-012199.en: Every morning in November, dewdrops like liquid diamonds dangled from the branches.
descriptosaurus-012199.zh: 十一月的每个早晨，像液体钻石一样悬挂在树枝上的露珠。

descriptosaurus-012201.en: The sound of the wind among the trees ceased abruptly.
descriptosaurus-012201.zh: 树木间的风声突然停止。

descriptosaurus-012202.en: Their path through the dense undergrowth wound in and out.
descriptosaurus-012202.zh: 他们穿过茂密的灌木丛的路径进出。

descriptosaurus-012203.en: Their path through the dense undergrowth wound in and out: around the tangled, thorny barriers; over the trunks of fallen trees; under low branches; through the gloomy vault formed by the huge oak trees.
descriptosaurus-012203.zh: 他们穿过茂密的灌木丛的路径进出：缠绕、多刺的障碍物； 在倒下的树干上； 在低分枝下； 穿过由巨大的橡树形成的阴郁的拱顶。

descriptosaurus-012204.en: The forest to her left was an endless dark labyrinth of trees.
descriptosaurus-012204.zh: 她左边的森林是一片无尽的黑暗迷宫。

descriptosaurus-012205.en: The forest to her left was an endless dark labyrinth of trees, but to her right, the moonlit clouds glowed through the branches.
descriptosaurus-012205.zh: 她左边的森林是一片无尽的黑暗迷宫树，但在她的右边，月光下的云层在树枝上发光。

descriptosaurus-012214.en: Coordinating Conjunctions: Fanboys (for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so)
descriptosaurus-012214.zh: 协调连词：fanboys（对于，和，nor，but，或，但是，so）

descriptosaurus-012216.en: The forest was a dark tangled maze, and it was impossible to find a way through.
descriptosaurus-012216.zh: 森林是一个黑暗纠结的迷宫，不可能找到一条路。

descriptosaurus-012217.en: He was now in the middle of the forest, and surrounded by blackness on all sides.
descriptosaurus-012217.zh: 他现在在森林的中间，四面八方都被黑暗包围着。

descriptosaurus-012218.en: The branches swayed in the wind, and their leaves fluttered like graceful butterflies.
descriptosaurus-012218.zh: 树枝在风中摇曳，叶子像优雅的蝴蝶一样飘扬。

descriptosaurus-012219.en: They had found a path, but their progress through the tangled thicket was slow.
descriptosaurus-012219.zh: 他们找到了一条路，但他们在纠缠不清的灌木丛中的进展很慢。

descriptosaurus-012220.en: The forest was usually full of sound, but it had fallen strangely silent.
descriptosaurus-012220.zh: 森林通常充满了声音，但它却出奇地沉默了。

descriptosaurus-012221.en: There was nothing she could do, so she stayed absolutely still.
descriptosaurus-012221.zh: 她无能为力，所以她一动不动。

descriptosaurus-012223.en: He quickened his pace, but the ground was uneven.
descriptosaurus-012223.zh: 他加快了步伐，但地面不平坦。

descriptosaurus-012224.en: He quickened his pace, but the ground was uneven and he stumbled.
descriptosaurus-012224.zh: 他加快了步伐，但地面不平，他跌跌撞撞。

descriptosaurus-012225.en: He quickened his pace, but the ground was uneven and he stumbled, crashing to the ground.
descriptosaurus-012225.zh: 他加快了步伐，但地面不平坦，跌跌撞撞，摔倒在地。

descriptosaurus-012226.en: It was easy to imagine something hiding in the shadows or someone watching her from behind the trees.
descriptosaurus-012226.zh: 很容易想象有什么东西藏在阴影里，或者有人在树后看着她。

descriptosaurus-012227.en: She was intrigued by the rich perfume that wafted towards her, so she followed the scent until she came across a blazing carpet of bluebells.
descriptosaurus-012227.zh: 她对飘向她的浓郁香水很感兴趣，所以她顺着气味，直到她遇到了蓝铃的炽热地毯。

descriptosaurus-012229.en: He kept looking over his shoulder, for in his mind every shadow in the wood had grown eyes.
descriptosaurus-012229.zh: 他不停地看着他的肩膀，因为在他的脑海中，树林里的每一个阴影都长成了眼睛。

descriptosaurus-012230.en: There was a growing unease among them as they wound their way through the wood, for its dark recesses could conceal any number of dangers.
descriptosaurus-012230.zh: 当他们穿过树林时，他们中间越来越不安，因为它的黑暗深处可以隐藏任何数量的危险。

descriptosaurus-012231.en: He did not see the vine stretching across the path, nor the fallen tree covered in rotting leaves.
descriptosaurus-012231.zh: 他没有看到藤蔓穿过小路，也没有看到倒下的树上被腐烂的树叶覆盖。

descriptosaurus-012232.en: Neither the thick layer of pine needles nor the carpet of leaves could totally muffle their footsteps.
descriptosaurus-012232.zh: 厚厚的松针和树叶的地毯都不能完全扼杀他们的脚步。

descriptosaurus-012233.en: He was crouched in the shadows, yet ready to move quickly.
descriptosaurus-012233.zh: 他蹲在阴影中，却准备快速移动。

descriptosaurus-012234.en: His knees were rubbery, yet he kept moving as quickly as he could.
descriptosaurus-012234.zh: 他的膝盖是橡胶状的，但他一直在尽可能快地移动。

descriptosaurus-012235.en: His knees were rubbery, his arms and legs splattered with sticky, squelching mud that clung to his feet, yet he kept moving as quickly as he could.
descriptosaurus-012235.zh: 他的膝盖是橡胶状的，他的手臂和腿上溅满了粘在他脚上的粘稠的泥浆，但他一直在尽可能快地移动。

descriptosaurus-012236.en: There was nothing she could do, so she stayed absolutely still and hoped she wouldn’t be seen, for she knew the slightest movement would give her away.
descriptosaurus-012236.zh: 她无能为力，所以她一动不动，希望她不会被看到，因为她知道最轻微的动作会把她送走。

descriptosaurus-012238.en: If he stopped and listened, he could hear the branches creaking in the wind.
descriptosaurus-012238.zh: 如果他停下来听，他能听到树枝在风中吱吱作响的声音。

descriptosaurus-012239.en: If he waited any longer, it would be getting dark.

descriptosaurus-012240.en: If he waited any longer, it would be getting dark, and hide what lay behind the trees.
descriptosaurus-012240.zh: 如果他再等，天黑了，把树后面的东西藏起来。

descriptosaurus-012241.en: If he waited any longer, it would be getting dark, hiding what lay behind the trees – watching and waiting.
descriptosaurus-012241.zh: 如果他再等再等，天就会变黑，把树后的东西藏起来——看着和等待。

descriptosaurus-012242.en: He did not see the roots that wriggled across the ground because they were hidden by layers of rotting leaves.
descriptosaurus-012242.zh: 他没有看到在地面上蠕动的根，因为它们被一层层腐烂的树叶所隐藏。

descriptosaurus-012243.en: When winter came, icy frosts coated the trees, the bushes, the undergrowth.
descriptosaurus-012243.zh: 冬天来了，冰霜覆盖了树木、灌木丛和灌木丛。

descriptosaurus-012244.en: An eerie gloom filled the clearing when patches of misty light shone through the gaps in the trees.
descriptosaurus-012244.zh: 当一片薄雾的光芒透过树林的缝隙照耀着时，一片怪异的阴霾充满了空地。

descriptosaurus-012245.en: When he took a step forward, he could feel the oozing mud of the swamp suddenly squelching beneath his feet.
descriptosaurus-012245.zh: 当他向前迈出一步时，他能感觉到沼泽渗出的泥浆突然在他的脚下发出嘶嘶声。

descriptosaurus-012246.en: Before winter had spread its chill over the forest, clusters of purple and pink blossoms had covered the bushes.
descriptosaurus-012246.zh: 在冬天蔓延到森林之前，一簇簇紫色和粉红色的花朵已经覆盖了灌木丛。

descriptosaurus-012247.en: After the sun had spread its glittering rays, the forest was bathed in a hazy golden light.
descriptosaurus-012247.zh: 太阳散发出光芒后，森林沐浴在朦胧的金色光芒中。

descriptosaurus-012248.en: While she had stumbled through the tangled thicket, the sun had fallen like a sinking stone, and a black cloud had been drawn across the sky.
descriptosaurus-012248.zh: 当她在纠结的灌木丛中跌跌撞撞时，太阳像一块下沉的石头一样落下，天空中划出了一片乌云。

descriptosaurus-012249.en: The wind pounded at the trees until it had bent their branches and stolen their leaves.
descriptosaurus-012249.zh: 风在树上猛烈撞击，直到它弯曲了它们的树枝并偷走了它们的叶子。

descriptosaurus-012250.en: Although it was the middle of the day, the ceiling of thick branches shut out the light.
descriptosaurus-012250.zh: 虽然是中午，但浓密的树枝的天花板挡住了灯光。

descriptosaurus-012251.en: Where the branches had spread to form an arched ceiling, the ground was a muddy swamp.
descriptosaurus-012251.zh: 树枝张开形成拱形天花板的地方，地面是一片泥泞的沼泽。

descriptosaurus-012252.en: As winter spread its icy breath over the forest, dewdrops like liquid diamonds clung to the branches.
descriptosaurus-012252.zh: 当冬天在森林上散发出冰冷的气息时，像液体钻石一样粘在树枝上的露珠。

descriptosaurus-012253.en: The branches began to form a gloomy tunnel as she edged deeper into the thicket.
descriptosaurus-012253.zh: 当她深入灌木丛时，树枝开始形成一条阴暗的隧道。

descriptosaurus-012255.en: The forest, spreading in all directions, was a gloomy, twisting labyrinth.
descriptosaurus-012255.zh: 四面八方的森林，是一片阴森森的迷宫。

descriptosaurus-012256.en: Tearing at her arms and legs, the sharp, barbed barricade was a spider’s web of needle-sharp thorns.
descriptosaurus-012256.zh: 撕裂她的胳膊和腿，锋利的带刺的路障是蜘蛛的尖刺刺网。

descriptosaurus-012257.en: Hissing through the trees, the wind sounded like whispered threats.
descriptosaurus-012257.zh: 在树林中嘶嘶作响的风声像是低声的威胁。

descriptosaurus-012258.en: Flickering in the moonlight, the leafy shadows looked like ghostly eyes.
descriptosaurus-012258.zh: 月光中闪烁的阴影，看起来像幽灵般的眼睛。

descriptosaurus-012259.en: Grasping at her clothes, tearing at her arms and legs, the stiff, daggerlike thorns were sharp fingernails.
descriptosaurus-012259.zh: 抓着她的衣服，撕扯着她的胳膊和腿，僵硬、像匕首一样的刺是锋利的指甲。

descriptosaurus-012260.en: The dense undergrowth tugged at her feet, trying to trip her.
descriptosaurus-012260.zh: 茂密的灌木丛拉着她的脚，试图绊倒她。

descriptosaurus-012261.en: The dense undergrowth tugged at her feet, trying to trip her, throwing up gnarled, ankle-twisting roots and impenetrable walls of thorns and brambles.
descriptosaurus-012261.zh: 茂密的灌木丛牵着她的脚，试图绊倒她，吐出粗糙的、扭曲的脚踝和无法穿透的荆棘和荆棘墙。

descriptosaurus-012262.en: Swinging her legs, wrapping them around the branch, she pulled herself on to it.
descriptosaurus-012262.zh: 摆动她的腿，将它们缠绕在树枝上，她把自己拉到上面。

descriptosaurus-012263.en: Swinging her legs, wrapping them around the branch, she pulled herself on to it, then reached from branch to branch until she found a fork in the branches where she could sit and keep watch.
descriptosaurus-012263.zh: 摆动她的腿，将它们缠绕在树枝上，她把自己拉到树枝上，然后从一个树枝伸到另一个树枝，直到她在树枝上找到一个叉子，在那里她可以坐下来守望。

descriptosaurus-012264.en: Leaping up, Scarlett threw herself at a lower branch of the tree.
descriptosaurus-012264.zh: 斯嘉丽跳了起来，扑向树的下枝。

descriptosaurus-012265.en: Leaping up, Scarlett threw herself at a lower branch of the tree, grasped the branch and scrambled upwards.
descriptosaurus-012265.zh: 斯嘉丽跳了起来，扑向树的下枝，抓住树枝，向上爬了起来。

descriptosaurus-012266.en: Resting on his hands and knees, he sucked in air.
descriptosaurus-012266.zh: 他靠在他的手和膝盖上，吸进了空气中。

descriptosaurus-012267.en: Resting on his hands and knees, his shoulders heaving, he sucked in air.
descriptosaurus-012267.zh: 他靠在他的手和膝盖上，他的肩膀起伏，吸进了空气中。

descriptosaurus-012268.en: Resting on his hands and knees, his shoulders heaving as he sucked in air, Tom slowly raised his head.
descriptosaurus-012268.zh: 汤姆靠在他的手和膝盖上，他的肩膀在吸入空气时起伏，慢慢地抬起头。

descriptosaurus-012270.en: (There are also examples within the other sections)

descriptosaurus-012271.en: The branches, gnarled bony fingers, reached an arm-like tentacle over the wall.
descriptosaurus-012271.zh: 树枝，粗糙的手指，伸到墙上的手臂状触手上。

descriptosaurus-012272.en: Ahead, they spotted a narrow path – an uneven, treacherous, ankletwisting path – disappearing into the thicket.
descriptosaurus-012272.zh: 前方，他们发现了一条狭窄的小路——一条不平坦、危险、脚踝的小路——消失在灌木丛中。

descriptosaurus-012273.en: Clusters of vivid, colourful blossoms, purples, reds, blues and yellows, cloaked the forest.
descriptosaurus-012273.zh: 鲜艳的、五颜六色的花朵、紫色、红色、蓝色和黄色的簇生，遮住了森林。

descriptosaurus-012274.en: Like a carpet of jewels (amethysts, rubies, sapphires), clusters of dazzling blossoms painted the forest floor in a rainbow of vivid colour.
descriptosaurus-012274.zh: 就像一块珠宝（紫水晶、红宝石、蓝宝石）的地毯，一簇簇耀眼的花朵将森林的地板描绘成鲜艳的彩虹。

descriptosaurus-012275.en: The yew tree – huge, ancient, scaly – climbed almost horizontally out of the ground.
descriptosaurus-012275.zh: 紫杉树——巨大的、古老的、鳞片状的——几乎是水平地从地上爬出来的。

descriptosaurus-012277.en: He was crouched in the shadows; he was ready to move quickly.
descriptosaurus-012277.zh: 他蹲在阴影中； 他准备迅速行动。

descriptosaurus-012278.en: They moved deeper into the forest to where the path ended, and Scarlett halted; she wondered whether she should double back or follow the mat of creeping, dark green weed.
descriptosaurus-012278.zh: 他们深入森林，到达小路结束的地方，斯嘉丽停了下来。 她想知道她是应该双退还是跟随爬行的深绿色杂草的垫子。

descriptosaurus-012279.en: Usually, the forest was full of sound; it had suddenly fallen strangely silent.
descriptosaurus-012279.zh: 通常，森林充满了声音； 它突然变得奇怪地沉默了。

descriptosaurus-012280.en: He slid and scrambled up the bank; his feet were struggling to get a grip in the mud.
descriptosaurus-012280.zh: 他滑到河岸上； 他的脚在泥泞中挣扎着抓住。

descriptosaurus-012281.en: There was nothing she could do; she stayed absolutely still.
descriptosaurus-012281.zh: 她无能为力； 她一动不动。

descriptosaurus-012282.en: It was easy to imagine something hiding in the shadows; to imagine someone watching her from behind the trees.
descriptosaurus-012282.zh: 很容易想象隐藏在阴影中的东西； 想象有人在树后看着她。

descriptosaurus-012284.en: There was a growing unease among them as they wound their way through the wood: its dark recesses could conceal any number of dangers.
descriptosaurus-012284.zh: 当他们穿过树林时，他们中间越来越不安：它的黑暗深处可以隐藏任何数量的危险。

descriptosaurus-012285.en: He kept looking over his shoulder: in his mind every shadow in the wood had grown eyes.
descriptosaurus-012285.zh: 他一直看着他的肩膀：在他的脑海里，树林里的每一个阴影都长成了眼睛。

descriptosaurus-012286.en: His foot caught on a vine across the path: a vine dotted with vicious thorns, concealed by the dense undergrowth like cunning tripwire.
descriptosaurus-012286.zh: 他的脚夹在小路上的一根藤蔓上：一棵藤蔓上点缀着恶毒的荆棘，被茂密的灌木丛掩藏着，像狡猾的绊线一样。

descriptosaurus-012287.en: He was searching for a single yew tree in the centre of the forest: an ancient yew, with a gnarled, splintered trunk that had created a hollow cavern in its centre.
descriptosaurus-012287.zh: 他在森林中心寻找一棵紫杉树：一棵古老的红豆杉，有一个多节的、碎裂的树干，在它的中心形成了一个空洞的洞穴。

descriptosaurus-012288.en: It was a dense, dark forest with eerie mazes and dangerous traps: secret paths and hidden swamps, impenetrable walls of thorns and brambles.
descriptosaurus-012288.zh: 这是一片茂密、黑暗的森林，有着令人毛骨悚然的迷宫和危险的陷阱：秘密路径和隐藏的沼泽，荆棘和荆棘墙。

descriptosaurus-012289.en: Vicious vines, like barbed wire, blocked the clearing: their needle-sharp thorns clutched at the arms and legs of anyone who dared to enter.
descriptosaurus-012289.zh: 恶毒的藤蔓，就像铁丝网一样，挡住了空地：它们的尖刺刺抓住了任何敢于进入的人的胳膊和腿。

descriptosaurus-012290.en: As branches swayed in the wind, he quickened his pace: his mind imagined that every shadow in the wood had grown eyes.
descriptosaurus-012290.zh: 当树枝在风中摇曳时，他加快了步伐：他的脑海里想象着树林里的每一个影子都长成了眼睛。

descriptosaurus-012300.en: They had entered a secret, ancient forest.
descriptosaurus-012300.zh: 他们进入了一个秘密的古老森林。

descriptosaurus-012301.en: A secret, ancient forest loomed before them.
descriptosaurus-012301.zh: 一个秘密的古老森林在他们面前隐约可见。

descriptosaurus-012302.en: Frozen liquid diamonds hung from every branch.
descriptosaurus-012302.zh: 每个分支悬挂着冷冻的液体钻石。

descriptosaurus-012303.en: Hanging from every branch were frozen liquid diamonds.
descriptosaurus-012303.zh: 悬挂在每个分支上的是冷冻液钻。

descriptosaurus-012304.en: Magnificent towering trees guarded the entrance to the ancient wood.
descriptosaurus-012304.zh: 壮丽的高耸的树木守卫着古木的入口。

descriptosaurus-012305.en: Guarding the entrance to the ancient wood were magnificent towering trees.
descriptosaurus-012305.zh: 守卫着古老木头的入口，是壮丽的高耸树木。

descriptosaurus-012306.en: The entrance to the ancient wood was guarded by magnificent towering trees.
descriptosaurus-012306.zh: 古树的入口被壮丽的高耸树木守卫着。

descriptosaurus-012307.en: The forest had a carpet of pale ivory snowdrops with dainty drooping bells.
descriptosaurus-012307.zh: 森林里有一块苍白的象牙雪花莲地毯，上面有精致的下垂铃铛。

descriptosaurus-012308.en: Pale ivory snowdrops, with dainty drooping bells, carpeted the forest.
descriptosaurus-012308.zh: 苍白的象牙雪花莲，带着精致的下垂铃铛，铺满了森林。

descriptosaurus-012309.en: The forest was carpeted by pale ivory snowdrops with dainty drooping bells.
descriptosaurus-012309.zh: 森林被苍白的象牙雪花莲铺满了地毯，上面有精致的下垂铃铛。

descriptosaurus-012310.en: The trees were cloaked in mist that made the trees look like ghostly, stooped figures leaning towards each other.
descriptosaurus-012310.zh: 树木笼罩在迷雾中，树木看起来像幽灵般的，弯腰的人影靠在彼此身上。

descriptosaurus-012311.en: Cloaked in mist, the trees looked like ghostly, stooped figures leaning towards each other.
descriptosaurus-012311.zh: 笼罩在迷雾中的树木，看起来像幽灵般的弯腰身影，互相靠在身边。

descriptosaurus-012312.en: Vicious vines, like barbed wire, blocked the clearing.
descriptosaurus-012312.zh: 恶毒的藤蔓，就像铁丝网一样，挡住了空地。

descriptosaurus-012313.en: Like barbed wire, vicious vines blocked the clearing, The clearing was blocked by vicious vines like barbed wire.
descriptosaurus-012313.zh: 像铁丝网一样，恶毒的藤蔓挡住了空地，空地被铁丝网等恶毒藤蔓挡住了。

descriptosaurus-012315.en: Prickly and needle-sharp, the undergrowth was a thorny spider’s web.
descriptosaurus-012315.zh: 多刺和尖锐的，灌木丛是一个棘手的蜘蛛网。

descriptosaurus-012316.en: Towering and majestic, the trees stood tall and proud.
descriptosaurus-012316.zh: 高耸而雄伟，树木高大而自豪。

descriptosaurus-012317.en: Rich, vivid and velvety, the blossoms painted the bushes with splashes of dazzling colour.
descriptosaurus-012317.zh: 丰富、生动、天鹅绒般的花朵，在灌木丛中涂上了令人眼花缭乱的色彩。

descriptosaurus-012318.en: As dry as bone, the blanket of dead leaves crunched under his feet.
descriptosaurus-012318.zh: 像骨头一样干燥，枯叶的毯子在他的脚下嘎吱作响。

descriptosaurus-012319.en: Clad in their beautiful, fiery autumn cloaks, the trees swayed in the wind: their leaves fluttered like graceful butterflies.
descriptosaurus-012319.zh: 身着美丽、炽热的秋斗篷，树木在风中摇曳：它们的叶子像优雅的蝴蝶一样飘扬。

descriptosaurus-012320.en: Deeper and deeper, darker and darker, the trail twisted and turned through the forest: under the gloomy vault formed by the huge oak trees; across the dense undergrowth and around the tangled, thorny barriers.
descriptosaurus-012320.zh: 越来越深，越来越黑，小径在森林中扭曲和转动：在巨大的橡树树形成的阴郁的拱顶下； 穿过茂密的灌木丛和纠结的、多刺的障碍。

descriptosaurus-012321.en: Desperate, he searched for the trail between the spidery knot of trees and bushes.
descriptosaurus-012321.zh: 绝望的是，他在树木和灌木的蜘蛛结之间寻找小径。

descriptosaurus-012323.en: The trees, towering and majestic, stood tall and proud.
descriptosaurus-012323.zh: 高耸而雄伟的树木，高大而自豪。

descriptosaurus-012324.en: A thicket, tangled, gnarled and thorny, guarded the entrance.
descriptosaurus-012324.zh: 一个灌木丛、纠结、多节和多刺，守卫着入口。

descriptosaurus-012325.en: Blossoms, rich, vivid and velvety, painted the bushes with splashes of dazzling colour.
descriptosaurus-012325.zh: 鲜花丰富、生动、天鹅绒般，在灌木丛中涂上了令人眼花缭乱的色彩。

descriptosaurus-012326.en: The undergrowth, prickly and needle-sharp, was a thorny spider’s web.
descriptosaurus-012326.zh: 灌木丛生，刺痛且尖锐，是一个棘手的蜘蛛网。

descriptosaurus-012327.en: Trunks, thick, twisted and splintered, spread into an arched ceiling.
descriptosaurus-012327.zh: 树干，厚实，扭曲和碎裂，蔓延成拱形的天花板。

descriptosaurus-012329.en: Up and up, the trees stretched towards the sky.

descriptosaurus-012330.en: Overhead, the huge canopy of treetops joined together like a crowd of vivid green umbrellas.
descriptosaurus-012330.zh: 在头顶上，巨大的树梢天篷像一群生动的绿色雨伞一样结合在一起。

descriptosaurus-012331.en: Instantly, the ground was painted with flickering shadows.
descriptosaurus-012331.zh: 瞬间，地面上涂上了闪烁的阴影。

descriptosaurus-012332.en: Around and around, the leaves swirled as the frosty gusts chased them along the ground.
descriptosaurus-012332.zh: 四处转转，当冰冷的阵风沿着地面追着它们时，树叶旋转了。

descriptosaurus-012333.en: Soon, the gusts of frosty air will arrive to steal the leaves from the branches.
descriptosaurus-012333.zh: 很快，寒冷的空气就会到来，从树枝上偷走树叶。

descriptosaurus-012335.en: The trees stretched up and up towards the sky.
descriptosaurus-012335.zh: 树木向上延伸，向天空延伸。

descriptosaurus-012336.en: The huge canopy of treetops overhead joined together like a crowd of vivid green umbrellas.
descriptosaurus-012336.zh: 头顶上巨大的树冠像一群生动的绿色雨伞连接在一起。

descriptosaurus-012337.en: The leaves swirled around and around as the frosty gusts chased them along the ground.
descriptosaurus-012337.zh: 树叶在地面上盘旋着，冰冷的阵风追着它们。

descriptosaurus-012338.en: The gusts of frosty air will soon arrive to steal the leaves from the branches.
descriptosaurus-012338.zh: 冰冷的空气很快就会到达，从树枝上偷走树叶。

descriptosaurus-012339.en: Clusters of purple blossoms drooped sleepily from the branches: drowsy and dozy in the warm summer sun.
descriptosaurus-012339.zh: 一簇簇紫色的花朵从树枝上昏昏沉沉地垂下：在温暖的夏日阳光下昏昏欲睡和昏昏欲睡。

descriptosaurus-012340.en: The trees tossed their branches upwards and flung their leaves to the sky.
descriptosaurus-012340.zh: 树木向上扔树枝，将叶子扔向天空。

descriptosaurus-012341.en: The ground was instantly painted with flickering shadows.
descriptosaurus-012341.zh: 地面瞬间被闪烁的阴影所描绘。

descriptosaurus-012343.en: The trees floated, swayed and danced in the moonlight.
descriptosaurus-012343.zh: 树木在月光下飘荡、摇曳、跳舞。

descriptosaurus-012344.en: The haunting, prickly murmur of the wind sighed through trees, whistled through the branches and crackled through the canopy.
descriptosaurus-012344.zh: 令人难以忘怀的刺痛的风声在树林中叹息，穿过树枝，噼里啪啦地穿过树冠。

descriptosaurus-012345.en: The stiff, icy fingers of the thorns pulled, tugged and grasped at his clothes, hair and arms.
descriptosaurus-012345.zh: 荆棘僵硬、冰冷的手指拉着、拉扯、抓住他的衣服、头发和手臂。

descriptosaurus-012346.en: The stiff, icy fingers of the thorns pulled at his clothes, tugged at his hair, grasped at his arms.
descriptosaurus-012346.zh: 荆棘僵硬、冰冷的手指拉扯着他的衣服，拉扯着他的头发，抓住了他的手臂。

descriptosaurus-012347.en: The damp, stinking reek from the swamp seeped from the ground, surged through the trees and lingered in the air.
descriptosaurus-012347.zh: 潮湿的臭臭从地面渗出，从树林中涌出，在空中徘徊。

descriptosaurus-012348.en: The fiery scarlet leaves fluttered in the breeze, quivered on their branches and floated to the ground to dance on gusts of frosty air.
descriptosaurus-012348.zh: 火红的红叶在微风中飘扬，在树枝上颤抖，飘到地上，在冰冷的空气中跳舞。

descriptosaurus-012349.en: The ceiling of thick branches were locked together, shutting out the light, covering the path in shadows, painting flickering shadows on the trees.
descriptosaurus-012349.zh: 厚枝的天花板被锁在一起，遮住了光线，在阴影中覆盖了路径，在树上画了闪烁的阴影。

descriptosaurus-012351.en: Rain-drenched, fresh, vibrant, blooming with new growth, spring had enveloped the forest.
descriptosaurus-012351.zh: 雨淋的、清新的、充满活力的、盛开的新生，春天已经笼罩了森林。

descriptosaurus-012352.en: Dazzling, breathtaking, spectacular golden blossoms hung in masses from vivid green stems.
descriptosaurus-012352.zh: 鲜艳的绿色茎上散发出耀眼、壮丽、壮观的金色花朵。

descriptosaurus-012353.en: Prickly and needle-sharp, tangled and thorny, the undergrowth was a spiked spider’s web.
descriptosaurus-012353.zh: 多刺和尖锐、纠结和多刺的灌木丛是尖刺的蜘蛛网。

descriptosaurus-012354.en: On and on, wave after wave of blazing bluebells greeted them as they entered the clearing.
descriptosaurus-012354.zh: 当他们进入空地时，一波又一波的炽热风信子迎接他们。

descriptosaurus-012355.en: On and on, mile after mile, they trudged through the gloomy vault: across the dense undergrowth, around the tangled, thorny barriers, over the trunks of fallen trees, under low branches.
descriptosaurus-012355.zh: 一英里又一英里，他们跋涉穿过阴沉的穹顶：穿过茂密的灌木丛，围绕着纠缠不清的多刺障碍，在倒下的树干上，在低矮的树枝下。

descriptosaurus-012356.en: Viciously, venomously, the vines, like barbed wire, grasped at the arms and legs of anyone daring to enter.
descriptosaurus-012356.zh: 恶毒地，恶毒地，藤蔓，像铁丝网一样，抓住了任何敢于进入的人的胳膊和腿。

descriptosaurus-012357.en: Gently, soothingly, the wind sighed through the trees, stirred her hair and tickled her face.
descriptosaurus-012357.zh: 轻轻地，舒缓地，风吹过树林，搅动着她的头发，挠了挠她的脸。

descriptosaurus-012358.en: The matted creepers slithered along the floor and around the trunks, strangling them in their slimy grasp.
descriptosaurus-012358.zh: 杂乱无章的爬行者沿着地板和树干滑行，将它们勒死在粘糊糊的抓握中。

descriptosaurus-012359.en: The morning dew crept up the trunk and around the leaves to hang like liquid diamonds.
descriptosaurus-012359.zh: 清晨的露水爬上树干，像液体钻石一样悬挂在树叶周围。

descriptosaurus-012360.en: Every morning in November, when winter had spread its frosty chill over the forest, the dewdrops like crystal earrings dangled from the branches.
descriptosaurus-012360.zh: 十一月的每一个早晨，当冬天的寒冷在森林上蔓延开来时，树枝上悬挂着像水晶耳环一样的露珠。

descriptosaurus-012361.en: When the thick tangled branches spread and twist to form dark, overhead tunnels and secret paths; when the creepers strangle the trees; when darkness covers the paths, the forest has truly become a forbidden, impenetrable maze.
descriptosaurus-012361.zh: 当厚厚的树枝蔓延和扭曲形成黑暗的顶层隧道和秘密路径时； 当爬行者勒死树木时； 当黑暗笼罩小路时，森林已经真正成为一个禁忌的、无法穿透的迷宫。

descriptosaurus-012362.en: Until you have seen the magnificent forest of majestic trees with their beautiful green cloaks; until you have glimpsed the brightly coloured creepers like party streamers; until you have stared in amazement at the pale ivory snowdrops with their dainty drooping bells, you haven’t fully wondered at the magic of nature.
descriptosaurus-012362.zh: 直到你看到壮丽的树林和美丽的绿色斗篷； 直到你瞥见了色彩鲜艳的爬行者，比如派对彩带； 直到你惊讶地盯着苍白的象牙雪花莲，它们精致的下垂铃铛，你还没有完全怀疑大自然的魔力。

descriptosaurus-012363.en: Wherever he looked, wherever he stepped, the tangled, thorny barriers threatened to clutch at his ankles, to grasp at his arms, to scratch at his face.
descriptosaurus-012363.zh: 无论他走到哪里，无论他走到哪里，纠结、多刺的屏障都威胁要抓住他的脚踝，抓住他的手臂，抓挠他的脸。

descriptosaurus-012364.en: Wherever he looked, spring was ready, to wake the forest from its wintry slumber, to thrust emerald shoots out of the ground, to paint the hills in reds, yellows and greens, to sprinkle tiny diamonds on the streams.
descriptosaurus-012364.zh: 无论他看哪里，春天都准备好，将森林从寒冷的沉睡中唤醒，将翡翠的枝条从地下推开，将山丘涂成红色、黄色和绿色，在溪流上洒上小钻石。

descriptosaurus-012365.en: The deeper he went into the forest, the more he realised that it would be impossible to find a way through the gloomy, twisted labyrinth, to negotiate the tangled thicket, to find a way out.
descriptosaurus-012365.zh: 他越深入森林，他就越意识到不可能在阴郁、扭曲的迷宫中找到一条路，通过纠缠的灌木丛，寻找出路。

descriptosaurus-012949.zh: 她知道它的凹槽可以隐藏任何数量的危险。

descriptosaurus-012950.en: The forest had been full of noise.

descriptosaurus-012951.en: Birds had fluttered in the trees.

descriptosaurus-012952.en: But as dusk fell, an eerie silence descended on the forest.
descriptosaurus-012952.zh: 但随着黄昏的降临，森林中一片诡异的寂静降临。

descriptosaurus-012953.en: Squirrels had scampered from branch to branch.
descriptosaurus-012953.zh: 松鼠从一个分支到另一个分支都奔跑了。

descriptosaurus-012954.en: Scarlett couldn’t shake off the sensation that she was being followed.
descriptosaurus-012954.zh: 斯嘉丽无法摆脱她被跟踪的感觉。

descriptosaurus-012955.en: Every few steps, she kept glancing nervously over her shoulder.

descriptosaurus-012970.zh: 有那么一瞬间，斯嘉丽被冻在了原地，她的心在胸口怦怦直跳。

descriptosaurus-012972.en: Then, blind instinct took over from sheer panic, and she flung herself down under the nearest bush.
descriptosaurus-012972.zh: 然后，盲目的本能从纯粹的恐慌中接手，她把自己扑倒在最近的灌木丛下。
